udhaar.title: Udhaar (credit)
udhaar.body: Gahak cheez abhi le leta hai aur paise baad mein deta hai, saare ya kuch. Jo baqi rahein woh us ke khate mein likhe rehte hain jab tak woh de na de. English software mein isay "credit" kehte hain.
udhaar.example: Phone Rs. 50,000. Abhi 20,000 diye → 30,000 us ke khate mein udhaar.

khata.title: Khata
khata.body: Har shakhs (gahak, dealer, doosri dukaan) ka ek safha jis mein us ke saath har bill aur har len den hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke us se kitne lene hain ya usay kitne dene hain.
khata.example: Bilal ka khata: 30,000 ka udhaar, 10,000 diye → us se 20,000 lene hain.

cost.title: Khareed qeemat
cost.body: Dukaan ne cheez jitne mein khareedi. Yeh sirf malik aur manager ko nazar aati hai. Munafa isi se nikalta hai.

asking.title: Bechne ki qeemat
asking.body: Jis qeemat par bechne ka irada hai. Yeh khareed qeemat se kam nahi ho sakti. Counter par badal sakte hain, aur nuqsan par sirf malik ya manager bech sakta hai.

profit.title: Munafa
profit.body: Bechne ki qeemat mein se khareed qeemat nikaal kar jo bache. "Kharche ke baad munafa" mein us waqt ka kiraya, bill, tankhwahein aur baqi kharche bhi nikale jate hain.
profit.example: 52,000 mein becha, 45,000 mein khareeda tha → munafa 7,000.

pta.title: PTA status
pta.body: PTA approved: phone Pakistan mein register hai, har SIM chalti hai. Non-PTA: register nahi, SIM thore din hi chalti hai. JV / patch: PTA se bachne ke liye phone mein tabdeeli ki gayi hai; khareed-farokht mein khatra hai.
pta.example: Bahar se aaya iPhone jis par PTA tax nahi diya: Non-PTA.

imei.title: IMEI
imei.body: 15 hindson ka number jo sirf usi ek phone ka hota hai. Phone par *#06# milayein ya dabbe par dekhein. App isi se phone ki kahani nikalti hai aur chori ke phone se khabardar karti hai.

idcheck.title: ID card check
idcheck.body: Jab gahak se purana phone khareedein to us ke CNIC aur chehre ki tasweer rakh lein. Agar phone chori ka nikla to aap dikha sakte hain ke kis ne becha. Jaanne wale ke liye chhor bhi sakte hain.
idcheck.example: CNIC ka aaga aur peechha, bechne wale ki tasweer aur phone ki tasweer.

opening.title: Purana stock
opening.body: Woh phone jo app shuru karne se pehle dukaan mein maujood the. Inhein ek dafa daal dein taake stock poora ho. Abhi koi paise nahi diye jate, is liye din ka hisaab nahi badalta.
opening.example: Pehle din shelf par rakhe 25 phone daal dein.

cut.title: Wapsi par dukaan ki katoti
cut.body: Jab gahak phone wapas laye to dukaan kuch paise rakh kar baqi wapas kar sakti hai. Jo dukaan rakhe woh aamdani mein gina jata hai.
cut.example: 1,00,000 mein becha, 90,000 wapas diye → dukaan ki katoti 10,000.

inHand.title: Haath mein bache
inHand.body: Us waqt mein jitne paise aaye un mein se jitne gaye (bikri, adaigiyan, kharche, stock ki khareed, wapsiyan). Stock par lage paise ab dukaan mein phone ki shakal mein hain, yeh nuqsan nahi.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.body: Kharabi ki soorat mein dukaan kitne arse tak theek karegi ya badlegi. Yeh raseed par chhapti hai.
warranty.example: 1 mahine ki warranty: mahine ke andar koi kharabi dukaan ki zimmedari.

tid.title: TID
tid.body: Transaction ID: online payment ke baad bank app ya SMS mein aane wala number. Likh lein to baad mein koi sawal ho to payment dhoondna aasaan hai.

cheque.title: Cheque
cheque.body: Bank ke cheque se payment. Paise account mein tab aate hain jab cheque clear ho, is liye app cheque alag "Cheques" khate mein rakhti hai.
cheque.example: HBL ka cheque number 00123456, tareekh 5 November.

remittance.title: Bahar se paise
remittance.body: Khareedne wale ke ghar wale doosre mulk se paise bhejte hain (Western Union, bank waghera). Un ki currency mein raqam aur rate likhein, rupay app khud nikaal deti hai.

void.title: Bill cancel karna
void.body: Ghalti se bana bill khatam karta hai. Kuch mitaya nahi jata: app ulti entry daal deti hai, is liye kahani aur hisaab dono theek rehte hain.
void.example: Ek bikri do dafa chadh gayi: ek cancel kar dein.

audit.title: Dukaan ka audit
audit.body: Kisi bhi arse ka poora karobar ek jagah: kya bika, kya khareeda, asal munafa, paisa kahan se aaya kahan gaya, kis par kya baqi hai, aur stock ke phone. Balance arse ke shuru aur aakhir (ya chune hue din) ke dikhte hain; har khana apne peechay ki list kholta hai.
audit.example: "Pichla mahina" chunein: bikri 1,250,000, munafa 180,000, naqad aur bank shuru mein 300,000 aur aakhir mein 410,000, logon par 95,000 baqi.

netSales.title: Net sale
netSales.body: Is muddat ki sari sale, discount aur gahak ki wapsi nikal kar. Sath wala % pichle utne hi dinon se muqabla hai.
netSales.example: 3 phone Rs. 1,20,000 mein beche, Rs. 2,000 discount diya, ek Samsung A15 Rs. 38,000 ka wapis aaya → net sale Rs. 80,000.

realProfit.title: Asal munafa (kharchon ke baad)
realProfit.body: Net sale mein se bike maal ki khareed qeemat aur kharche (kiraya, bill, tankhwah) nikal kar, repair aur doosri aamdani jama kar ke. Malik ka ghar le jaya paisa kharcha nahi. Red ka matlab nuqsan hai.
realProfit.example: Net sale Rs. 5,00,000, khareed Rs. 4,20,000, kharche Rs. 45,000, repair aamdani Rs. 10,000 → asal munafa Rs. 45,000.

attention.title: Abhi dekhne wali cheezein
attention.body: Aaj dekhne wale kaam, abhi ke hisaab se (chuni hui muddat ke nahi): ID check baqi, stock alert, late qistein aur len-den ki wapsi ki tareekhen. Chip dabayen, list khul jayegi.
attention.example: Chip par likha hai "ID check baqi 2" aur "Late qistein 1 · Rs. 8,000" → woh 2 phone dekhein aur us ek gahak ko call karein.

idChecks.title: ID check baqi
idChecks.body: Stock ke woh phone jin ke bechne wale ka ID check abhi baqi hai ya mashkook mark hua hai. Mashkook wale red mein dikhte hain.
idChecks.example: Used iPhone 13 khareeda aur CNIC check poora nahi kiya → jab tak clear na karein yahan 1 gina jayega.

lateInstallments.title: Late qistein
lateInstallments.body: Woh qiston ke plan jin ki kam az kam ek mahana qist tareekh guzarne ke baad bhi nahi aayi, aur un late qiston ki kul raqam.
lateInstallments.example: Ali ke Infinix Hot 40 ki Rs. 5,000 ki qist 5 tareekh ko thi, nahi aayi; Bilal ki Rs. 3,000 late → 2 plan, Rs. 8,000.

lendingLate.title: Len-den late
lendingLate.body: Woh log jinhein baghair bill paise diye aur un ki wapsi ki wade ki tareekh guzar gayi, aur woh abhi kitne dene hain.
lendingLate.example: Usman ko Rs. 20,000 diye, 10 tareekh tak wapsi ka wada tha, aaj 15 hai → late 1 · Rs. 20,000.

lendingWeOwe.title: Len-den wapis dena hai
lendingWeOwe.body: Dukaan ne baghair bill jo paise udhaar liye aur 3 din ke andar wapis karne hain ya tareekh guzar chuki hai.
lendingWeOwe.example: Hall Road ke dealer se Rs. 50,000 liye, 12 tareekh ko wapis karne hain, aaj 10 hai → 1 · Rs. 50,000.

dueToday.title: Aaj ki qistein
dueToday.body: Woh qiston ke plan jin ki agli mahana qist aaj hai (aur abhi koi late nahi).
dueToday.example: Sana ke Samsung A15 plan ki Rs. 4,000 ki qist aaj hai → 1. Dukaan band karne se pehle yaad dilayen.

dead_stock.title: Dead stock
dead_stock.body: Woh phone jo aap ki aakhri umar ki had (agar nahi badli to 90 din) se zyada stock mein pare hain. In mein paisa phansa hai.
dead_stock.example: Ek Oppo A57 ko aaye 120 din ho gaye, abhi tak nahi bika → dead stock hai; qeemat kam karne ka sochein.

high_value_slow.title: Mehnga, aahista bikne wala
high_value_slow.body: Mehnga phone (khareed qeemat aap ki mehnge ki had yani aam tor par Rs. 50,000 ya zyada) jo "normal" had (aam tor par 30 din) se zyada para hai.
high_value_slow.example: iPhone 13 Rs. 1,40,000 mein khareeda, 45 din se stock mein → yahan dikhega, kyunke bari raqam ruki hui hai.

low_margin.title: Kam munafa
low_margin.body: Maangi gayi qeemat khareed qeemat ke itni qareeb hai ke mutawaqqa munafa aap ki had (aam tor par 5%) se kam hai.
low_margin.example: Vivo Y20 Rs. 30,000 mein khareeda, demand Rs. 31,000 → munafa taqreeban 3% → yahan dikhega.

missing_cost.title: Khareed qeemat nahi
missing_cost.body: Stock ka woh phone jis ki khareed qeemat save nahi, is liye us ka munafa nahi nikal sakta.
missing_cost.example: Purane stock ka Redmi Note 12 baghair khareed qeemat ke dala → us ka munafa ghalat dikhega; cost dalein.

missing_asking.title: Demand ki qeemat nahi
missing_asking.body: Stock ka woh phone jis ki bechne ki (demand) qeemat nahi likhi, is liye staff ko pata nahi kya maangein.
missing_asking.example: Tecno Spark 20 khareeda magar demand ki qeemat nahi likhi → maslan Rs. 32,000 likh dein.

verification_pending.title: ID check baqi
verification_pending.body: Stock ka used phone jis ke bechne wale ka ID check abhi poora nahi hua.
verification_pending.example: Ek walk-in bechne wale se used Samsung A32 khareeda, CNIC ki photo save nahi → 1 baqi.

verification_flagged.title: ID check mashkook
verification_flagged.body: Woh phone jis ke ID check par mashkook ka nishan laga (maslan IMEI ya bechne wala theek nahi laga). Clear hone tak na bechein.
verification_flagged.example: Dabbe ka IMEI phone se nahi mila, staff ne mashkook lagaya → 1 mashkook; bechne se pehle check karein.

repeat_returns.title: Aik se zyada baar wapis aaya
repeat_returns.body: Stock ka woh phone jo gahak do ya zyada baar wapis kar chuke. Is mein chhupa nuqs ho sakta hai.
repeat_returns.example: Ek hi Infinix Note 30 do baar bika aur wapis aaya → yahan dikhega; achhi tarah check karein.

inPeriod.title: Is muddat mein
inPeriod.body: Sirf chune hue dinon mein kya hua: khareeda maal, kharche, aane wala aur jane wala paisa. "Pehle" is se theek pehle ke utne hi din hain.
inPeriod.example: Muddat "Yeh mahina" (1–30 Nov): aaya paisa Rs. 9,00,000; pehle (1–31 Oct) Rs. 7,50,000.

purchases.title: Khareeda maal
purchases.body: Is muddat ke khareed ke billon ka kul, supplier ko wapis kiya maal nikal kar. Neeche: kitne bill aur kitne phone.
purchases.example: 3 billon par 10 phone Rs. 4,00,000 mein khareede, ek Rs. 35,000 ka wapis kiya → Rs. 3,65,000.

expenses.title: Kharche
expenses.body: Is muddat ka kiraya, bijli, tankhwahen, chai aur dukaan ke doosre kharche. Malik jo ghar le gaya woh yahan nahi gina jata.
expenses.example: Kiraya Rs. 40,000 + bill Rs. 12,000 + chai Rs. 3,000 = Rs. 55,000; malik Rs. 30,000 ghar le gaya (shamil nahi).

moneyIn.title: Aaya paisa
moneyIn.body: Is muddat mein galle, bank aur wallet mein aane wala sara paisa: naqd sale, wasool udhaar, repair waghera. Apne hi accounts mein muntaqil kiya paisa nahi gina jata.
moneyIn.example: Counter sale Rs. 3,00,000 + wasool udhaar Rs. 50,000 + repair Rs. 10,000 → Rs. 3,60,000.

moneyOut.title: Gaya paisa
moneyOut.body: Is muddat mein galle, bank aur wallet se jane wala sara paisa: maal ki adaigi, dealer ko adaigi, kharche, wapsiyan. Apne accounts ke beech muntaqli nahi gini jati.
moneyOut.example: Maal ki adaigi Rs. 2,50,000 + dealer ko Rs. 40,000 + kharche Rs. 55,000 → Rs. 3,45,000.

transfers.title: Apne accounts mein muntaqli
transfers.body: Apne ek account se doosre mein dala paisa (galle se bank, bank se Easypaisa). Yeh aamdani ya kharcha nahi, is liye aaya/gaya paisa mein shamil nahi.
transfers.example: Galle se Rs. 1,00,000 bank mein jama karaye → yahan Rs. 1,00,000 dikhega, aaya ya gaya paisa mein nahi.

balances.title: Balance
balances.body: Muddat ke shuru mein (Shuru), aakhir mein (Aakhir) aur aaj (Abhi) aap ke paas kitna tha. Agar "Is din tak" chunein to bara number us din ka balance hai.
balances.example: Cash aur bank: shuru Rs. 2,00,000, aakhir Rs. 2,80,000, abhi Rs. 3,10,000 → muddat mein Rs. 80,000 barha.

cashBank.title: Cash aur bank
cashBank.body: Galle, bank account aur wallet (Easypaisa, JazzCash) ka paisa ikattha. Neeche: har account ka apna balance.
cashBank.example: Galla Rs. 60,000 + Meezan Bank Rs. 1,80,000 + Easypaisa Rs. 40,000 → Rs. 2,80,000.

stock.title: Stock mein phone
stock.body: Stock mein kitne phone, tablet aur ghariyan thin, aur khareed qeemat par (sirf malik / manager) aur demand par un ki maliyat. Accessories is ginti mein nahi.
stock.example: Stock mein 25 phone: khareed Rs. 9,00,000, demand Rs. 10,20,000 → taqreeban Rs. 1,20,000 munafa ruka hua.

receivable.title: Logon ne dena hai
receivable.body: Gahakon aur doosron ka kul udhaar jo unhon ne dukaan ko dena hai, un ke khaton se (len-den samet). Neeche: muddat mein kitna wasool hua aur kitne log.
receivable.example: Ali ne Rs. 30,000, Bilal ne Rs. 15,000, Kamran ne Rs. 5,000 dene hain → 3 logon se Rs. 50,000.

payable.title: Hum ne logon ko dena hai
payable.body: Dukaan ne dealeron, supplieron aur doosron ko kul kitna dena hai, un ke khaton se (len-den samet). Neeche: muddat mein kitna diya aur kitne logon ko.
payable.example: Hall Road dealer ke Rs. 1,20,000 aur ek supplier ke Rs. 30,000 baqi → 2 logon ke Rs. 1,50,000.

moneyByKind.title: Account ki qism ke hisaab se paisa
moneyByKind.body: Yeh daira muddat ke aakhir (ya chune din) ka cash aur bank balance qism ke hisaab se baant'ta hai: cash, bank, Easypaisa, JazzCash waghera.
moneyByKind.example: Cash Rs. 60,000, bank Rs. 1,80,000, Easypaisa Rs. 40,000 → daire ka sab se bara hissa bank.

checks.title: Hisaab durust hai
checks.body: App apna hisaab khud check karti hai: cash shuru + aaya − gaya = aakhir, har entry barabar, har khata ledger se milta hai, stock shuru + aaya − gaya = aakhir, adaigi bill se zyada nahi. Green tick matlab sab theek; red cross ho to support ko batayen.
checks.example: Cash: shuru Rs. 2,00,000 + aaya Rs. 3,60,000 − gaya Rs. 2,80,000 = aakhir Rs. 2,80,000 → green tick.

limitations.title: Kya nahi dikhta aur kyun
limitations.body: Kuch cheezein app mein darj nahi hotin, is liye audit unhein nahi dikha sakta: aksar billon ki wapsi ki tareekh (is liye udhaar ki umar bill ki tareekh se gini jati hai), khareed par tax, aur bahar se aayi raqam ki fee.
limitations.example: 1 October ka bill jis par wade ki tareekh nahi, 31 October ko "30 din purana" dikhega, "late" nahi.

pnl.title: Nafa nuqsan
pnl.body: Muddat ki sale line ba line asal munafa kaise banti hai: sale, discount, wapsi, khareed qeemat, kharche, doosri aamdani. Bracket wala number pichli muddat ka hai.
pnl.example: Net sale Rs. 5,00,000 (4,50,000) → is muddat mein pichli se Rs. 50,000 zyada becha.

cash.title: Cash aur bank
cash.body: Muddat mein paisa kahan se aaya aur kahan gaya, galle, har bank aur har wallet ke liye, shuru se aakhir tak.
cash.example: Shuru Rs. 2,00,000 + aaya Rs. 3,60,000 − gaya Rs. 2,80,000 → aakhir Rs. 2,80,000.

expenses.title: Kharche
expenses.body: Muddat ke dukaan ke kharche qism ke hisaab se, sab se bare kharche, aur kis ne kis account se kharch kiya. Malik ka ghar le jaya paisa alag dikhta hai.
expenses.example: Kiraya Rs. 40,000, tankhwahen Rs. 60,000, bill Rs. 12,000 → kharche Rs. 1,12,000.

tax.title: Tax
tax.body: Muddat ke sale billon par lagaya gaya sales tax, FBR mein registered dukaan ke liye. Yeh hukumat ka paisa hai, dukaan ka nahi.
tax.example: 18% tax wale 2 bill: Rs. 1,00,000 + Rs. 18,000 tax → jama tax Rs. 18,000.

series.title: Din / hafta / mahine ka munafa
series.body: Har danda ek din (lambi muddat mein hafta ya mahina) ka asal munafa hai. Jo staff khareed qeemat nahi dekh sakta use net sale dikhti hai.
series.example: 1, 2, 3 Nov ke dande: Rs. 8,000, Rs. 12,000, Rs. 3,000 → 2 tareekh sab se achha din.

salesVsProfit.title: Net sale aur asal munafa
salesVsProfit.body: Muddat par do lakeeren: kitna becha (green) aur khareed o kharchon ke baad asal kitna kamaya (dark). Farq bara hona aam hai; dark lakeer gire to dekhein.
salesVsProfit.example: Hafta 1: sale Rs. 1,50,000, munafa Rs. 15,000; hafta 2: sale Rs. 1,60,000, munafa Rs. 5,000 → zyada becha magar kam kamaya.

grossSales.title: Discount se pehle sale
grossSales.body: Discount aur gahak ki wapsi se pehle sale billon ka kul.
grossSales.example: iPhone 13 Rs. 1,60,000 aur Samsung A15 Rs. 40,000 mein becha → Rs. 2,00,000.

discounts.title: Diya gaya discount
discounts.body: Muddat mein sale billon par qeemat se kam ki gayi raqam. Yeh sale aur munafa dono kam karti hai.
discounts.example: Samsung A15 ki demand Rs. 42,000, Rs. 40,000 mein becha → Rs. 2,000 discount.

salesReturns.title: Gahakon ki wapsi
salesReturns.body: Muddat mein gahakon ki wapis lai cheezon ki maliyat. Yeh sale se nikalti hai; phone wapis stock mein aa jata hai.
salesReturns.example: Gahak ne Rs. 35,000 mein bika Infinix Hot 40 wapis kiya → yahan Rs. 35,000.

cogs.title: Bike maal ki khareed qeemat
cogs.body: Muddat mein biki cheezon ke liye dukaan ne jo qeemat di thi (wapsi par yeh cost wapis aa jati hai). Sirf malik aur manager dekhte hain.
cogs.example: Rs. 34,000 mein khareeda Samsung A15, Rs. 40,000 mein becha → yahan Rs. 34,000.

grossProfit.title: Sale par munafa
grossProfit.body: Net sale mein se bike maal ki khareed qeemat, kiraya aur doosre kharchon se pehle.
grossProfit.example: Net sale Rs. 5,00,000 − khareed Rs. 4,20,000 → Rs. 80,000.

opExpenses.title: Kharche
opExpenses.body: Muddat ke dukaan chalane ke kharche (kiraya, bill, tankhwah, chai). Malik ka nikala paisa shamil nahi.
opExpenses.example: Kiraya Rs. 40,000 + bijli Rs. 12,000 + tankhwah Rs. 25,000 → Rs. 77,000.

operatingProfit.title: Kharchon ke baad munafa
operatingProfit.body: Sale ka munafa mein se kharche, repair aur doosri aamdani jama karne se pehle.
operatingProfit.example: Sale ka munafa Rs. 80,000 − kharche Rs. 77,000 → Rs. 3,000.

otherIncome.title: Repair aur doosri aamdani
otherIncome.body: Bechne ke ilawa kamai: repair ka kaam aur doosri aamdani, jaise gahak ke phone wapis karne par dukaan ka rakha hissa.
otherIncome.example: Repair Rs. 8,000 + wapsi par rakhe Rs. 2,000 → Rs. 10,000.

taxCollected.title: Jama kiya tax
taxCollected.body: Muddat ke sale billon par laga sales tax. Yeh hukumat ka paisa hai, is liye sale ya munafa mein nahi.
taxCollected.example: Rs. 1,18,000 ka bill, 18% tax → Rs. 18,000 tax, sale Rs. 1,00,000.

ownerTook.title: Malik ne nikala
ownerTook.body: Malik ne apne liye dukaan se jo paisa liya. Cash kam hota hai magar yeh dukaan ka kharcha nahi, is liye munafa wohi rehta hai.
ownerTook.example: Malik ghar ke liye Rs. 30,000 le gaya → cash Rs. 30,000 kam, munafa wohi.

cashOpening.title: Shuru
cashOpening.body: Muddat ke pehle din ke shuru mein aap ke sab accounts (galla, bank, wallet) ka paisa ikattha.
cashOpening.example: 1 Nov subah: galla Rs. 50,000 + bank Rs. 1,50,000 → shuru Rs. 2,00,000.

cashIn.title: Aaya paisa
cashIn.body: Muddat mein aap ke accounts mein aaya sab kuch, wajah ke hisaab se. Is tab par apne doosre account se muntaqil kiya paisa bhi shamil hai.
cashIn.example: Sale Rs. 3,00,000 + wasool udhaar Rs. 50,000 + galle se bank Rs. 20,000 → Rs. 3,70,000.

cashOut.title: Gaya paisa
cashOut.body: Muddat mein aap ke accounts se gaya sab kuch, wajah ke hisaab se. Is tab par apne doosre account mein muntaqil kiya paisa bhi shamil hai.
cashOut.example: Maal Rs. 2,00,000 + kharche Rs. 60,000 + galle se bank Rs. 20,000 → Rs. 2,80,000.

cashClosing.title: Aakhir
cashClosing.body: Muddat ke aakhir (ya chune din) par sab accounts ka paisa. Neeche "Abhi" aaj ka balance hai.
cashClosing.example: Shuru Rs. 2,00,000 + aaya Rs. 3,70,000 − gaya Rs. 2,80,000 → aakhir Rs. 2,90,000.

cameIn.title: Paisa kahan se aaya
cameIn.body: Aaya paisa wajah ke hisaab se bata hua. Patti har wajah ka kul mein hissa dikhati hai.
cameIn.example: Rs. 3,50,000 mein sale Rs. 3,00,000 aur wasool udhaar Rs. 50,000 → sale ki patti lambi.

wentOut.title: Paisa kahan gaya
wentOut.body: Gaya paisa wajah ke hisaab se bata hua. Patti har wajah ka kul mein hissa dikhati hai.
wentOut.example: Rs. 2,80,000 mein maal Rs. 2,00,000, kharche Rs. 60,000, wapsi Rs. 20,000 → maal ki patti lambi.

sales_now.title: Counter par wasool sale
sales_now.body: Sale ke bill par hi mila paisa (cash, bank, wallet), exchange ka cash hissa bhi. Baad mein mila udhaar yahan nahi.
sales_now.example: Rs. 50,000 ka phone becha, gahak ne abhi Rs. 30,000 diye → yahan Rs. 30,000, Rs. 20,000 udhaar mein.

udhaar_received.title: Wasool udhaar
udhaar_received.body: Logon ne baad mein apne khate (purane billon) mein jo adaigi ki.
udhaar_received.example: Ali ne purane udhaar ke Rs. 20,000 Easypaisa par diye → yahan Rs. 20,000.

borrowed.title: Len-den liya
borrowed.body: Dukaan ne kisi se baghair bill jo paisa udhaar liya.
borrowed.example: Maal khareedne ke liye dost ki dukaan se Rs. 50,000 liye → yahan Rs. 50,000.

repairs.title: Repair
repairs.body: Repair ke kaam ka mila paisa: advance aur aakhri bill.
repairs.example: Screen badli: Rs. 1,000 advance + delivery par Rs. 3,500 → Rs. 4,500.

refund_from_supplier.title: Supplier se wapsi
refund_from_supplier.body: Maal wapis karne par supplier ne jo paisa lautaya.
refund_from_supplier.example: Kharab Vivo Y20 dealer ko wapis kiya, us ne Rs. 30,000 lautaye → yahan Rs. 30,000.

transfer_in.title: Apne account se aaya
transfer_in.body: Aap ke apne kisi doosre account se aaya paisa. Aamdani nahi.
transfer_in.example: Galle se Rs. 1,00,000 bank mein dale → bank mein yahan Rs. 1,00,000.

opening.title: Opening
opening.body: App mein account banate waqt likha gaya shuru ka balance.
opening.example: App shuru ki to galle mein Rs. 25,000 the → opening Rs. 25,000.

other_in.title: Doosra aaya
other_in.body: Aaya paisa jo upar ki kisi wajah mein nahi aata.
other_in.example: Baghair qism ke Rs. 500 ki entry → doosra aaya mein.

stock_now.title: Khareed par ada maal
stock_now.body: Maal khareedte waqt khareed ke bill par hi diya paisa. Baad mein dene wala yahan nahi.
stock_now.example: 5 phone Rs. 2,00,000 mein khareede, abhi Rs. 1,50,000 diye → yahan Rs. 1,50,000, Rs. 50,000 baqi.

paid_to_people.title: Logon ko adaigi (udhaar)
paid_to_people.body: Dealeron aur doosron ko baad mein un ke khate mein di gayi adaigi.
paid_to_people.example: Hall Road dealer ko purane balance ke Rs. 40,000 diye → yahan Rs. 40,000.

lent.title: Len-den diya
lent.body: Dukaan ne kisi ko baghair bill jo paisa udhaar diya.
lent.example: Sath wale dukandar ko Rs. 10,000 diye → yahan Rs. 10,000.

expenses.title: Kharche
expenses.body: Is paise se diye gaye kharche: kiraya, bill, tankhwah, aur malik ka nikala paisa.
expenses.example: Bank se Rs. 40,000 kiraya diya → yahan Rs. 40,000.

refunds.title: Gahakon ko wapsi
refunds.body: Wapsi aur exchange par gahakon ko lautaya paisa.
refunds.example: Gahak ne Samsung A15 wapis kiya, aap ne Rs. 36,000 lautaye → yahan Rs. 36,000.

repair_parts.title: Repair ke purze
repair_parts.body: Repair ke kaam ke liye purzon ya bahar ke kaam par kharch kiya paisa.
repair_parts.example: Gahak ki repair ke liye Rs. 2,500 ki screen khareedi → yahan Rs. 2,500.

fees.title: Software fee
fees.body: Is app ki di gayi fee.
fees.example: App ki mahana fee Rs. 2,000 di → yahan Rs. 2,000.

transfer_out.title: Apne account mein gaya
transfer_out.body: Aap ke apne kisi doosre account mein bheja paisa. Kharcha nahi.
transfer_out.example: Galle se Rs. 1,00,000 bank mein dale → galle mein yahan Rs. 1,00,000.

other_out.title: Doosra gaya
other_out.body: Gaya paisa jo upar ki kisi wajah mein nahi aata.
other_out.example: Baghair qism ke Rs. 300 ki entry → doosra gaya mein.

reversal.title: Ulta entry
reversal.body: Mansookh entry: bill ya adaigi mansookh ho to app ulti entry karti hai. Yeh usi wajah ke naam se dikhti hai jise yeh khatam karti hai.
reversal.example: Rs. 5,000 ka kharcha ghalti se dala aur mansookh kiya → aaya paisa mein "Ulta: kharche Rs. 5,000".

perAccount.title: Har account
perAccount.body: Har account alag: shuru + aaya − gaya = aakhir, apne accounts ke beech muntaqil hissa, aur wajohat chhoti chips mein.

channels.title: Zariye ke hisaab se
channels.body: Aaya aur gaya paisa account ki qism ke hisaab se: cash, bank, Easypaisa, JazzCash, cheque, bahar se. Apni muntaqli shamil nahi.

channelsIn.title: Zariye ke hisaab se aaya paisa
channelsIn.body: Daira dikhata hai muddat mein paisa kaise aaya: kitna cash, bank, Easypaisa waghera mein. Dabayen to accounts khulenge.
channelsIn.example: Aaya Rs. 4,00,000: cash Rs. 2,50,000, bank Rs. 70,000, Easypaisa Rs. 80,000 → zyada tar cash.

paymentsByMethod.title: Khate ki adaigiyan tareeqe ke hisaab se
paymentsByMethod.body: Sirf alag adaigiyan (wasool ya diya udhaar, len-den) un par likhe tareeqe ke hisaab se, aur kitni adaigiyan.
paymentsByMethod.example: Easypaisa +30,000 / −0 (4) → 4 gahakon ne Easypaisa par Rs. 30,000 udhaar diya.

international.title: Bahar se raqam
international.body: Doosre mulk se bheji raqam (Western Union, bank waghera): foreign raqam, rate aur rupay, currency aur adaigi ke hisaab se.
international.example: Gahak ke bhai ne 200 SAR bheje, rate 74 → bill mein Rs. 14,800 gine gaye.

expTotal.title: Kharche
expTotal.body: Muddat ke dukaan ke sab kharche, kitni entries aur pichli muddat ke sath. Malik ka nikala paisa alag dikhta hai, is kul mein nahi.

expSeries.title: Din / hafta / mahine ke kharche
expSeries.body: Har danda ek din (lambi muddat mein hafta ya mahina) ke kharche hain.
expSeries.example: Mahine ki 1 tareekh: kiraya Rs. 40,000 → ooncha danda; baqi din Rs. 1,000–3,000.

expCats.title: Qism ke hisaab se kharche
expCats.body: Har qism ka kul, kitni entries, hisse ki patti aur pichli muddat. Dabayen to kharche khulenge.
expCats.example: Tankhwahen (2) Rs. 1,12,000 mein se Rs. 60,000 → taqreeban aadhi patti; pehle Rs. 55,000.

largest.title: Sab se bare kharche
largest.body: Muddat ke sab se bare akele kharche, tareekh, kis ne dala aur kis account se.
largest.example: 1 Nov ko malik ne Meezan Bank se Rs. 40,000 kiraya diya → sab se upar.

expByWho.title: Kis ne, kahan se kharch kiya
expByWho.body: Kharche dalne wale ke hisaab se aur jis account se diye gaye us ke hisaab se.
expByWho.example: Malik Rs. 80,000 (3), Ahmed Rs. 32,000 (9); galla Rs. 32,000, bank Rs. 80,000.

taxedBills.title: Tax wale bill
taxedBills.body: Muddat ke sale billon mein se kitnon par tax laga.

taxable.title: Tax wali sale
taxable.body: Tax wale billon ka kul, tax ke baghair.
taxable.example: 6 tax wale bill kul Rs. 3,54,000, tax Rs. 54,000 → tax wali sale Rs. 3,00,000.

taxOnBills.title: Jama kiya tax
taxOnBills.body: Muddat ke sale billon par likha tax, wapsi se pehle.
taxOnBills.example: Rs. 3,00,000 par 18% tax wale 6 bill → Rs. 54,000.

taxNet.title: Wapsi ke baad tax
taxNet.body: Jama tax mein se wapsi par lautaya tax. Yeh is muddat ka hukumat ka banta tax hai.
taxNet.example: Jama Rs. 54,000, ek tax wala phone Rs. 9,000 tax ke sath wapis aaya → Rs. 45,000.

taxRows.title: Tax wale billon ki list
taxRows.body: Har tax wala sale bill: gahak, tareekh, tax se pehle raqam, rate, qeemat mein tax shamil tha (incl.) ya upar laga (excl.), aur tax.
taxRows.example: Bill S-120 · 1,00,000 @ 18% excl. → tax Rs. 18,000, gahak ne Rs. 1,18,000 diye.

sales.title: Sale
sales.body: Muddat ka har sale bill: kitne ka bana, kaise ada hua (counter par ya udhaar), kis mulazim ne aur kis gahak ko.
sales.example: 40 bill, Rs. 12,00,000: Rs. 9,00,000 counter par, Rs. 3,00,000 udhaar.

purchases.title: Khareed
purchases.body: Muddat ka har khareed ka bill: kitna maal khareeda, kitna foran diya, kitna abhi dena hai aur kis supplier ko.
purchases.example: 8 bill, 20 phone, Rs. 8,00,000: diye Rs. 6,00,000, dene hain Rs. 2,00,000.

paid.title: Poora ada
paid.body: Woh bill jin par aaj kuch baqi nahi. Card dabayen to sirf yeh bill dikhenge; dobara dabayen to hat jayega.
paid.example: Bill Rs. 45,000, ada Rs. 45,000 → poora ada.

partial.title: Kuch ada
partial.body: Woh bill jin par kuch paisa mila aur kuch aaj bhi baqi hai. "Baqi" bachi raqam hai.
partial.example: Bill Rs. 60,000, ada Rs. 40,000 → kuch ada, baqi Rs. 20,000.

unpaid.title: Ada nahi
unpaid.body: Woh bill jin par abhi kuch nahi mila; poori raqam udhaar hai.
unpaid.example: Infinix Hot 40 ka Rs. 35,000 ka bill, kuch nahi mila → ada nahi, baqi Rs. 35,000.

returned.title: Wapis
returned.body: Woh sale bill jin ka sara maal gahak wapis le aaya.
returned.example: Samsung A15 becha, gahak agle din wapis le aaya → bill wapis.

userFilter.title: Mulazim ke hisaab se
userFilter.body: Kisi naam ko dabayen to sirf us mulazim ke bill aur numbers dikhenge; "Sab" phir sab dikhata hai.
userFilter.example: "Ahmed" dabayen → sirf Ahmed ke 12 bill, Rs. 3,50,000.

billed.title: Bill ki raqam
billed.body: Muddat ke sale billon ka kul, jaisa bill par likha (discount ke baad, tax samet). Neeche: bill, biki cheezein aur un ka munafa. % pichli muddat se muqabla hai.

atCounter.title: Counter par ada
atCounter.body: Bechte waqt billon par mila paisa (cash, bank, wallet). Neeche: kitne bill counter par poore ada hue.
atCounter.example: Rs. 50,000 ka bill, gahak ne mauqe par Rs. 30,000 diye → yahan Rs. 30,000.

onCredit.title: Udhaar par
onCredit.body: Billon ka woh hissa jo bechte waqt ada nahi hua (udhaar). "Baqi" woh hai jo baad ki adaigiyon ke baad aaj bhi rehta hai.
onCredit.example: 10 billon par Rs. 3,00,000 udhaar; gahak baad mein Rs. 1,00,000 de chuke → baqi Rs. 2,00,000.

discounts.title: Discount
discounts.body: Muddat ke sale billon par diya gaya kul discount.
discounts.example: Ek bill par Rs. 1,000 aur doosre par Rs. 2,500 kam kiye → Rs. 3,500.

returned.title: Gahakon ki wapsi
returned.body: Is muddat ke sale billon par wapis aaya maal.
returned.example: Is mahine ke bill ka ek phone Rs. 38,000 ka wapis aaya → Rs. 38,000.

avgBill.title: Ausat bill
avgBill.body: Bill ki kul raqam taqseem billon ki tadaad.
avgBill.example: 40 billon par Rs. 12,00,000 → ausat bill Rs. 30,000.

salesSeries.title: Din / hafta / mahine ki sale
salesSeries.body: Har danda ek din (ya hafta, mahina) ke billon ki raqam hai. Danda dabayen to dikhega kitna udhaar par tha.
salesSeries.example: Hafte ka danda Rs. 2,00,000, udhaar Rs. 50,000 → masroof din, kuch udhaar.

byUser.title: Mulazim ke hisaab se
byUser.body: Muddat mein har mulazim ke bill: kitne, kul raqam, aur sale mein discount, udhaar, wapsi aur munafa bhi. Sale ki line dabayen to usi ke bill dikhenge.
byUser.example: Ahmed: 12 bill, Rs. 3,50,000, discount Rs. 4,000, udhaar Rs. 60,000.

byCustomer.title: Gahak ke hisaab se
byCustomer.body: Muddat mein sab se zyada kis ne khareeda: bill, kul aur un billon par abhi kitna baqi. "Walk-in" baghair naam ki sale hai.
byCustomer.example: Ali Traders: 5 bill, Rs. 2,40,000, baqi Rs. 40,000.

bills.title: Bill
bills.body: Muddat ka har bill jo upar ke filter (halat card, mulazim, talash) se milta hai. Bill dabayen to khul jayega. Ada aur baqi aaj ke numbers hain.
bills.example: "Ada nahi" dabayen aur "Ali" talash karein → sirf Ali ke ghair ada bill, maslan S-118 baqi Rs. 35,000.

bought.title: Khareeda
bought.body: Muddat ke khareed ke billon ka kul, kitne bill, phone aur doosri cheezein. % pichli muddat se muqabla hai.
bought.example: 8 bill, 20 phone, 50 cover → Rs. 8,00,000; pichle mahine se +12%.

paidNow.title: Khareed par ada
paidNow.body: Khareedte waqt khareed ke billon par supplier ko diya paisa.
paidNow.example: Rs. 2,00,000 ka maal khareeda aur mauqe par Rs. 1,50,000 diye → yahan Rs. 1,50,000.

purchaseCredit.title: Udhaar par (khareed)
purchaseCredit.body: Khareed ke billon ka woh hissa jo khareedte waqt nahi diya. "Abhi dena hai" baad ki adaigiyon ke baad aaj ki raqam hai.
purchaseCredit.example: Dealer ka Rs. 50,000 udhaar rakha, baad mein Rs. 20,000 diye → abhi dene hain Rs. 30,000.

returnedToSupplier.title: Supplier ko wapsi
returnedToSupplier.body: Muddat mein supplieron ko kitni baar maal wapis kiya aur us ki maliyat.
returnedToSupplier.example: 2 kharab phone Rs. 60,000 ke wapis bheje → 2 · Rs. 60,000.

purchaseSeries.title: Din / hafta / mahine ki khareed
purchaseSeries.body: Har danda ek din (ya hafta, mahina) ki khareed hai. Danda dabayen to phone ki tadaad dikhegi.
purchaseSeries.example: Peer ka danda Rs. 3,00,000 · 8 phone → bari khareed ka din.

bySupplier.title: Supplier ke hisaab se
bySupplier.body: Muddat mein kis se khareeda: bill, phone, kul aur un billon par abhi kitna dena hai.
bySupplier.example: Hall Road dealer: 4 bill, 12 phone, Rs. 5,00,000, abhi dene Rs. 1,00,000.

udhaar_given.title: Sale par diya udhaar
udhaar_given.body: Muddat ke sale billon ka ghair ada hissa jo gahakon ke khate mein gaya.
udhaar_given.example: Rs. 50,000 mein becha, Rs. 30,000 mile → Rs. 20,000 udhaar diya.

received.title: Logon se wasool
received.body: Muddat mein logon ne apne khate mein jo adaigi ki.
received.example: Teen gahakon ne Rs. 10,000 fi kas diye → Rs. 30,000.

sale_returns.title: Wapsi se kam hua
sale_returns.body: Woh wapsiyan jin se gahak ka udhaar kam hua (paise ki bajaye maal wapis aaya).
sale_returns.example: Gahak ke Rs. 40,000 baqi the, phone wapis kiya → Rs. 40,000 kam, ab kuch nahi dena.

udhaar_taken.title: Khareed par liya udhaar
udhaar_taken.body: Muddat ke khareed ke billon ka ghair ada hissa jo dukaan ne supplieron ko dena hai.
udhaar_taken.example: Rs. 1,00,000 ka khareeda, Rs. 70,000 diye → Rs. 30,000 udhaar liya.

paid.title: Logon ko diya
paid.body: Muddat mein dukaan ne supplieron aur doosron ke khate mein jo adaigi ki.
paid.example: Dealer ko purane balance ke Rs. 25,000 diye → Rs. 25,000.

purchase_returns.title: Supplier ko wapsi
purchase_returns.body: Supplier ko wapis kiya maal jis se dukaan ka udhaar kam hua.
purchase_returns.example: Dealer ke Rs. 60,000 dene the, Rs. 30,000 ka phone wapis kiya → ab Rs. 30,000 dene hain.

lent.title: Len-den diya
lent.body: Muddat mein baghair bill logon ko diya paisa. Yeh un ke khate mein jata hai.

borrowed.title: Len-den liya
borrowed.body: Muddat mein baghair bill logon se liya paisa. Dukaan ne yeh wapis karna hai.

repairs.title: Repair ke bill
repairs.body: Muddat mein repair ki woh raqam jo gahak ke khate mein baqi rahi.
repairs.example: Repair ka bill Rs. 4,000, gahak ne Rs. 1,000 diye → Rs. 3,000.

other.title: Doosra / opening
other.body: Khate ki doosri tabdeeliyan, zyada tar kisi shakhs ko dalte waqt likha purana balance.
other.example: Purana gahak dala jis ke pehle se Rs. 12,000 baqi the → Rs. 12,000.

ofLending.title: Jis mein len-den
ofLending.body: Upar ke udhaar ka woh hissa jo len-den hai (baghair bill diya ya liya paisa). Yeh kul ke andar hai, alag nahi. Dabayen to len-den khulega.
ofLending.example: Logon ne Rs. 1,00,000 dene, jis mein len-den Rs. 20,000 → Rs. 80,000 billon ka.

movement.title: Is muddat mein udhaar
movement.body: Muddat mein khate kaise badle: diya aur wasool udhaar, wapsi, len-den, repair aur opening balance.
movement.example: Diya Rs. 2,00,000, wasool Rs. 1,50,000 → shuru se Rs. 50,000 zyada baqi.

overdue.title: Late
overdue.body: Sirf wade ki tareekh wale bill late ho sakte hain. Dande dikhate hain tareekh se kitne din upar aur kitni raqam. "Abhi waqt hai" aur "Wade ki tareekh nahi" alag dikhte hain.
overdue.example: Bill ki tareekh 1 Nov, aaj 20 Nov, Rs. 25,000 baqi → 8-30 din wale dande mein.

age.title: Udhaar ki umar
age.body: Har shakhs ka udhaar kitna purana hai, us ke sab se purane ghair ada bill se: 0-7, 8-30, 31-60, 61+ din. Purana udhaar wasool karna mushkil hota hai.
age.example: Bilal ka sab se purana ghair ada bill 70 din pehle ka, Rs. 15,000 → 61+ wale dande mein.

owesUs.title: Jinhon ne humein dena hai
owesUs.body: Har woh shakhs jis ne dukaan ko dena hai, bare se shuru: sab se purane bill se din (ya late din), aur aakhri baar kab diya. Dabayen to khata khulega.
owesUs.example: Ali · 45 din · aakhri adaigi 2 Nov → Rs. 30,000.

weOwe.title: Jinhein hum ne dena hai
weOwe.body: Har woh shakhs jise dukaan ne dena hai, bare se shuru, sab se purane ghair ada bill ki umar aur aakhri adaigi ke sath.
weOwe.example: Hall Road dealer · 20 din · aakhri adaigi 25 Oct → Rs. 1,20,000.

phones.title: Ghair ada billon ke phone
phones.body: Woh phone jo aise billon par bike ya khareede jo poore ada nahi hue, bill, us ki umar aur us bill par baqi raqam ke sath. Kai phone wale bill par har phone ke sath bill ki baqi raqam dikhti hai.
phones.example: Ali ko bill S-110 par iPhone 13 becha, 25 din pehle, bill par Rs. 40,000 baqi → unhon ne 40,000 dene.

plans.title: Qistein
plans.body: "Logon ne dena hai" ka woh hissa jo qiston ke plan par hai. Yeh upar ke udhaar ke andar hai, alag nahi.
plans.example: Logon ne Rs. 2,00,000 dene, jis mein Rs. 80,000 qiston ke 4 plan par.

plansOpen.title: Chalte plan
plansOpen.body: Qiston ke woh plan jo abhi chal rahe hain.

plansLeft.title: Abhi aana hai
plansLeft.body: Sab chalte planon par abhi milne wala paisa.
plansLeft.example: 4 plan, har ek par Rs. 20,000 baqi → Rs. 80,000.

plansLate.title: Late plan
plansLate.body: Woh plan jin ki kam az kam ek mahana qist tareekh se late hai.
plansLate.example: Ali ki 5 Nov ki qist nahi aayi → 1 late plan.

plansLateAmount.title: Late raqam
plansLateAmount.body: Tareekh guzri mahana qiston ka kul.
plansLateAmount.example: Rs. 5,000 ki do qistein nahi aayin → Rs. 10,000.

what.title: Len-den
what.body: Kisi shakhs ko baghair bill diya ya us se liya paisa (haath udhaar). Yeh us ke ek hi khate mein hai, is liye udhaar ka hissa hai, alag nahi.
what.example: Usman ko Rs. 20,000 diye aur us ka ek bill ka Rs. 10,000 bhi baqi → khate mein Rs. 30,000.

owedToShop.title: Logon ne dena hai (len-den)
owedToShop.body: Len-den ka woh paisa jo logon ne aaj (ya chune din) tak dukaan ko wapis karna hai, aur kitne log.
owedToShop.example: Usman Rs. 20,000 + Kashif Rs. 5,000 → 2 logon se Rs. 25,000.

shopOwes.title: Hum ne dena hai (len-den)
shopOwes.body: Len-den ka woh paisa jo dukaan ne aaj (ya chune din) tak wapis karna hai, aur kitne logon ko.
shopOwes.example: Dealer se Rs. 50,000 liye, Rs. 20,000 lautaye → 1 shakhs ko Rs. 30,000.

lent.title: Muddat mein diya
lent.body: Muddat mein dukaan ne jo len-den diya, entries ki tadaad aur pichli muddat ke sath.

borrowed.title: Muddat mein liya
borrowed.body: Muddat mein dukaan ne jo len-den liya, entries ki tadaad aur pichli muddat ke sath.

adjusted.title: Billon mein adjust
adjusted.body: Len-den ka woh paisa jo baad mein us shakhs ke billon mein barabar ho gaya, is liye ab khula len-den nahi. Yeh ab tak ki sab entries ginta hai, sirf is muddat ki nahi.
adjusted.example: Kashif ko Rs. 10,000 diye, phir use phone becha aur bill se Rs. 10,000 kaat liye → Rs. 10,000 adjust.

voided.title: Mansookh entries
voided.body: Muddat ki kitni len-den entries mansookh huin. Kuch mitaya nahi jata; mansookh entry history mein rehti hai.
voided.example: Rs. 5,000 ki entry do baar ho gayi, ek mansookh ki → 1.

series.title: Diya aur liya
series.body: Har danda ek din (ya hafta, mahina) mein diya aur liya len-den ikattha hai. Danda dabayen to har hissa dikhega.
series.example: 10 Nov ka danda Rs. 60,000: diya Rs. 10,000 · liya Rs. 50,000.

byMethod.title: Kaise gaya aaya
byMethod.body: Muddat mein diya aur liya len-den, paisa kaise gaya: cash, bank, Easypaisa waghera.
byMethod.example: Cash: diya Rs. 10,000 · liya 0; Easypaisa: diya Rs. 25,000 · liya Rs. 50,000.

due.title: Wapsi ki tareekhen
due.body: Wapsi ki tareekh wala len-den, late pehle: Late, Aaj, 3 din mein, Baad mein. Diye paise par us shakhs ko yaad dilayen; liye paise par dukaan ne dena hai.
due.example: Usman · unhon ne dena hai · 10 Nov · 5 din late → Rs. 20,000; WhatsApp par yaad dilayen.

people.title: Shakhs ke hisaab se len-den
people.body: Har shakhs ka len-den: muddat mein diya aur liya, us ka poora khata, aur right side par aaj ka khula len-den (unhon ne dena / hum ne dena / barabar).
people.example: Usman: diya 20,000 · liya 0 · khata 30,000 → unhon ne 20,000 dene.

entries.title: Entries
entries.body: Muddat ki har len-den entry: number, tareekh, kis ne dali aur note. Minus diya paisa, plus liya paisa.
entries.example: L-12 · 10 Nov · Ahmed · "dukaan ke kiraye ke liye" → −10,000 (diya).

full.title: Mukammal dukaan audit report
full.body: Chuni muddat ki ek report: jo hisse chahiyen un par nishan lagayen, khulasa ya tafseel chunein, phir print / PDF ya Excel (har hisse ki alag sheet). Numbers wohi hain jo screen par hain.
full.example: "Pichla mahina" ke liye khulasa, nafa nuqsan aur udhaar chunein → accountant ke liye 3 hisson wali PDF.

summary.title: Khulasa
summary.body: Aham numbers ek safhe par: net sale, munafa, kharche, cash aur bank, udhaar, stock, aur jo darj nahi.
summary.example: Net sale Rs. 12,00,000 · munafa Rs. 1,10,000 · cash Rs. 2,90,000 · logon ne Rs. 1,00,000 dene.

insights.title: Karobar ki aham baatein
insights.body: Aap ke numbers se app ki nikali chhoti saada baatein, achha, dhyan ya maloomat ke nishan ke sath. Kuch andaze se nahi.
insights.example: "Sale pichle mahine se 12% zyada" (achha) · "5 phone 90 din se purane" (dhyan).

sales.title: Sale
sales.body: Muddat ke sale bill: bill ki raqam, counter par, udhaar par, mulazim ke hisaab se, aur tafseel mein har bill.

purchases.title: Khareed
purchases.body: Muddat ke khareed ke bill: khareeda, khareed par ada, abhi dena, supplier ke hisaab se.
purchases.example: 8 bill, Rs. 8,00,000; Hall Road dealer Rs. 5,00,000, dene Rs. 1,00,000.

pnl.title: Nafa nuqsan
pnl.body: Sale se asal munafe tak line ba line, pichli muddat aur din / hafta / mahine ke sath.
pnl.example: Net sale Rs. 5,00,000 − cost Rs. 4,20,000 − kharche Rs. 45,000 + doosri Rs. 10,000 = Rs. 45,000.

cash.title: Cash aur bank
cash.body: Har account ka shuru, aaya, gaya aur aakhir, wajah ke hisaab se aaya gaya paisa, aur bahar ki raqam.

expenses.title: Kharche
expenses.body: Qism ke hisaab se kharche pichli muddat ke sath, aur tafseel mein sab se bare.

tax.title: Tax
tax.body: Tax wale bill, tax wali sale, jama tax aur wapsi ke baad tax; tafseel mein har tax wala bill.
tax.example: 6 bill, tax wali sale Rs. 3,00,000, tax Rs. 54,000.

customers.title: Bare gahak
customers.body: Gahak sale aur munafe ke hisaab se tarteeb mein, aur dukaan ke sab se bare lene wale.

suppliers.title: Bare supplier
suppliers.body: Sirf malik / manager: supplier un se khareed aur un ke phone par munafe ke hisaab se tarteeb mein, aur dukaan ke sab se bare dene.
suppliers.example: 1. Hall Road dealer se Rs. 5,00,000 ki khareed; us ke phone par munafa Rs. 45,000.

udhaar.title: Udhaar
udhaar.body: Logon ne dena aur hum ne dena: shuru, aakhir, muddat mein harkat, udhaar ki umar aur log.
udhaar.example: Aakhir mein logon ne Rs. 1,00,000 dene; Bilal Rs. 15,000, 70 din se.

lending.title: Len-den
lending.body: Baghair bill diya aur liya paisa: khuli raqam, muddat ki entries, log aur wapsi ki tareekhen.
lending.example: Diya Rs. 35,000, liya Rs. 50,000; Usman ke Rs. 20,000, 5 din late.

inventory.title: Stock ki maliyat
inventory.body: Us din stock ke phone, khareed aur demand par maliyat, mutawaqqa munafa, aur halat, PTA aur ID check ke hisaab se ginti.
inventory.example: 25 phone, khareed Rs. 9,00,000, demand Rs. 10,20,000, munafa Rs. 1,20,000.

ageing.title: Stock ki umar
ageing.body: Phone kitne arse se stock mein hain (taza, normal, aahista, dhyan, dead) aur stock alert.
ageing.example: 3 phone dead (90 din se zyada), maliyat Rs. 1,05,000.

products.title: Model ki karkardagi
products.body: Har model: kitne bike, hissa, ausat qeemat, bikne ke din, wapsi, stock mein, aur top / darmiyana / kam.
products.example: Samsung A15: 12 bike, 25%, ausat Rs. 40,000, 8 din → top.

invoices.title: Billon ke numbers
invoices.body: Har qism ke kitne kaghaz (sale, khareed, adaigi, wapsi), un ki raqam, kitne mansookh, aur mulazim ke hisaab se.

verification.title: ID check
verification.body: Muddat mein save checks aur chhore gaye checks ("Main ise janta hoon"), kis ne aur kyun chhore.
verification.example: 18 checks save; Ahmed ne apni 10 mein se 3 chhore → ghair mamooli.

checks.title: Hisaab ki jaanch
checks.body: App ke apne hisaab ki jaanch (cash, entries, khate, stock, adaigi), dono taraf aur farq.

staff.title: Mulazmeen ka kaam
staff.body: Har mulazim ne muddat mein kya becha, khareeda, wasool kiya aur kharch kiya.
staff.example: Ahmed: 12 sale bill Rs. 3,50,000, wasool Rs. 40,000, kharch Rs. 3,000.

security.title: Hifazat aur dhoka
security.body: Sirf malik: mansookhiyan, demand ya cost se kam sale, qeemat ki tabdeeli, stock adjust, chhore checks, ghalat PIN, mulazim ke hisaab se.
security.example: Ahmed ki cost se kam 2 sale, 1 mansookhi → dekhne wali baat.

repairs.title: Repair aur labs
repairs.body: Aaye aur wapas diye phone, repair ki aamdani, parts, lab charges, munafa aur har lab ka record.
repairs.example: Is mahine: 40 aaye, 36 wapas, munafa Rs. 70,000; Zain Lab 90% theek.

mode.title: Khulasa ya tafseel
mode.body: Khulase mein kul aur har list ki upar ki 10 lines. Tafseel mein poori listen (har ek mein 100 tak), jaise har bill.
mode.example: Khulase mein sale: kul aur upar ke 10 gahak; tafseel mein: sab 40 bill bhi.

individual.title: Alag alag reports
individual.body: Akeli reports PDF, Excel ya CSV mein. Jin par "chuni muddat ke liye" likha hai woh upar ki muddat ki hain; khata, log aur stock ki listen aaj ki hain.
individual.example: Pichle mahine ke "Kharche" Excel mein lein, ya aaj dukaan mein maujood maal ki "Stock list".

summary.title: Stock tab
summary.body: Is waqt (ya "As of" mein chune gaye din) dukan mein maujood saare mobile, tablet aur watch: kitne hain, kitne ke khareede, kitne ke bechne hain, aur condition, PTA, ID check, type, brand aur supplier ke hisaab se. Accessories yahan nahi ginti.
summary.example: Stock mein 42 mobile, khareed Rs. 9,50,000, asking Rs. 10,60,000 → sab bikne par taqreeban Rs. 1,10,000 munafa ki umeed.

ageing.title: Stock ki umar tab
ageing.body: Stock ka har mobile kitne din se dukan mein para hai, aap ke apne dinon ke khanon mein, aur woh mobile jin par aaj tawajju chahiye. Yeh hamesha "aaj" ka haal hai, chuni gayi muddat ka nahi.
ageing.example: Samsung A15 1 September ko aaya, aaj 15 October hai → 44 din → khana "Slow" (31 se 60 din).

idChecks.title: ID check tab
idChecks.body: Mobiles ke ID / chori check: stock mein kitne check ho chuke, kitne baqi, kitne mashkook, is muddat mein kitne check save hue, aur har woh check jo "main is bande ko janta hoon" keh kar chhora gaya — kis ne aur kyun.
idChecks.example: Is mahine: 18 check save, 2 mobile abhi baqi, 1 check Bilal ne "purana gahak" likh kar chhora.

inStock.title: Stock mein
inStock.body: Is waqt (ya chune gaye din) dukan mein kitne mobile, tablet aur watch hain. Neeche wali line batati hai ke in mein se kitno ki asking price abhi nahi likhi.
inStock.example: Dukan mein 42 mobile, 3 ki price abhi nahi likhi → "42 · 3 baghair asking price".

atCost.title: Cost par
atCost.body: Stock ke mobile aap ko kitne mein pare: har ek ki khareed qeemat jama kar ke. Yeh sirf owner aur manager ko nazar aata hai.
atCost.example: Samsung A15 Rs. 38,000 + iPhone 13 Rs. 1,45,000 + Infinix Hot 40 Rs. 30,000 → cost par Rs. 2,13,000.

atAsking.title: Asking par
atAsking.body: Agar stock ka har mobile apni asking price par bik jaye to kitne paise aayen: sab ki asking jama. Jis mobile ki price nahi likhi woh kuch nahi jorta.
atAsking.example: Samsung A15 asking Rs. 42,000 + iPhone 13 Rs. 1,60,000 + Infinix Hot 40 Rs. 34,000 → asking par Rs. 2,36,000.

expectedMargin.title: Expected margin
expectedMargin.body: Agar stock asking price par bik jaye to kitna munafa hoga: asking minus cost, sirf un mobiles ka jin ki dono qeematein likhi hain. % cost ke muqable mein hai. Sirf owner aur manager.
expectedMargin.example: Asking Rs. 2,36,000 − cost Rs. 2,13,000 → expected margin Rs. 23,000, yani cost ka 10.8%.

byCondition.title: Condition ke hisaab se stock (chart)
byCondition.body: Stock ke mobile condition ke hisaab se: box pack, open box, used, patched. Kisi hissay par tap karein to woh mobile Stock mein khul jayenge.
byCondition.example: 42 mobile: Used 25, Box pack 12, Open box 4, Patched 1 → "Used" par tap karein to 25 used mobile nazar aayenge.

byVerification.title: ID check ke hisaab se stock (chart)
byVerification.body: Stock ke mobile un ke ID / chori check ke hisaab se: check ho gaya, baqi hai, mashkook, ya check ki zaroorat nahi. Tap karein to stock list khulegi.
byVerification.example: 42 mobile: check ho gaye 30, zaroorat nahi 6, baqi 5, mashkook 1 → woh 1 mashkook mobile nahi bechna.

condition.title: Condition card
condition.body: Har line ek condition hai: kitne mobile · un ki cost (sirf owner aur manager) · un ki asking. Line par tap karein to woh mobile khulenge.
condition.example: "Used 25 · 9,50,000 · 10,60,000" → 25 used mobile, kul cost Rs. 9,50,000, kul asking Rs. 10,60,000.

pta.title: PTA card
pta.body: Stock ke mobile PTA ke hisaab se: approved, non-PTA, JV ya unknown — tadaad · cost · asking. Ek mobile yahan ek baar aur baqi har card mein bhi ek baar aata hai.
pta.example: "Non-PTA 8 · 2,40,000 · 2,72,000" → stock mein 8 non-PTA mobile, asking par Rs. 2,72,000.

verification.title: ID check card
verification.body: Stock ke mobile ID check ke nateeje ke hisaab se — tadaad · cost · asking. Line par tap karein to stock list khulegi.
verification.example: "ID check pending 5 · 1,50,000 · 1,70,000" → Rs. 1,70,000 ke 5 mobile abhi check ke intezar mein.

category.title: Type card
category.body: Stock type ke hisaab se: phone, tablet ya watch — tadaad · cost · asking.
category.example: "Tablet 3 · 1,20,000 · 1,38,000" → stock mein 3 tablet, asking par Rs. 1,38,000.

byBrand.title: Brand ke hisaab se
byBrand.body: Stock mein har brand ke kitne mobile hain (sab se baray 12). Bar par tap karein to us brand ki asking value nazar aayegi.
byBrand.example: Samsung 15, Infinix 10, Apple 6 → Samsung ki bar sab se oonchi; us par Rs. 6,00,000 asking.

bySupplier.title: Supplier ke hisaab se stock
bySupplier.body: Stock mein kis ke mobile pare hain: har mobile aakhri baar jis bande ya dukan se khareeda, tadaad ke saath aur (owner / manager ko) cost. Jo mobile badle mein ya shuru ke stock mein aaye woh "No supplier" mein hain. Naam par tap karein.
bySupplier.example: "Ali Traders 12 phones · cost 4,80,000" → stock ke 12 mobile Hall Road ke Ali Traders se khareede gaye.

statusCounts.title: Har device kahan hai
statusCounts.body: Dukan mein ab tak darj hone wale saare mobile, is hisaab se ke har ek abhi kahan hai: stock mein, bik gaya, loan par, customer ke paas, repair mein, kharab, ya supplier ko wapas.
statusCounts.example: "In stock 42 · Sold 340 · On loan 2 · In repair 1" → 2 mobile doosri dukan ke paas loan par hain.

topCost.title: Sab se mehngay (cost)
topCost.body: Stock ke woh 5 mobile jo sab se mehngay khareede gaye. Aap ka sab se zyada paisa inhi mein phansa hai.
topCost.example: Sab se upar iPhone 13 Pro Rs. 1,95,000 → agar yeh mahino para rahe to Rs. 1,95,000 ruke rahenge.

topAsking.title: Sab se mehngay (asking)
topAsking.body: Stock ke woh 5 mobile jin ki asking price sab se zyada hai.
topAsking.example: Samsung S23 Ultra asking Rs. 2,40,000 sab se upar → aaj aap ki dukan ka sab se mehnga mobile.

topMargin.title: Sab se zyada expected profit
topMargin.body: Stock ke woh 5 mobile jin ki asking aur cost mein sab se zyada farq hai, farq cost ke % ke saath.

lowMargin.title: Sab se kam margin
lowMargin.body: Stock ke woh 5 mobile jin ki asking aur cost mein sab se kam farq hai. Minus ka matlab asking price khareed se bhi kam hai.
lowMargin.example: Samsung A15: cost Rs. 38,000, asking Rs. 38,500 → "500 (1.3%)" — munafa na hone ke barabar; price check karein.

bands.title: Umar ke khane (chart)
bands.body: Stock ke kitne mobile kis umar ke khane mein hain. Umar us din se ginti hai jab mobile is baar dukan mein aaya (khareeda gaya ya customer ne wapas kiya). Bar par cost (owner / manager) ya asking likhi hai. Bar ya chip par tap karein to sirf wohi mobile dikhenge.
bands.example: Default khane: Fresh 15 din tak, Normal 16 se 30, Slow 31 se 60, Attention 61 se 90, Dead 90 se zyada. 70 din pehle khareeda mobile "Attention" mein hai.

fresh.title: Fresh
fresh.body: Haal hi mein aaye mobile — pehli had tak (15 din, agar aap ne nahi badli). Koi fikr nahi.
fresh.example: Infinix Hot 40 6 din pehle khareeda → Fresh.

normal.title: Normal
normal.body: Pehli had se purane, doosri had tak (default 16 se 30 din). Bikne ka aam waqt.
normal.example: Samsung A15 ko dukan mein 22 din → Normal.

slow.title: Slow
slow.body: Doosri had se aagay, teesri had tak (default 31 se 60 din). Aam se aahista bik raha hai; price par sochein ya zyada dikhayein.
slow.example: Oppo A78 ko dukan mein 45 din → Slow.

attention.title: Attention
attention.body: Teesri had se aagay, aakhri had tak (default 61 se 90 din). Paisa phans raha hai; dead stock banne se pehle kuch karein.
attention.example: Vivo Y17s ko dukan mein 75 din → Attention.

dead.title: Dead
dead.body: Aakhri had se bhi purane (default 90 din se zyada). Har ek "Needs attention" mein dead stock ke taur par bhi aata hai.
dead.example: Tecno Spark 10 ko dukan mein 120 din → Dead.

thresholds.title: Thresholds badlein
thresholds.body: Settings khulti hai jahan aap apni hadein rakhte hain: umar ke 4 khanon ke din, "high value" price, thin margin %, top / low product ke usool aur ID check chhorne ke usool.
thresholds.example: Khane 15/30/60/90 se 10/20/40/60 kar dein → 45 din purana mobile Slow se Attention mein chala jayega.

alerts.title: Needs attention
alerts.body: Stock ke woh mobile jin par aaj nazar daalni hai, sab se serious pehle: mashkook check, dead stock, mehnga aur slow, check baqi, cost ya asking nahi, kam margin, ek se zyada baar wapas aaya. Ek mobile do wajah se bhi aa sakta hai. Line par tap karein.
alerts.example: iPhone 13 cost Rs. 1,45,000, dukan mein 40 din → "High value, slow"; agar asking Rs. 1,48,000 hai to "Thin margin" (2.1%) bhi.

deadStock.title: Dead stock
deadStock.body: Mobile aap ki aakhri had (default 90 din) se zyada arsay se dukan mein hai.
deadStock.example: Tecno Spark 10 95 din pehle khareeda → Dead stock. Rs. 28,000 3 mahine se phanse hain.

highValueSlow.title: High value, slow
highValueSlow.body: Mehnga mobile (cost aap ki "high value" had ke barabar ya zyada, default Rs. 50,000) jo Normal khane se aagay (30 din se zyada) hai magar abhi dead nahi.
highValueSlow.example: iPhone 13 cost Rs. 1,45,000, dukan mein 40 din → High value, slow. Utna hi purana Rs. 30,000 wala mobile yahan nahi aayega.

lowMargin.title: Thin margin
lowMargin.body: Asking price cost se bas thori zyada hai: (asking − cost) ÷ cost aap ke thin margin % (default 5%) se neeche hai. Sirf woh mobile jin ki dono qeematein likhi hain.
lowMargin.example: Cost Rs. 40,000, asking Rs. 41,500 → 1,500 ÷ 40,000 = 3.75% → Thin margin.

missingCost.title: No cost
missingCost.body: Is mobile ki khareed qeemat darj nahi, is liye is ka munafa nahi nikal sakta. Aam taur par shuru ka stock jo baghair cost ke dala gaya. Sirf owner aur manager.
missingCost.example: Purana Samsung A12 opening stock mein baghair cost ke dala → Rs. 22,000 mein bike to poore Rs. 22,000 munafa lagenge. Cost dalein.

missingAsking.title: No asking price
missingAsking.body: Mobile par bechne ki price nahi likhi, is liye staff ko pata nahi kitne maangne hain aur yeh "At asking" mein bhi nahi jurta.
missingAsking.example: Infinix Note 30 khareed Rs. 45,000, asking nahi → maslan Rs. 49,500 likhein.

verificationPending.title: ID check pending
verificationPending.body: Used mobile (ya jo kisi bande se khareeda, supplier se nahi) jis ka ID / chori check abhi nahi hua.
verificationPending.example: Kal ek walk-in se Rs. 70,000 mein used iPhone 11 khareeda, check nahi hua → ID check pending.

verificationFlagged.title: ID check flagged
verificationFlagged.body: Check mein masla nikla (maslan IMEI chori mein darj hai ya bechne wale ka ID card match nahi hua). Yeh mobile nahi bechna.
verificationFlagged.example: Samsung S21 khareed Rs. 85,000, check mein chori nikla → flagged; alag rakhein, na bechein.

repeatReturns.title: Ek se zyada baar wapas aaya
repeatReturns.body: Yeh mobile bika aur customer ne 2 ya zyada baar wapas kiya. "×3" ka matlab 3 baar wapas aaya — kharabi check karein.
repeatReturns.example: Oppo A57 bika, wapas aaya, phir bika, phir wapas → "×2".

clear.title: ID checked
clear.body: Woh mobile jin ka ID / chori check saaf aaya. Bara number abhi stock wale hain; "all time" ab tak ke saare mobile ginta hai.
clear.example: Stock 30 · all time 410 → shuru se 410 mobile saaf check hue, in mein 30 abhi dukan mein hain.

pending.title: ID check pending
pending.body: Woh mobile jin ka check abhi baqi hai — used ya kisi bande se khareede hue. Bara number: abhi stock mein; "all time": saare mobile.
pending.example: Stock 5 · all time 7 → dukan ke 5 mobile abhi check hone hain; 2 aur baghair poore check ke bik gaye ya chale gaye.

flagged.title: Chori? Na bechein
flagged.body: Woh mobile jin ke check mein masla nikla. Bara number: abhi stock mein; "all time": ab tak ke saare flagged. Stock mein flagged mobile alag rakhein.
flagged.example: Stock 1 · all time 3 → ek flagged Samsung S21 dukan mein hai; isay na bechein.

notRequired.title: No check needed
notRequired.body: Supplier se khareede gaye box pack mobiles ko ID check ki zaroorat nahi. Bara number: abhi stock mein; "all time": aise saare mobile.
notRequired.example: Distributor se 12 naye box pack Infinix Hot 40 → 12 "No check needed" mein.

checksInPeriod.title: Is muddat mein save hue check
checksInPeriod.body: Chuni gayi tareekhon ke beech kitne ID check save hue, nateeje ke hisaab se: clear, pending ya flagged. Chhora gaya check yahan nahi ginta.
checksInPeriod.example: Is mahine: "ID checked 18 · pending 2 · flagged 1" → 21 check save hue.

bypasses.title: Chhore gaye ID check
bypasses.body: Is muddat mein jab bhi kisi ne check karne ke bajaye "main is bande ko janta hoon" chun kar mobile ko checked kiya. Har bande ki line: chhore · in mein kitne flagged the · us ne kitne mobile khareede · chhore hue khareede gaye ka kitna %. Neeche list mein har chhora hua check: kis ne, kab, kis se, aur wajah.
bypasses.example: Bilal: "4 skipped · 10 intakes · 40%" → is mahine us ne 10 mobile khareede aur 4 ka check chhora.

unusual.title: Unusual (chhore check)
unusual.body: Koi banda "unusual" tab likha jata hai jab us ne kisi flagged mobile ka check chhora ho, ya kam az kam muqarrara tadaad (default 3) aur apne khareede mobiles ke muqarrara % (default 50%) ya zyada ka check chhora ho. Yeh Settings mein badlein.
unusual.example: Bilal ne apne khareede 6 mein se 4 ka check chhora = 67% (4 ≥ 3 aur 67% ≥ 50%) → unusual. Asad ne 20 mein se 2 chhore → nahi.

products.title: Products
products.body: Is muddat mein kya bika, sale ke bills se (cancel bill chhor kar): model, brand ya type ke hisaab se, tadaad, paise, munafa aur Top / Average / Low darja. Accessories sirf "By model" mein apne naam se aati hain.
products.example: By model, is mahine: Samsung A15 ke 12 bike, Infinix Hot 40 ke 8, Tecno Spark 10 ka 1. By brand yehi Samsung 12, Infinix 8, Tecno 1.

unitsSold.title: Units sold
unitsSold.body: Is muddat mein bike hue nag jo wapas nahi hue. "By brand" aur "By type" mein sirf mobile, tablet aur watch ginte hain.
unitsSold.example: 50 mobile aur 30 charger bike, 2 mobile wapas aaye → By model 78 units; By brand 48.

sales.title: Net sales (products)
sales.body: Is muddat mein biki hui bill lines ke paise jo wapas nahi hui, jama kar ke. Cancel bill shamil nahi.
sales.example: 3 mobile Rs. 1,20,000 mein beche, ek wapas aaya (Rs. 40,000) → net sales Rs. 80,000.

profit.title: Sale par munafa
profit.body: Bechne ki qeemat minus cost, is muddat mein biki aur wapas na hone wali lines ka. Sirf owner aur manager.
profit.example: Samsung A15 bika Rs. 42,000, cost Rs. 38,000; Infinix Hot 40 bika Rs. 34,000, cost Rs. 30,000 → munafa Rs. 8,000.

classes.title: Top · average · low
classes.body: Kitni lines (model, brand ya type) kis darje mein hain. Low = low had (default 1 nag) se zyada nahi bika; Top = saare nagon ka kam az kam muqarrara hissa (default 20%); baqi Average.
classes.example: 50 mobile bike: A15 ke 12 (24%) → Top; Spark 10 ka 1 → Low; Hot 40 ke 8 (16%) → Average → "1 · 1 · 1".

soldVsBought.title: Sold vs bought (chart)
soldVsBought.body: Har bar muddat ka ek din, hafta ya mahina hai. Hari bar bike hue nag; neeche peeli bar khareede hue nag (wapas na hone wali purchase lines, accessories samait). Hari bar par tap karein to paise nazar aayen.
soldVsBought.example: Doosra hafta: bike 14, khareede 20 → aap bechne se tez khareed rahe hain; stock barh raha hai.

classFilter.title: Darje se dikhayein
classFilter.body: Sirf ek darje ki lines dikhayein — Top, Average ya Low — ya All.
classFilter.example: "Low" par tap karein → sirf woh model jo 1 nag bike, jaise Tecno Spark 10 ek sale ke saath.

top.title: Top
top.body: Low had se zyada bika aur is muddat ke saare nagon ka kam az kam muqarrara hissa (default 20%).
top.example: Kul 50 nag bike, Samsung A15 ke 12 → 12 ÷ 50 = 24% → Top.

average.title: Average
average.body: Low had se zyada bika magar Top wale hissay se kam.
average.example: Kul 50 nag, Infinix Hot 40 ke 8 → 16%, jo 20% se kam → Average.

low.title: Low
low.body: Is muddat mein low had (default 1 nag) se zyada nahi bika — chahe bohat thori sale mein us ka hissa bara ho.
low.example: Tecno Spark 10 ka 1 bika → Low. Jis haftay sirf 3 sale hon, 1 sale wala model (33%) bhi Low hi hai.

thresholds.title: Class ki hadein
thresholds.body: Darjon ke peeche do hadein, jaisi Settings mein rakhi hain: Top ka % hissa aur Low ke nag. "Change thresholds" Settings kholta hai.
thresholds.example: "Top = 20% ya zyada · Low = 1 unit ya kam" → Low ko 2 kar dein to 2 bikne wale model bhi Low ho jayenge.

rowFigures.title: Har line mein kya hai
rowFigures.body: Bike nag · paise; bar aur "% of units" = saare nagon mein is ka hissa; munafa (aur cost ka %); fi nag average price; bikne ke average din (aane ke din se bikne ke din tak); returned = jo nag wapas aaye; in stock = yehi model abhi dukan mein. Line par tap karein to Stock mein khulegi.
rowFigures.example: "Samsung A15 12 · 5,04,000 · 24% of units · profit 48,000 (10.5%) · avg price 42,000 · avg days to sell 18 · in stock 4".

bills.title: Is muddat ke documents
bills.body: Chuni gayi tareekhon ke beech bane har document: sale bill, purchase bill, li aur di gayi payments, aur wapsiyan. Cancel documents is ginti mein nahi; woh neeche alag list mein hain.
bills.example: 120 sale bill + 15 purchase bill + 40 payments + 5 wapsiyan → 180 documents.

sale.title: Sale bills
sale.body: Is muddat ke sale bill jo cancel nahi hue, un ke total ke saath. "· 2 voided" batata hai kitne cancel hue. Tap karein to list khulegi.
sale.example: 122 bill bane, 2 cancel → 120 dikhega, total Rs. 48,00,000 · 2 voided.

purchase.title: Purchase bills
purchase.body: Is muddat ke purchase bill jo pakke hain (cancel nahi), un ke total ke saath. Sirf owner aur manager.
purchase.example: Hall Road ke suppliers se 15 khareedain, total Rs. 9,80,000.

paymentIn.title: Payments received
paymentIn.body: Is muddat mein alag document ke taur par li gayi payments — maslan customer ka udhaar utarna — bill par counter par diya gaya cash nahi.
paymentIn.example: Ahmed ne apne udhaar mein se Rs. 5,000 Easypaisa se diye → 1 payment received, Rs. 5,000.

paymentOut.title: Payments given
paymentOut.body: Is muddat mein alag document ke taur par ki gayi payments — maslan supplier ko us ka baqaya dena. Raqam owner aur manager dekhte hain.
paymentOut.example: Ali Traders ko bank se Rs. 50,000 diye → 1 payment given, Rs. 50,000.

saleReturn.title: Customers ki wapsi
saleReturn.body: Is muddat mein customers ke wapas laaye maal ke wapsi documents, raqam ke saath.
saleReturn.example: Ek customer ne Rs. 42,000 mein bika Samsung A15 wapas kiya → 1 wapsi, Rs. 42,000.

purchaseReturn.title: Supplier ko wapsi
purchaseReturn.body: Is muddat mein supplier ko wapas bheje maal ke wapsi documents. Raqam owner aur manager dekhte hain.
purchaseReturn.example: Rs. 30,000 mein khareeda kharab Infinix Hot 40 wapas bheja → 1 wapsi, Rs. 30,000.

byStatus.title: Status ke hisaab se sale bill
byStatus.body: Is muddat ke sale bill (cancel wale bhi) aaj ki haalat ke hisaab se: poore paid, kuch paid, kuch paid nahi, wapas ya cancel — tadaad · total · aur udhaar walon ka baqi (total − paid).
byStatus.example: Kuch paid wale 10 bill Rs. 3,00,000 ke, Rs. 2,20,000 mil gaye → "10 · 3,00,000 · due 80,000".

byUser.title: Employee ke hisaab se bill
byUser.body: Har bande ke is muddat mein banaye documents: sale bill aur un ka total, purchase bill, payments, aur us ke banaye kitne documents ab cancel hain.
byUser.example: Bilal: "45 sales · Rs. 18,00,000 · 3 purchases · 12 payments · 2 voided".

voided.title: Cancel documents
voided.body: Is muddat ka har sale bill, purchase bill ya payment jo cancel hui: number, tareekh, kis ne cancel kiya aur wajah. Raqam par lakeer hai kyun ke ab woh nahi ginti. Tap karein to khulega.
voided.example: Sale bill S-0142 Rs. 35,000 Bilal ne cancel kiya, wajah "ghalat IMEI" → mobile stock mein wapas aur naya bill bana.

people.title: Log
people.body: Is muddat ke aap ke customers, suppliers aur doosri dukanein: kitne hain, aur jo paimana aap chunein us par pehle 20. Kisi bande par tap karein to us ka aap ke saath saara len den nazar aayega.
people.example: "Customers by sales" chunein → is mahine Ahmed Rs. 1,30,000 ke saath pehle number par; tap karein to us ke saare bill aur payments.

metric.title: Kis hisaab se tarteeb
metric.body: Chunein ke logon ko kis cheez par tarteeb dena hai. Gehra card sab ka total aur kitne log hain dikhata hai; har line mein us bande ki raqam aur total mein us ka hissa.
metric.example: 85 customers se total Rs. 10,00,000; Ahmed Rs. 1,30,000 → us ka hissa 13%.

customersSales.title: Customers by sales
customersSales.body: Har naam wale customer ke is muddat ke sale bill, wapsi minus kar ke (cancel bill chhor kar). Baghair naam wale walk-in ke bill nahi ginte.
customersSales.example: Ahmed: 3 bill Rs. 1,50,000, Rs. 20,000 ka saman wapas → Rs. 1,30,000.

customersBills.title: Customers by bills
customersBills.body: Har naam wale customer ke is muddat mein kitne sale bill bane (cancel nahi) — kaun sab se zyada baar aata hai.
customersBills.example: Usman ne is mahine 7 baar khareeda, Ahmed ne 3 baar → Usman 7 ke saath pehle.

customersProfit.title: Customers by profit
customersProfit.body: Is muddat mein har customer par kitna munafa hua: us ke rakhe hue maal ki bechne ki qeemat minus cost. Sirf owner aur manager.
customersProfit.example: Ahmed ne iPhone 13 Rs. 1,60,000 mein liya, cost Rs. 1,45,000 → munafa Rs. 15,000.

suppliersPurchases.title: Suppliers by purchases
suppliersPurchases.body: Is muddat mein har supplier se kitna khareeda: us ke purchase bill, usay ki gayi wapsi minus kar ke (cancel bill chhor kar).
suppliersPurchases.example: Ali Traders: bill Rs. 5,00,000, ek mobile Rs. 30,000 wapas → Rs. 4,70,000.

suppliersDevices.title: Suppliers by phones
suppliersDevices.body: Is muddat mein har supplier se kitne mobile, tablet aur watch khareede (wapas kiye hue chhor kar).
suppliersDevices.example: Ali Traders se 20 mobile khareede, 1 wapas kiya → 19.

suppliersProfit.title: Suppliers by profit on their phones
suppliersProfit.body: Is muddat mein bike mobiles ka munafa, us supplier ke hisaab se jis se har mobile khareeda tha — kis ke mobile sab se zyada kamate hain. Sirf owner aur manager.
suppliersProfit.example: Ali Traders ke 3 mobile is mahine bike, munafa Rs. 4,000, 5,500 aur 3,000 → Rs. 12,500.

receivable.title: Hamara sab se zyada lena
receivable.body: Woh log jin ka khata batata hai ke woh aap ke qarzdar hain, muddat ke aakhri din (ya "As of" din) par, sab se bara pehle.
receivable.example: Usman ka khata: bill Rs. 80,000, diye Rs. 55,000 → us par Rs. 25,000 baqi, list mein hai.

payable.title: Hamara sab se zyada dena
payable.body: Woh log jin ka khata batata hai ke aap un ke qarzdar hain, muddat ke aakhri din (ya "As of" din) par, sab se bara pehle.
payable.example: Ali Traders: khareed Rs. 4,70,000, diye Rs. 3,90,000 → aap ne Rs. 80,000 dene hain.

customer.title: Customers
customer.body: Bara number: muddat ke aakhir tak app mein save customers. "new" = is muddat mein dale gaye; "dealt" = jin ka is muddat mein kam az kam ek sale bill bana.
customer.example: "250 · new 18 · dealt 85" → 250 customers darj, 18 is mahine dale, 85 ne is mahine kuch khareeda.

supplier.title: Suppliers
supplier.body: Bara number: muddat ke aakhir tak save suppliers. "new" = is muddat mein dale gaye; "dealt" = jin se is muddat mein khareeda.
supplier.example: "30 · new 2 · dealt 9" → is mahine apne 30 mein se 9 suppliers se khareeda.

shop.title: Doosri dukanein
shop.body: App mein save doosri mobile dukanein (dukanon ke beech loan aur len den ke liye), muddat ke aakhir tak, aur is muddat mein kitni dali gayin.
shop.example: "6 · new 1" → Hall Road ki 6 dukanein darj, 1 is mahine dali.

security.title: Security
security.body: Sirf owner. Is muddat mein jis cheez ne bhi price ya usool mora us ki ek list — price badalna, asking ya cost se kam par bechna, discount, cancel, reversal, stock adjust, opening balance, chhore check, ghalat PIN, admin kaam, paise move — kis ne, kab, pehle → baad, wajah aur kis ne approve kiya. Yahan kuch badla ya mitaya nahi ja sakta.
security.example: "Sold under asking · Samsung A15 · Bilal · 42,000 → 40,000 · −2,000 · approved: Owner".

kinds.title: Record ki qismein
kinds.body: Har chip ek qism ka record hai, is muddat mein kitni baar hua. Chip par tap karein to sirf wohi qism; "All" sab kuch dikhata hai. Sirf woh qismein dikhti hain jo huin.
kinds.example: "All · 37 · Discount · 20 · Voided · 4" → "Voided" par tap karein to 4 cancel documents.

askingChanged.title: Asking changed
askingChanged.body: Kisi ne mobile ki asking price badli. Line mein purani → nayi aur farq.
askingChanged.example: Bilal ne Samsung A15 ki asking 42,000 → 39,000 ki → −3,000.

belowAsking.title: Sold under asking
belowAsking.body: Mobile asking price se kam par bika. Line mein asking → bechne ki qeemat, farq aur kis ne approve kiya.
belowAsking.example: iPhone 13 asking 1,60,000, bika 1,55,000 → −5,000, owner ne PIN se approve kiya.

belowCost.title: Sold under cost
belowCost.body: Mobile cost se kam par bika — nuqsan. Line mein cost → bechne ki qeemat aur nuqsan.

discount.title: Discount
discount.body: Sale bill jis par discount diya gaya. Line mein discount se pehle → baad ka bill, aur discount.

void.title: Voided
void.body: Sale bill, purchase bill ya payment cancel hui. Mukammal bill badla nahi ja sakta; ghalti ho to cancel kar ke naya banta hai.
void.example: Bilal ne bill S-0142 (Rs. 35,000) cancel kiya, wajah "ghalat IMEI".

reversal.title: Reversed
reversal.body: Khate ki koi entry ulti entry se khatam ki gayi, wajah ke saath. Kuch mitaya nahi jata; durusti nayi entry hai.
reversal.example: Ghalat customer ke khate mein gayi Rs. 10,000 ki payment reverse ki gayi, wajah "ghalat banda".

stockAdjust.title: Stock adjusted
stockAdjust.body: Kisi ne accessory ya item ki ginti haath se badli, wajah ke saath.
stockAdjust.example: Charger 20 se 18 kiye, wajah "2 toote mile".

openingBalance.title: Opening balance
openingBalance.body: Kisi bande ke khate mein purana baqaya dala gaya (app se pehle ka lena ya dena).
openingBalance.example: Usman ka opening balance Rs. 15,000 dala → purane register ke Rs. 15,000 us par baqi.

bypass.title: ID check skipped
bypass.body: Asal ID check ke bajaye "main is bande ko janta hoon" se mobile ko checked kiya gaya.
bypass.example: Bilal ne Rs. 25,000 mein used Vivo Y17s khareeda aur check chhora, wajah "parosi".

pinWrong.title: Wrong PIN
pinWrong.body: Price ki approval (maslan asking se kam bechna) ke liye owner ka ghalat PIN dala gaya. Login ki ghaltiyan yahan nahi aatin.
pinWrong.example: Staff ne iPhone 13 asking se kam bechne ke liye 3 baar ghalat PIN dala → 3 lines.

delete.title: Deleted
delete.body: Aap ki list se koi brand ya model ka naam hataya gaya. Sirf wohi naam mit sakta hai jo kisi mobile mein istemal na ho.
delete.example: Ghalti se likha model "Galaxy A0" jo kahin istemal nahi tha, manager ne mitaya.

admin.title: Admin action
admin.body: Account mein koi tabdeeli: admin ne password rakha ya OTP se badla, provider ki support access, nayi branch, ya modules ya plan badla.
admin.example: 3 November ko manager ka password OTP se badla → 1 admin action.

transfer.title: Money moved
transfer.body: Aap ke apne accounts ke beech paise move hue — galla, bank, JazzCash, Easypaisa.
transfer.example: Dukan band karte waqt galle se Meezan Bank mein Rs. 50,000 → 1 line.

byUser.title: Employee ke hisaab se
byUser.body: Har bande ke is muddat mein har qism ke kitne record hain. Jab koi ginti apni had tak pohnche to laal "flagged" lagta hai.
byUser.example: "Bilal — flagged: Voided · Discount 6 · Voided 3 · Sold under asking 1".

flagged.title: Flag ki hadein
flagged.body: Kisi bande par kisi qism ka flag tab lagta hai jab is muddat mein us ki ginti had tak pohnche: voided 3, sold under asking 3, sold under cost 2, discount 5, wrong PIN 3, asking changed 5, ID check skipped = aap ki dukan ki minimum had (default 3).
flagged.example: Bilal ne is mahine 2 mobile cost se kam beche → 2 ≥ 2 → "Sold under cost" ka flag.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Is muddat ke liye har bande ka ek card: kya becha, khareeda, wasool kiya, diya aur kharch kiya. Owner ko har bande ke cancel, price badalna, chhore check aur baqi security ginti bhi dikhti hai. Sale wale khane par tap karein to us ke bill.
staff.example: Bilal ka card: 45 bills mein Rs. 18,00,000 becha, discount 12,000, 2 purchases, payments 12 / 3, kharche 4.

total.title: Team ki sale
total.body: Is muddat ke saare sale bills ka total (cancel nahi), neeche kitne bande hain, aur sab ka diya hua kul discount.
total.example: Bilal Rs. 18,00,000 + Asad Rs. 12,00,000 → Rs. 30,00,000 · 2 bande · discount 20,000.

sold.title: Becha
sold.body: Is bande ke is muddat mein banaye sale bills ka total (discount ke baad; cancel bill shamil nahi; wapsi alag dikhayi hai).
sold.example: Bilal ne 45 bill banaye jin ka total Rs. 18,00,000 → Sold Rs. 18,00,000.

bills.title: Bills
bills.body: Is bande ne is muddat mein kitne sale bill banaye (cancel shamil nahi).
bills.example: Asad ne is mahine 30 bill banaye → 30.

discount.title: Discount diya
discount.body: Is muddat mein is bande ke sale bills par diya gaya discount, jama kar ke.
discount.example: Bilal ne 10 bills par Rs. 500 aur 7 par Rs. 1,000 → Rs. 12,000.

profit.title: Sale par munafa
profit.body: Is bande ke beche aur wapas na hone wale maal ki bechne ki qeemat minus cost. Sirf owner aur manager.
profit.example: Asad ne Rs. 12,00,000 ke mobile beche jin ki cost Rs. 10,80,000 → munafa Rs. 1,20,000.

onCredit.title: Udhaar par
onCredit.body: Is bande ke bills ka woh hissa jo bill bante waqt counter par nahi mila — udhaar diya gaya.
onCredit.example: Bill Rs. 60,000, customer ne counter par Rs. 40,000 cash diye → Rs. 20,000 udhaar.

returns.title: Wapsiyan
returns.body: Is bande ne is muddat mein customers ki kitni wapsiyan darj kin.
returns.example: Bilal ne is mahine customers se 2 mobile wapas liye → 2.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.body: Is bande ne is muddat mein kitne purchase bill banaye aur un ka total. Sirf owner aur manager.

payments.title: Payments in / out
payments.body: Is bande ne is muddat mein kitni payments darj kin: wasool / di gayin (cancel shamil nahi).
payments.example: "12 / 3" → Bilal ne customers se 12 baar udhaar wasool kiya aur 3 baar suppliers ko diya.

expenses.title: Kharche
expenses.body: Is bande ne is muddat mein kitne kharche dale aur un ka total.
expenses.example: Asad ne chai Rs. 600, rickshaw Rs. 400, bill Rs. 3,000 dale → "Expenses 3 · 4,000".

security.title: Security ginti
security.body: Sirf owner. Security list mein is bande ke is muddat ke record, qism ke hisaab se. Laal wali qism apni had tak pohnch gayi hai. Tap karein to Security list khulegi.
security.example: "Discount 6 · Voided 3 · Sold under asking 1", Voided laal (had 3).

flag.title: Flag
flag.body: Woh qismein jin mein yeh banda is muddat mein had tak pohncha (voided 3, under asking 3, under cost 2, discount 5, wrong PIN 3, asking changed 5, chhore check = aap ki minimum had). Dekhne ki wajah hai, ghalti ka saboot nahi.
flag.example: Bilal ne is mahine 3 bill cancel kiye → flag "Voided".

came.title: Aaye
came.body: Is arse mein khulne wali repair jobs (customers ke aur apne phone).
came.example: Is hafte 15 phone repair ke liye aaye.

given.title: Wapas diye
given.body: Is arse mein bill ke sath band hone wali jobs (customer ko wapas).

notFixed.title: Theek na ho sake
notFixed.body: Is arse mein baghair repair ke customer ko wapas kiye gaye phone.

openNow.title: Abhi khule
openNow.body: Jo jobs aaj tak band nahi huin, arsa koi bhi ho.
openNow.example: 7 phone abhi dukaan ya labs mein.

readyNow.title: Tayyar, le nahi gaye
readyNow.body: Theek shuda phone jo customer ka intezar kar rahe hain. Unhein phone karein.
readyNow.example: 3 tayyar: Ahmed, Bilal aur Sana ko phone karein.

lateNow.title: Abhi der se
lateNow.body: Khuli jobs jin ka customer se kiya wada guzar gaya.

atLabNow.title: Abhi lab mein
atLabNow.body: Jo phone abhi bahar ki labs ke paas hain.

lateAtLab.title: Lab mein der
lateAtLab.body: Woh phone jo lab ke wade ke baad bhi wahin hain.
lateAtLab.example: Zain ne 03-11 kaha, 05-11 ko bhi wahin.

income.title: Repair ki aamdani
income.body: Is arse ke repair bill (parts + kaam ka charge − discount).

parts.title: Parts ki laagat
parts.body: In bills mein lage parts ki dukaan ko laagat.

labCustomer.title: Lab charges
labCustomer.body: Customers ke phones par bahar ki labs ke charges jo is arse mein wapas aaye.

profit.title: Repair ka munafa
profit.body: Repair ki aamdani − parts ki laagat − lab charges.

labStock.title: Apne phones par lab charges
labStock.body: Dukaan ke apne stock phones par labs ke charges. Repair munafe mein nahi: un phones ki qeemat mein judte hain.
labStock.example: Purana A54 Rs. 40,000 ka + lab Rs. 3,000 → laagat Rs. 43,000.

avgBill.title: Ausat bill
avgBill.body: Repair ki aamdani ÷ wapas di gayi jobs.

series.title: Din-war aaye
series.body: Har din (ya hafte / mahine) kitne phone repair ko aaye; ishare mein wapas diye.

labs.title: Is arse ki repair labs
labs.body: Har lab jise is arse mein phone mile: bheje, theek, theek nahi, ausat din, theek % aur charges.

needsLook.title: Abhi dekhna hai
needsLook.body: Lab mein der wale phone aur customer ke wade se guzri jobs. Kholne ke liye tap karein.
needsLook.example: iPhone 11 Ali Lab mein 4 din; Ahmed ka A54 2 din der.

faults.title: Sab se aam kharabiyan
faults.body: Is arse mein kaun si kharabiyan sab se zyada aayin: woh parts stock mein rakhein.

labWaiting.title: Jo job abhi wapas nahi di, un ki lab fees
labWaiting.body: Gahakon ki un jobs ki lab fees jo abhi wapas nahi di gayin. Jab job bill ke saath wapas di jayegi to ye repair ke munafe mein shamil hogi.
labWaiting.example: Vivo Y20 lab se aaya, fees Rs. 2,500, gahak kal aayega → aaj yahan, kal munafe mein.

bulk.title: Bulk Excel
bulk.body: Ek ek mobile ya banda type karne ke bajaye Excel ki sheet bhar kar upload karein. App har row check kar ke saaf lafzon mein batati hai kya ghalat hai. 'Import' dabane tak kuch save nahi hota, aur phir ya to saari theek rows save hoti hain ya koi nahi.
bulk.example: Stock mein 50 purane mobile: 20 minute mein sheet mein likhein, ek baar upload karein, kaam khatam.

name.title: Naam
name.body: Bande ya dukaan ka naam jaise aap pukarte hain. Yeh bill, khate aur WhatsApp message par aata hai.

phone.title: Mobile number
phone.body: Bande ka mobile number. Is se woh jaldi mil jata hai aur WhatsApp bill aur reminder isi par jata hai.
phone.example: 0321 5550002 — ek baar likhein, agli baar sirf 0321555 search karein.

cnic.title: CNIC (shanakhti card)
cnic.body: Bande ke shanakhti card ka 13 hindson wala number. Purana phone khareedte waqt zaroor likhein taake pata ho kis ne becha.

address.title: Pata
address.body: Banda ya dukaan kahan hai. Lazmi nahi; dealer aur delivery ke liye kaam aata hai.

notes.title: Note
notes.body: Is entry ke baare mein jo baat yaad rakhni ho. Yeh sirf aap ki dukaan dekhti hai.
notes.example: "Baqi jumma ko dega" ya "dabbe par kharash hai".

amount.title: Raqam
amount.body: Kitne paise, rupay mein. Sirf number likhein; comma app khud lagati hai.

date.title: Tareekh
