date.body: Yeh kis din hua. Khud aaj ki tareekh hoti hai; report isi din mein ginti hai.
date.example: Kal ki sale likhna bhool gaye: kal ki tareekh rakhein to kal ke hisaab mein aayegi.

method.title: Adaigi kaise hui
method.body: Naqd, online (bank app / Easypaisa / JazzCash), cheque ya bahar mulk se. Isi se tay hota hai ke raqam kis account mein jaye.
method.example: Customer ne 10,000 Easypaisa par bheje: Online → Easypaisa chunein; raqam Easypaisa account mein jayegi, galle mein nahi.

account.title: Account (galla / bank / wallet)
account.body: Dukaan ke paise kahan hain: galla (naqd daraz), bank account, Easypaisa ya JazzCash. Har ek ka apna baqaya hai.

discount.title: Discount (riayat)
discount.body: Customer ke liye qeemat mein se kam ki gayi raqam. Is se bill aur munafa dono kam hote hain.

tax.title: Tax (sales tax)
tax.body: Sarkari sales tax jo qeemat ke upar lagta hai, agar dukaan registered hai. Yeh hukumat ke liye jama hota hai, aap ki aamdani nahi.
tax.example: Bill 10,000 aur 18% tax → customer 11,800 dega; 1,800 tax hai.

paid.title: Abhi ada
paid.body: Jo raqam abhi counter par di gayi. Jo baqi rahe woh khate mein udhaar rehti hai.

remaining.title: Baqi
remaining.body: Is bill ya khate par ab tak ki adaigi ke baad jo raqam abhi deni hai.

qty.title: Tadaad
qty.body: Kitne piece. Darjan ya dabbe mein khareedi cheez bhi piece mein gini jati hai.

period.title: Arsa (period)
period.body: Screen kin dinon ko ginti hai: aaj, is hafte, is mahine, apni marzi ki tareekh se tareekh tak waghera. Screen ka har adad sirf inhi dinon ka hai.
period.example: 15 March ko "is mahine" yani 1 se 15 March; "pichla mahina" yani poora February.

asOf.title: Kisi din tak (as of)
asOf.body: Baqaya (stock, udhaar, naqd) us din ke aakhir mein jaisa tha waisa dikhata hai, aaj wala nahi.
asOf.example: 31 January tak: us raat logon par kitna udhaar tha, chahe baad mein ada kar diya ho.

download.title: Print / Excel
download.body: Yeh screen print karein ya PDF banayein, ya Excel sheet download kar ke rakhein ya accountant ko bhejein.
download.example: Mahine ke aakhir mein: Excel → accountant ko WhatsApp par bhejein.

search.title: Search
search.body: Naam, mobile number, IMEI ya bill number ka kuch hissa likhein; list mein sirf milti cheezein rahengi.
search.example: 4512 likhein to woh phone milega jis ka IMEI 4512 par khatam hota hai.

page.title: Super admin
page.body: Software ke maalik ke taur par aap ka apna page: har customer dukaan, us ka package, fees aur baqi din, check karne wali adaigiyan, aur nayi dukaan kholna. Dukaandar ise kabhi nahi dekhte.
page.example: Star Mobiles (Hall Road) app maangti hai: yahan dukaan kholein, login WhatsApp par bhejein, aur screenshot aane par us ki Rs. 2,000 fees manzoor karein.

business.title: Karobar
business.body: Aap ka karobari hisaab kholta hai: mahana aamdani (MRR), mahina waar aur zariya waar wasooli, aane wali aur tareekh guzri fees, abhi kaun app chala raha hai, aur license keys.
business.example: 3 dukaanein Rs. 2,000 mahana deti hain → yahan MRR Rs. 6,000 dikhegi.

appLink.title: Android app ka link
appLink.body: Android phone ke liye dukaan wali app ka download link. Ye hamesha naya version deta hai, is liye yehi link har dukaan ko bhejein.
appLink.example: Nayi dukaan app maangti hai: WhatsApp dabayein, maalik chunein; woh apne Infinix Hot 40 par link khol kar app install kar leta hai.

fees.title: Software fees
fees.body: Dukaandaron ki batayi hui fees ki adaigiyan, raqam, transaction ID aur screenshot ke saath. Wasool dabane se us dukaan ka plan ada kiye gaye mahinon jitna barh jata hai; Mustarad karne par aap ki wajah dukaandar ko jati hai.
fees.example: Ali Mobiles ne 3 mahinon ke Rs. 6,000 Easypaisa par bheje → apne Easypaisa mein dekh kar Wasool · +3 mahine dabayein → us ka plan 3 mahine aur chalega.

feesMonth.title: Is mahine · check karni hain
feesMonth.body: Is mahine: is mahine ki 1 tareekh se aap ki manzoor ki gayi fees ka jor (manzoori ke din ke hisaab se). Check karni hain: dukaanon ki batayi hui adaigiyan jo aap ne abhi manzoor ya mustarad nahi kin.
feesMonth.example: Is mahine Rs. 2,000 aur Rs. 4,000 manzoor kiye aur 1 screenshot baqi hai → Is mahine Rs. 6,000 · 1 check karni hai.

billing.title: Billing settings
billing.body: Aap ki bank tafseel, support number, yaad dehani ka schedule aur dukaanon ke liye note. Dukaanein ye fees ki yaad dehani aur Software fees screen par dekhti hain. Wallets (Easypaisa, JazzCash) Adaigi ke accounts mein daalein.
billing.example: Aik baar Meezan Bank ki tafseel aur WhatsApp 0300 1234567 bharein → har dukaan ki yaad dehani mein dikhega kahan paise bhejne hain aur kis se baat karni hai.

bankName.title: Bank ka naam
bankName.body: Woh bank jis mein dukaanein aap ki fees transfer kar sakti hain.

accountTitle.title: Account title
accountTitle.body: Aap ke bank account par likha naam, bilkul waisa jaisa bank dikhata hai, taake dukaandar ko tasalli ho ke woh sahi shakhs ko paise bhej raha hai.

accountNumber.title: Account number
accountNumber.body: Aap ka bank account number, isi bank ya bank app se transfer ke liye.

iban.title: IBAN
iban.body: Aap ka 24 huroof wala bank number jo PK se shuru hota hai. Koi bhi bank app is par paise bhej sakti hai.

branch.title: Branch
branch.body: Aap ki bank branch ka naam ya code. Kuch dukaandar bank counter par jama karate hain to unhein ye chahiye hota hai.

supportPhone.title: Support phone
supportPhone.body: Woh number jis par dukaandar software ya fees ke baare mein madad ke liye call karte hain. Ye yaad dehani par dikhta hai.

supportWa.title: Support WhatsApp
supportWa.body: Woh WhatsApp number jis par dukaanein madad ke liye ya adaigi ka screenshot bhejne ke liye message karti hain. WhatsApp par madad ka button isi se chat kholta hai.
supportWa.example: 0300 1234567 → dukaandar WhatsApp par madad dabata hai aur aap se chat khul jati hai.

schedule.title: Yaad dehani ka schedule
schedule.body: Plan khatam hone se kitne din pehle kaun si yaad dehani shuru ho: pehle peeli patti, phir orange patti aur popup, phir surkh. Aakhri tareekh ke baad riayati din chalte hain; un ke baad dukaan band ho jati hai.
schedule.example: Peeli 7, orange 3, surkh 1, riayat 7; plan 30 November ko khatam → 23 Nov se peeli, 27 se orange, 29 ko surkh, 8 December se band.

infoDays.title: Peeli patti kab se
infoDays.body: Aakhri tareekh se kitne din pehle dukaan ki screenon par chhoti peeli patti dikhna shuru ho. Abhi popup nahi.
infoDays.example: 7 → plan 30 November ko khatam, peeli patti 23 November se dikhegi.

warnDays.title: Orange patti + popup kab se
warnDays.body: Aakhri tareekh se kitne din pehle patti orange ho jaye aur din mein aik baar yaad dehani ka popup aaye.
warnDays.example: 3 → 27 November se maalik ko rozana aik baar popup dikhega.

urgentDays.title: Surkh patti + popup kab se
urgentDays.body: Aakhri tareekh se kitne din pehle patti surkh ho jaye; popup snooze ghanton ke baad phir aata hai.
urgentDays.example: 1 → 29 November ko patti surkh aur popup har 4 ghante baad.

graceDays.title: Miyad ke baad riayati din
graceDays.body: Aakhri tareekh ke baad kitne din dukaan poori tarah chalti rahe, surkh patti aur popup ke saath. Un ke baad dukaan band: sirf dekh sakti hai, fees de sakti hai aur data ka backup le sakti hai.
graceDays.example: 7 → plan 30 November ko khatam, dukaan 7 December tak chalegi aur 8 December se band.

snoozeHours.title: Snooze ghante
snoozeHours.body: Jab maalik surkh popup par Baad mein yaad dilayen dabata hai to popup itne ghante nahi aata.
snoozeHours.example: 4 → subah 11 baje snooze kiya, popup dopahar 3 baje phir aayega.

note.title: Dukaanon ke liye note
note.body: Aik chhota paigham jo dukaandaron ko aap ki adaigi ki tafseel ke saath dikhta hai. Yehi paigham English, Urdu aur Roman Urdu mein likhein.
note.example: Transfer karte waqt remarks mein apni dukaan ka naam likhein.

accounts.title: Adaigi ke accounts
accounts.body: Aap ke wallets aur accounts jin mein dukaandar fees bhejte hain: Easypaisa, JazzCash, SadaPay ya bank. Har dukaan ye fehrist apni Software fees screen par dekhti hai.
accounts.example: Easypaisa · Ahmed Raza · 0345 1234567 → dukaandar number copy kar ke Rs. 2,000 bhej deta hai.

label.title: Account ka naam
label.body: Wallet ya bank ka naam, jaise dukaandar use janta hai.

name.title: Account holder
name.body: Us account par registered naam, taake dukaandar bhejne se pehle naam dekh le.

number.title: Number / IBAN
number.body: Wallet ka mobile number ya bank ka IBAN jis mein paise jayein.

note.title: Account ka note
note.body: Account ke neeche dukaandar ke liye aik optional line.
note.example: Adaigi ke baad screenshot WhatsApp par bhejein.

shopRequests.title: Website se dukaan ki requests
shopRequests.body: Woh log jinhon ne app lene ke liye website par form bhara. Nayi dukaan kholein dabane se form mein un ki tafseel khud bhar jati hai; tick ka nishan request mukammal kar deta hai.
shopRequests.example: Saddar, Karachi se Bilal ne basic package maanga → Nayi dukaan kholein dabayein; us ka naam aur number pehle se bhare honge.

pwRequests.title: Password ki requests
pwRequests.body: Woh dukaandar jinhon ne login screen par password bhool gaya dabaya. Dukaan ka naya password rakhein, WhatsApp par bhejein, phir tick dabayein.
pwRequests.example: Usman apna password bhool gaya → Password rakhein, ms4821 likhein, Save, WhatsApp par bhejein, tick.

filter.title: Sab · Fees baqi · Band
filter.body: Dukaanon ki fehrist chhoti karta hai. Fees baqi: jin ka plan 7 din ya kam mein khatam ho raha hai, ya khatam ho chuka magar riayati din chal rahe hain. Band: riayati din bhi khatam, dukaan sirf dekh aur fees de sakti hai.
filter.example: 2 dukaanon ka plan is hafte khatam aur 1 ka 3 din pehle khatam hua → Fees baqi 3.

shops.title: Customers ki dukaanein
shops.body: Aap ka software chalane wali har dukaan, maalik, package, baqi din aur mahana fees ke saath. Dukaan par daba kar package badlein, adaigi darj karein, renewal code banayein ya password rakhein.
shops.example: Star Mobiles · basic · 12 din baqi · Rs. 2,000/mahina.

planStatus.title: Package aur baqi din
planStatus.body: Dukaan ka package aur plan kitne din aur chalega. Sabz: chal raha hai. Peela: 7 din ya kam baqi. Surkh: khatam (riayati din) ya band. Khatam ke saath aakhri ada shuda din likha hai.
planStatus.example: basic · 5 din baqi · Khatam 30 Nov → use Rs. 2,000 dene ka yaad dilayein.

openShop.title: Ye dukaan kholein
openShop.body: Dukaan ki app aise kholta hai jaise aap us ke andar hon, taake maalik ke liye kuch dekh ya theek kar sakein. Aap ka aana us dukaan ke record mein likha jata hai.
openShop.example: Maalik kehta hai aik sale ghayab hai → us ki dukaan khol kar aaj ki sale khud dekhein.

ownerPassword.title: Maalik ka password
ownerPassword.body: Jab dukaan ka maalik password bhool jaye to yahan naya rakh kar use bhej dein. Purana password chalna band ho jata hai.
ownerPassword.example: ms5521 likhein → Save → WhatsApp par bhejein → woh 0321 5550002 aur ms5521 se login karta hai.

newPassword.title: Naya password
newPassword.body: Dukaan ke maalik ka naya login password, kam az kam 6 huroof. Aisa rakhein jo phone par aasani se likha jaye.

modules.title: Is dukaan ke modules
modules.body: Ye dukaan app ke kaun se izafi hisse chala sakti hai. Buniyadi cheezein (stock, sale, purchase, khata, adaigiyan) hamesha chalti hain. Plan ke mutabiq par tick ho to package tay karta hai; tick hata kar khud chunein.
modules.example: basic dukaan ko repair bhi chahiye → Plan ke mutabiq ka tick hatayein, Repairs par tick karein, Modules save karein.

followPlan.title: Plan ke mutabiq
followPlan.body: Tick ho to dukaan ko us ke package ke modules milte hain aur package badalne par khud badal jate hain. Tick na ho to sirf woh modules jin par aap neeche tick karein.
followPlan.example: basic mein accessories, kharche, sale hold aur tax hain; dukaan ko pro par karein to repair aur reports khud aa jati hain.

plans.title: Package
plans.body: trial: sab kuch, app aazmane ke liye. basic: buniyadi cheezein aur accessories, kharche, sale hold aur tax. pro: saath mein repair, exchange, reports, download, WhatsApp, qistein, hazri aur assistant. chain: sab kuch, kai dukaanon wale maalik ke liye.
plans.example: Nayi dukaan trial se shuru karti hai; trial ke baad woh Rs. 2,000 mahana wala basic leti hai.

monthlyFee.title: Mahana fees
monthlyFee.body: Ye dukaan aap ko har mahine kitne rupay deti hai. Isi se Karobar wale page ki MRR aur aane wali / tareekh guzri fees banti hai. Khali ya 0 = koi fees nahi.

expiresOn.title: Adaigi is tareekh tak
expiresOn.body: Woh aakhri din jis tak dukaan ka plan ada shuda hai. Yaad dehaniyan isi tak ginti karti hain; is ke baad riayati din shuru. Khali chhod kar Plan save karein = koi aakhri tareekh nahi.
expiresOn.example: 30 November 2026 → 1 December se dukaan riayati dinon mein hogi.

feeNote.title: Note (sirf aap)
feeNote.body: Is dukaan ki fees ya saude ke baare mein aap ki apni baat. Dukaandar ise kabhi nahi dekhta.
feeNote.example: Har 3 mahine baad deta hai; pehla mahina muft (Bilal ka dost).

extend.title: +1 / +3 / +12 mahine
extend.body: Plan mein foran mahine jor kar save karta hai. Agar adaigi ki tareekh abhi aage hai to wahan se, warna aaj se ginti hoti hai, is liye pehle dene wale ke din zaya nahi hote. Is se koi adaigi darj nahi hoti.
extend.example: Adaigi 20 November tak, aaj 10 November, +3 mahine dabayein → 20 February tak.

unlimited.title: Unlimited
unlimited.body: Aakhri tareekh hata deta hai: dukaan ko koi yaad dehani nahi aati aur woh kabhi band nahi hoti. Apni dukaan, dost ya ta-hayat saude ke liye.
unlimited.example: Aap ki demo dukaan: Unlimited dabayein to Koi aakhri tareekh nahi dikhega.

shopGrace.title: Is dukaan ke riayati din
shopGrace.body: Aakhri tareekh ke baad sirf ye dukaan kitne din aur chal sakti hai is se pehle ke band ho. Khali = Billing settings wale riayati din.
shopGrace.example: Aam taur par 7; bharose wale dealer ko 15 → woh aakhri tareekh ke 15 din baad band hoga.

recordPayment.title: Adaigi darj karein
recordPayment.body: Jo paise aap ko khud mile (naqd, ya bank app mein dekha transfer). Ye wasool ke taur par save hoti hai, plan foran utne mahine barh jata hai aur raseed number banta hai.
recordPayment.example: Bilal ne Rs. 6,000 naqd diye: raqam 6000, mahine 3, zariya cash → raseed SUB-0007 aur us ka plan 3 mahine aur chalega.

payAmount.title: Raqam (Rs)
payAmount.body: Is adaigi mein milne wale rupay. Shuru mein dukaan ki mahana fees bhari hoti hai; zyada mahinon ki adaigi ho to badal dein.

payMonths.title: Mahine
payMonths.body: Ye adaigi kitne mahinon ki hai. Plan utne hi mahine barh jata hai.
payMonths.example: 3 → adaigi ki tareekh 30 November se 28 February ho jati hai.

payMethod.title: Kis zariye ada kiya
payMethod.body: Paise kaise aaye: cash, Easypaisa, JazzCash, bank waghera. Karobar wala page isi lafz se raqam alag alag karta hai; bare chhote huroof aur space se farq nahi parta.
payMethod.example: Easypaisa aur easypaisa aik hi zariya gine jate hain.

paidOn.title: Adaigi ki tareekh
paidOn.body: Jis din paise asal mein bheje ya diye gaye. Karobar wala page ise usi din ke mahine mein ginta hai.
paidOn.example: 31 October ko bheje, 2 November ko darj kiye → October mein gine jayenge.

renewalCode.title: Renewal code
renewalCode.body: Dastkhat shuda key jo maalik Mazeed → Software fees mein paste kare to is dukaan ke plan mein mahine jur jate hain. Internet ke baghair chalti hai, sirf aik baar. Har code Karobar → Keys mein mehfooz rehta hai.
renewalCode.example: Baghair internet wali aik computer ki dukaan ne Rs. 2,000 diye → 1 mahine ka code bana kar WhatsApp par bhejein, woh paste kare → plan +1 mahina.

codeMonths.title: Code ke mahine
codeMonths.body: Istemal hone par code kitne mahine jorega. Code banane se koi adaigi darj nahi hoti.
codeMonths.example: 12 → us dukaan ke liye aik saal ki key jis ne saal ke Rs. 20,000 diye.

addBranch.title: Branch shamil karein
addBranch.body: Isi maalik ki aik aur dukaan kholta hai. Woh isi login se dukaan badalta hai; har dukaan ka apna stock, khata aur bill, jabke package aur fees aik hi rehti hai.
addBranch.example: Star Mobiles ne Hafeez Centre mein doosri dukaan kholi → branch Star Mobiles 2, Lahore shamil karein.

branchName.title: Branch ka naam
branchName.body: Nayi dukaan ka naam, jaisa us ke bills aur screenon par dikhega.

city.title: Shehar
city.body: Dukaan ka shehar. Ye aap ki dukaanon ki fehrist mein dikhta hai aur dukaan dhoondne mein madad karta hai.

shopName.title: Dukaan ka naam
shopName.body: Dukaan ka naam jaisa us ke bills aur screenon ke upar dikhega.

ownerName.title: Maalik ka naam
ownerName.body: Dukaan ke maalik ka naam. Ye aap ki dukaanon ki fehrist mein dikhta hai.

ownerPhone.title: Maalik ka mobile (login)
ownerPhone.body: Maalik isi number se login karta hai, aur login tafseel isi par WhatsApp hoti hai.

password.title: Maalik ka password
password.body: Dukaan ke maalik ka pehla password, kam az kam 6 huroof. Login number ke saath use de dein.
password.example: ms4821 → woh 0321 5550002 aur ms4821 se login karta hai.

language.title: Dukaan ki zubaan
language.body: Dukaan ki app, bill aur WhatsApp paigham kis zubaan mein shuru hon. Har user baad mein app ki zubaan badal sakta hai.
language.example: Anarkali ki dukaan jis ka staff sirf Urdu parhta hai → Urdu.

giveDetails.title: Login tafseel
giveDetails.body: Woh mobile number aur password jis se nayi dukaan ka maalik login karega. WhatsApp par bhejein; paigham mein website aur Android app ka link bhi hai.

credit.title: Package abhi, fee baad mein
credit.body: Us gahak ke liye jo kehta hai package barha dein, paise baad mein bhej doon ga. Package foran barh jata hai aur fee baqi likhi jati hai. Dukaan ko apne fees page, fee ke bill aur yaad-dehani mein sirf "Ada nahi hui", "Kuch ada hui" ya "Ada ho gayi" nazar aata hai. Paise aayein to pehle yeh fee poori hoti hai.
credit.example: Ali Mobiles 2 mahine aur maangta hai aur 15 tareekh ko dega → 2 mahine, Rs. 3,000, 15 tareekh. Package abhi barh gaya; us ke fees page par Rs. 3,000 baqi dikhta hai.

months.title: Mahine
months.body: Package mein abhi kitne mahine barhane hain.
months.example: 2 → 10 March ko khatam hone wala package ab 10 May ko khatam hoga.

amount.title: Raqam
amount.body: In mahinon ki fee jo dukaan ne deni hai. Shuru mein mahana fee × mahine hoti hai; koi aur raqam tay hui ho to badal dein.

dueOn.title: Ada karne ki tareekh
dueOn.body: Jis din gahak ne paise dene ka waada kiya. Us ke baad aap ko bhi aur dukaan ko bhi fee der se nazar aati hai.
dueOn.example: 15 tareekh ka waada → 16 se "Ada karne ki tareekh guzar gayi 15" dikhta hai.

note.title: Aap ka note
note.body: Sirf aap ke liye, ke kya tay hua tha. Dukaan isay kabhi nahi dekhti, bill par bhi nahi.
note.example: "Phone par kaha Eid ke baad dega."

list.title: Fee jo abhi ada nahi hui
list.body: Is dukaan ko udhaar par diye gaye sab package, purane pehle, har ek par kitna ada hua aur kitna baqi hai. Payment pehle sab se purana poora karti hai.
list.example: FEE-0003 Rs. 3,000, ada Rs. 1,000 → Kuch ada hui, Rs. 2,000 baqi.

bin.title: Customer delete karna
bin.body: Delete karne se customer apni sab branches ke saath Deleted mein chala jata hai. Us ka maalik aur staff login nahi kar sakte, aur dukaan list, aap ke hisaab aur raat ke messages se hat jati hai. Kuch mit'ta nahi: bill, khata, phone aur history sab mehfooz rehte hain. Deleted kholein aur Wapis laayen dabayein, dukaan bilkul waisi hi wapis aa jaye gi.
bin.example: Ali Mobiles ne dukaan band kar di → Dukaan delete karein, naam "Ali Mobiles" likhein, wajah "dukaan band". Chhe mahine baad wapis aaye to Deleted → Ali Mobiles → Wapis laayen.

typeName.title: Dukaan ka naam
typeName.body: Taake ghalti se koi dukaan delete na ho, us ka naam bilkul waisa hi likhein jaisa dikh raha hai. Chhote bare huroof se farq nahi parta.

reason.title: Wajah
reason.body: Aap ne kyun delete ki. Yeh sirf aap Deleted mein dekhein ge.
reason.example: Dukaan band / chhe mahine se fee nahi di.

page.title: Karobar
page.body: Software ke maalik ke taur par aap ka karobar: aamdani, zariya waar adaigiyan, aane wali aur tareekh guzri fees, har dukaan ka package aur baqi waqt, kaun online aur kaun offline chalata hai, aur license keys.
page.example: 3 dukaanein Rs. 2,000 mahana deti hain → MRR Rs. 6,000; un mein se aik 5 din mein khatam → 7 din mein aani hai Rs. 2,000.

tabs.title: Khulasa · Dukaanein · Adaigiyan · Keys
tabs.body: Khulasa: kul jor. Dukaanein: har customer ki aik line, package, baqi din aur istemal ke saath. Adaigiyan: har fees, zariya aur haalat ke saath. Keys: banayi, bheji, istemal hui ya mansookh renewal keys.
tabs.example: Bilal kehta hai us ne paise de diye → Adaigiyan, Bilal search karein → Rs. 2,000 · easypaisa · Pending.

mrr.title: Mahana aamdani (MRR)
mrr.body: MRR yaani har mahine aane wali aamdani: paid package (basic, pro, chain) wali un sab dukaanon ki mahana fees jin ka plan khatam nahi hua. Trial, khatam aur band dukaanein nahi gini jatin.
mrr.example: 3 dukaanein Rs. 2,000 mahana deti hain aur chauthi band hai → MRR Rs. 6,000.

arpu.title: Fi dukaan ausat
arpu.body: MRR ko paid package wali dukaanon ki tadaad (saath likhi Dukaanein) se taqseem kiya gaya. Khatam aur band dukaanein is tadaad mein hain magar fees nahi jortin, is liye ausat kam kar deti hain.
arpu.example: MRR Rs. 6,000 aur 3 dukaanein → Rs. 2,000; chauthi band dukaan ke saath → Rs. 1,500.

collectedMonth.title: Is mahine wasool
collectedMonth.body: Manzoor shuda fees, adaigi ke din ke hisaab se, is mahine ki 1 tareekh se. Neeche: pichle mahine ka yehi jor.
collectedMonth.example: 3 Nov ko Rs. 2,000 aur 10 Nov ko Rs. 6,000 → Rs. 8,000; Pichla mahina Rs. 4,000.

collectedTotal.title: Kul wasool
collectedTotal.body: Shuru se ab tak ki sab manzoor shuda fees. Dukaanein: kitni alag dukaanon ne kam az kam aik baar ada kiya.

pending.title: Pending (check karein)
pending.body: Dukaanon ki batayi hui adaigiyan jo aap ne abhi manzoor ya mustarad nahi kin; neeche wala number adaigiyan ginta hai. Adaigiyan kholne ke liye tile dabayein.

coming7.title: 7 din mein aani hai
coming7.body: Un dukaanon ki mahana fees jin ka plan agle 7 din mein (aaj samait) khatam ho raha hai. Inhi ko abhi yaad dilana hai.
coming7.example: Rs. 2,000 wali 2 dukaanein is hafte khatam → Rs. 4,000, Dukaanein: 2.

coming30.title: 30 din mein aani hai
coming30.body: Un dukaanon ki mahana fees jin ka plan agle 30 din mein khatam ho raha hai. Is mein 7 din wali bhi shamil hain.
coming30.example: Rs. 2,000 wali 5 dukaanein is mahine khatam → Rs. 10,000, Dukaanein: 5.

overdue.title: Tareekh guzar gayi
overdue.body: Un dukaanon ki mahana fees jin ki aakhri tareekh guzar chuki (riayati din ya band): woh paise jo ab tak mil jane chahiye the.
overdue.example: Ali Mobiles ka plan 5 din pehle khatam, fees Rs. 2,000 → Tareekh guzar gayi Rs. 2,000, Dukaanein: 1.

onlineNow.title: Abhi istemal mein
onlineNow.body: Jo dukaanein abhi app chala rahi hain: online dukaan jis ne pichle 10 minute mein istemal kiya, aik computer wala system jis ne pichle aik ghante mein rabta kiya. Neeche: aaj aur pichle 7 din mein istemal karne wali dukaanein.
onlineNow.example: 14 dukaanein: abhi 5, aaj 11, is hafte 13 → aik dukaan ne hafte se app nahi kholi.

keysTile.title: License keys
keysTile.body: Bara number woh keys hain jo banin magar abhi istemal nahi huin. Neeche: istemal shuda aur mansookh keys. Keys kholne ke liye tile dabayein.
keysTile.example: 10 keys banin, 6 istemal, 1 mansookh → 3 abhi istemal nahi huin.

byMonth.title: Mahina waar wasooli
byMonth.body: Pichle 12 mahinon ki manzoor shuda fees, har mahine ki aik patti, adaigi ke din ke hisaab se.
byMonth.example: October Rs. 18,000, November Rs. 24,000 → November ki patti lambi hai.

byChannel.title: Kis zariye se
byChannel.body: Sab manzoor shuda fees, adaigi ke zariye ke hisaab se: kitni adaigiyan aur kul raqam.

byPlan.title: Package ke hisaab se
byPlan.body: Har package par kitni dukaanein hain aur un se mahana aamdani (MRR). Trial aur khatam shuda plan aamdani mein nahi jurte.

usage.title: Kaun istemal kar raha hai
usage.body: Kitni dukaanein online app (website / Android) chalati hain aur kitni aik computer wala Windows system, aur har plan ki haalat mein kitni dukaanein hain.
usage.example: Online 11, Offline 3; Chal raha hai 9, Jald khatam 2, Band 1.

cloud.title: Online (website / app)
cloud.body: Woh dukaanein jo internet par website ya Android app se kaam karti hain. Un ka data aap ke server par hai.
cloud.example: 11 dukaanein website ya app chalati hain.

local.title: Offline (aik computer)
local.body: Woh dukaanein jo aap ke server ke baghair dukaan ke aik computer par app chalati hain. Un ka istemal tab hi dikhta hai jab us computer par internet ho aur woh rabta kare.
local.example: 3 dukaanon mein Windows wala system laga hai.

statuses.title: Plan ki haalat
statuses.body: Chal raha hai: 7 din se zyada baqi. Jald khatam: 7 din ya kam. Khatam (mohlat): khatam magar abhi chal raha hai. Band: mohlat bhi khatam, sirf dekhna aur fees dena. Koi aakhri tareekh nahi: unlimited. Trial: trial package par.
statuses.example: Jald khatam 2 → un 2 dukaanon ko is hafte yaad dilayein.

shopList.title: Dukaanon ki fehrist
shopList.body: Har customer ki aik line: mahana fees, package, haalat, baqi din, online ya offline (sabz nuqta = abhi istemal mein), kul ada kiya, aakhri adaigi aur zariya, pending raqam aur aakhri istemal. Band aur khatam hone wali dukaanein upar. Tafseel ke liye dukaan dabayein.
shopList.example: Star Mobiles · Rs. 2,000 / mahina · basic · Jald khatam · 3 din baqi · Kul ada kiya Rs. 12,000.

deployment.title: Online ya offline
deployment.body: Dukaan online app (website / Android) chalati hai ya aik computer wala system. Dukaan ki tafseel mein ye aap khud rakhte hain, maslan computer wala version lagane ke baad.
deployment.example: Ali Mobiles mein Windows version lagaya → Offline (aik computer) rakhein.

version.title: Version
version.body: Dukaan ke aik computer wale system par app ka version, jaisa computer ne aakhri baar bataya. Is se pata chalta hai computer ko update chahiye ya nahi.
version.example: 1.4.2 jabke naya 1.5.0 hai → woh computer update karein.

fee.title: Fees
fee.body: Is dukaan ki mahana fees, neeche us ka package.

status.title: Plan ki haalat
status.body: Ada shuda plan ke baqi din (ya aakhri tareekh se upar din), haalat ke saath. ∞ yaani koi aakhri tareekh nahi.

paidTotal.title: Kul ada kiya
paidTotal.body: Is dukaan ki sab fees jo aap ne manzoor ki; × wala number batata hai kitni adaigiyan.
paidTotal.example: Rs. 12,000 · 6× → us ne 6 baar ada kiya.

lastUsed.title: Aakhri istemal
lastUsed.body: Is dukaan mein kisi ne aakhri baar kab app istemal ki (aik computer wale system ke liye: aakhri rabta kab hua). Sabz nuqta = abhi istemal mein.
lastUsed.example: kabhi nahi → use login mila magar us ne abhi app nahi kholi.

shopPayments.title: Is dukaan ki adaigiyan
shopPayments.body: Is dukaan ki batayi hui ya aap ki darj ki gayi har fees, zariya, tareekh, mahine, raseed aur haalat ke saath.

payList.title: Adaigiyon ki fehrist
payList.body: Har fees ki adaigi, nayi sab se upar: dukaan, zariya, adaigi ki tareekh, mahine, reference, raseed aur haalat. Dukaan ke naam, transaction ID ya raseed number se search karein.
payList.example: SUB-0007 search karein to woh raseed mil jayegi jis ka Bilal pooch raha hai.

channels.title: Zariya
channels.body: Sirf aik zariye se aayi adaigiyan dikhata hai.
channels.example: jazzcash dabayein → sirf JazzCash wali adaigiyan.

payStatus.title: Adaigi ki haalat
payStatus.body: Pending: aap ke check karne ka intezar. Wasool: manzoor, plan barh gaya. Radd: qabool nahi hui; dukaan ne aap ki wajah dekhi.
payStatus.example: Pending dabayein to baqi screenshot dikhenge.

approvedTotal.title: Wasool (dikhayi gayi)
approvedTotal.body: Neeche wali fehrist mein wasool shuda adaigiyon ka jor, zariya, haalat aur search ke baad. Pending aur radd shuda nahi jurtin.

what.title: License key
what.body: Dastkhat shuda code jo aik dukaan ke plan mein mahine jorta hai. Dukaandar ise Mazeed → Software fees → Renewal code mein paste karta hai; website, app ya aik computer wale system par, internet ke baghair, aik baar chalta hai. Link 7 din tak dukaandar ko key dikhata hai.
what.example: Ali Mobiles ne Rs. 6,000 diye → 3 mahine ki key bana kar WhatsApp par bhejein; woh paste kare to plan 3 mahine aur chalega.

status.title: Istemal nahi · Istemal ho gayi · Mansookh
status.body: Istemal nahi: ban gayi, dukaan ka intezar hai. Istemal ho gayi: dukaan ne is se renew kar liya (website / app ya aik computer par). Mansookh: aap ne mansookh ki, ab nahi chalti.
status.example: Key ghalat number par chali gayi → use mansookh kar ke nayi banayein.

forShop.title: Kis dukaan ke liye
forShop.body: Woh dukaan jis ke liye key ban rahi hai. Key sirf usi dukaan par chalti hai.
forShop.example: Star Mobiles chunein; yehi key Ali Mobiles par nahi chalegi.

months.title: Key ke mahine
months.body: Istemal hone par key plan mein kitne mahine joregi. Key banane se adaigi darj nahi hoti; paise alag se darj karein.
months.example: 3 mahine → 30 November tak wala plan 28 February tak.

note.title: Key ka note
note.body: Key par aap ki apni baat, maslan kyun banayi. Sirf aap dekhte hain.

card.title: Key ka card
card.body: Key, kab bani, kitni baar bheji gayi aur us ka link kitni baar khula. WhatsApp / SMS: link ke saath bhejein. Key copy / Link copy: kisi aur app ke liye. Nayi key banayein: utne hi mahinon ki nayi key, purani ghair istemal shuda mansookh. Naya link: 7 din ka naya link. Key mansookh karein: key chalna band.
card.example: Bilal se paigham gum ho gaya → dobara WhatsApp dabayein: wohi key, 2 baar bheji.

pageWhat.title: Renewal key
pageWhat.body: Aap ke software provider ne ye key bheji hai taake aap ki dukaan ka plan dikhaye gaye mahinon jitna barh jaye. Ye sirf aap ki dukaan ke liye hai aur aik baar chalti hai.
pageWhat.example: 3 mahine → paste karne ke baad aap ka plan 3 mahine aur chalega.

pageSteps.title: Key kaise istemal karein
pageSteps.body: Key copy karein dabayein, dukaan ki app kholein, Mazeed → Software fees → Renewal code mein paste kar ke Renew dabayein. Ye internet ke baghair bhi chalti hai.
pageSteps.example: Adaigi 30 November tak; 1 mahine ki key ke baad → 30 December tak.

page.title: Charger, cover waghera
page.body: Dukan ki har ginti wali cheez: charger, cable, cover, glass, parts. Har cheez mein likha rehta hai ke kitne piece hain, qeemat kya hai aur poori history.
page.example: Aap ke paas 25 Type-C cable aur 8 iPhone 13 cover hain: dono yahan alag alag cheez hain, har ek ki apni ginti aur qeemat.

stock.title: Stock mein
stock.body: Aap ki tamam cheezein, abhi dukan mein kitne piece hain aur bechne ki qeemat. Kisi par tap karein to us ka page khulega.
stock.example: Samsung 25W charger · 12 · Rs. 1,800 ka matlab: dukan mein 12 piece hain, ek Rs. 1,800 ka bikta hai.

low.title: Kam stock
low.body: Woh cheezein jin ki ginti "Reorder at" wale number tak ya us se neeche aa gayi hai. Ab mazeed khareedne ka waqt hai.
low.example: Reorder at 5 hai aur sirf 4 glass protector bache hain → glass protector yahan nazar aaye ga.

pending.title: Baqi accessories
pending.body: Phone ke saath wala dabba, charger ya koi aur cheez jo abhi di ya li nahi gayi: ya to dealer ne aap ko deni hai, ya aap ne customer se waada kiya hai. Jab ho jaye to "Delivered" dabayein.
pending.example: Aap ne iPhone 13 becha aur dabba kal dene ka waada kiya → yeh "To customer" ke saath kal ki tareekh se nazar aaye ga jab tak aap Delivered na dabayein.

filters.title: Filter
filters.body: Sirf kuch cheezein dikhayein: ek brand, ek quality, ya sirf woh jin ke piece khatam ho gaye.
filters.example: Filter → brand Anker → list mein sirf Anker ke charger aur cable nazar aayein ge.

reportsLink.title: Items ki reports
reportsLink.body: Items ki reports kholta hai: kya mangwana hai, stock ki maaliyat, tez aur sust bikne wali, munafa, para hua maal aur supplier. Sirf owner aur manager dekhte hain.
reportsLink.example: Reports → Low stock batata hai ke Samsung charger kam hain aur order taqreeban Rs. 18,000 ka ho ga.

brand.title: Brand
brand.body: Woh company jis ne cheez banayi. Ek baar likh dein; agli baar list mein khud aa jaye ga.

grade.title: Quality
grade.body: Cheez kis qisam ki hai: original, company (OEM), A-grade, copy / China ya used. Is se aap aur customer ko pata rehta hai ke kya mil raha hai.
grade.example: Do iPhone charger: original Rs. 6,500 ka aur copy Rs. 1,200 ka — quality likhein taake kabhi aapas mein na milein.

outOfStock.title: Stock khatam
outOfStock.body: Sirf woh cheezein dikhata hai jin ka koi piece nahi bacha (0 ya kam).
outOfStock.example: Stock khatam → "Infinix Hot 40 cover · 0" nazar aaya: koi nahi bacha, mazeed khareedein.

name.title: Cheez ka naam
name.body: Counter par aap is cheez ko jo kehte hain. Yeh bill, label aur search mein nazar aata hai.

similar.title: Milti julti cheezein
similar.body: Naya naam likhte waqt app milte julte naam wali pehle se mojood cheezein dikhati hai, taake ek hi cheez do baar na bane.
similar.example: Aap ne "Type C cable" likha aur app ne "Type-C cable 1m · 18 piece" dikhaya: nayi banane ki bajaye wohi istemal karein.

category.title: Qisam
category.body: Cheez ki qisam: charger, cable, cover, glass, battery, repair part waghera. Reports aur filter isi se cheezon ko group karte hain.
category.example: 20,000 mAh power bank "Power bank" mein jaye ga; repair ki screen "Repair part" mein.

price.title: Bechne ki qeemat
price.body: Aam customer ke liye ek piece ki qeemat. Sale screen yeh khud likh deti hai; counter par aap phir bhi badal sakte hain.
price.example: Bechne ki qeemat Rs. 1,800 → 2 charger lene wale customer ka bill Rs. 3,600.

qty.title: Stock mein
qty.body: Abhi dukan mein kitne piece hain: jo kuch khareeda aur shamil kiya, us mein se becha, repair mein laga ya nikala hua kam kar ke.
qty.example: 20 cable khareede, 7 beche, 1 repair mein laga → stock mein 12.

reorder.title: Reorder at
reorder.body: Jab ginti is number tak ya is se neeche aa jaye to cheez low stock mein dikhti hai aur order ki list mein aa jati hai.
reorder.example: Reorder at 5: jab 5 ya kam Samsung charger bachein to yeh Low stock mein nazar aayein ge.

openingQty.title: Opening qty
openingQty.body: Is cheez ke woh piece jo app shuru karne se pehle hi dukan mein thay. Ek baar likh dein; abhi koi paisa nahi diya jata.
openingQty.example: Shelf par 30 purane cover → Opening qty 30.

openingCost.title: Ek ki laagat
openingCost.body: Un purane piece mein se ek aap ko kitne ka para. Munafa aur stock ki maaliyat isi se nikalti hai.
openingCost.example: 30 purane cover Rs. 250 fi piece khareede → Cost each 250; stock value Rs. 7,500.

color.title: Rang
color.body: Is cheez ka rang, agar aap rang alag alag rakhte hain.
color.example: iPhone 13 silicone cover: Black aur Blue do alag cheezein.

compatible.title: Kis phone par lagta hai
compatible.body: Yeh cheez kin phones ke liye hai. Is se customer ke phone ke liye sahi cover, glass ya battery dhoondna aasaan hota hai.
compatible.example: Glass protector · Fits: Samsung A15, A25.

size.title: Size / variant
size.body: Size aur woh tafseel jo ek hi cheez ke do version alag kare: size, capacity, connector, watt aur rang, ek saath.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.body: Yeh kitna rakhta hai: battery aur power bank ke liye mAh, memory card aur USB ke liye GB.
capacity.example: Power bank 10,000 mAh; memory card 64 GB.

connector.title: Connector
connector.body: Cable, charger ya handsfree ki pin ki qisam.

wattage.title: Watt
wattage.body: Charger kitni tezi se charge karta hai, us par W mein likha hota hai.
wattage.example: Samsung super fast charger 25W; normal charger 10W.

warrantyBy.title: Warranty kis ki
warrantyBy.body: Kharab hone par kaun theek kare ya badle: aap ki dukan, ya woh supplier jis se aap ne khareeda.
warrantyBy.example: Anker power bank, warranty Supplier ki: kharab ho to aap ise Hall Road wale dealer ko wapas bhejein ge.

warrantyTerms.title: Warranty ki shartein
warrantyTerms.body: Warranty ki mukhtasar shartein, apne alfaaz mein.
warrantyTerms.example: Sirf badla jaye ga, paani ya tooti pin par nahi.

piecesInBox.title: Ek dabbe mein piece
piecesInBox.body: Is cheez ke ek dabbe mein kitne piece aate hain. Dabbe ke hisaab se khareedein to app khud piece gin leti hai. Khali = dukan ka aam dabba.
piecesInBox.example: Glass protector ke ek dabbe mein 25 piece → 2 dabbe khareedne se 50 piece shamil hon ge.

piecesInCarton.title: Ek carton mein piece
piecesInCarton.body: Is cheez ke ek carton mein kitne piece aate hain. Carton se khareeda hua maal piece mein gina jata hai. Khali = dukan ka aam carton.
piecesInCarton.example: Cable ke ek carton mein 200 piece → 1 carton se stock mein 200 piece aayein ge.

pricing.title: Qeemat ka tareeqa
pricing.body: Fixed price: bechne ki qeemat aap khud likhte hain. Markup on cost: app khareed qeemat mein aap ka % jor kar qeemat lagati hai, har khareedari ke baad dobara.
pricing.example: Markup 40% aur charger Rs. 500 ka → bechne ki qeemat Rs. 700. Agla maal Rs. 550 ka aaya → Rs. 770.

markupPct.title: Markup %
markupPct.body: Ausat khareed qeemat par kitna % jor kar bechne ki qeemat bane. App ise qareeb tareen Rs. 10 par kar deti hai.
markupPct.example: Laagat Rs. 340, markup 50% → 510 → bechne ki qeemat Rs. 510.

wholesale.title: Wholesale qeemat
wholesale.body: Dealer aur wholesale customers ke liye kam qeemat. Jab sale par customer "Dealer / wholesale" ho to yehi qeemat khud aa jati hai.
wholesale.example: Retail Rs. 1,800, wholesale Rs. 1,450: Hafeez Centre ka dukandar jo wholesale likha hai use Rs. 1,450 mile ga.

minPrice.title: Kam se kam qeemat
minPrice.body: Sab se kam qeemat jis par staff bech sakta hai. Is se kam par owner ya manager ki ijazat chahiye. Khareed qeemat se kam par sirf owner ya manager bech sakta hai.
minPrice.example: Kam se kam Rs. 1,500: salesman Rs. 1,400 likhe to manager ki ijazat chahiye.

promo.title: Promo qeemat
promo.body: Khaas offer ki qeemat. Offer ki tareekhon ke beech yeh sab ke liye sale screen par aati hai, aam ya wholesale qeemat se pehle.
promo.example: Eid offer: 5 se 12 April tak cover Rs. 1,299 ki bajaye Rs. 999.

promoDates.title: Offer kab se / kab tak
promoDates.body: Offer ki qeemat ka pehla aur aakhri din. "Kab se" khali = abhi se; "kab tak" khali = koi aakhri din nahi.
promoDates.example: 5 April se 12 April tak: 13 April ko qeemat phir Rs. 1,299 ho jaye gi.

taxRate.title: GST %
taxRate.body: Optional. Jab sale par tax ho to is item par bill ke rate ki bajaye is ka apna GST % lagta hai; phone aur baghair rate wale item par bill ka rate. Baghair tax ki sale par tax nahi lagta.
taxRate.example: Bill par 18% tax: phone Rs. 10,000 → Rs. 1,800; do cable Rs. 1,000 ki, GST 5% → Rs. 100. Bill ka tax Rs. 1,900.

taxIncl.title: Qeemat mein tax shamil
taxIncl.body: On: bechne ki qeemat mein tax pehle se shamil hai. Off: tax qeemat ke oopar lage ga.
taxIncl.example: Qeemat Rs. 1,180 jis mein 18% shamil → Rs. 1,000 qeemat + Rs. 180 tax.

maxStock.title: Ziyada se ziyada stock
maxStock.body: Ziyada se ziyada kitne piece rakhne hain. Order ki list isi number tak khareedne ka mashwara deti hai. Khali = "Reorder at" ka teen guna.
maxStock.example: Maximum 30, 6 bache → order ki list 24 piece ka mashwara de gi.

location.title: Shelf / rack
location.body: Dukan mein yeh cheez kahan rakhi hai, taake koi bhi jaldi dhoond le.
location.example: Rack 2, oopar wali shelf; counter ki daraz.

showInSale.title: Sale screen par dikhayein
showInSale.body: Off: cheez stock mein rehti hai magar sale screen par nazar nahi aati. Sirf repair mein lagne wale parts ke liye.
showInSale.example: Repair ke liye rakhi Infinix Hot 40 ki screen → ise off karein taake sale mein nazar na aaye.

supplierSkus.title: Supplier ke code
supplierSkus.body: Har dealer apne bill par is cheez ke liye jo code likhta hai. Woh code likhein ya scan karein to app yehi cheez dhoond leti hai.
supplierSkus.example: Hall Road wala dealer ise "SC-25W" kehta hai: yahan save karein to us ke bill ki line isi charger se mil jaye gi.

supplierSku.title: Supplier ka code
supplierSku.body: Us dealer ke bill ya dabbe par is cheez ka likha hua code.

detail.title: Cheez ka page
detail.body: Ek cheez ki har baat: kitne hain, qeematein, laagat, khareedari ke batch aur har aana jana.
detail.example: Samsung 25W charger: stock mein 12, Rs. 1,800 mein bikta hai, laagat Rs. 1,200 fi piece, aakhri baar Ali Traders se khareeda.

adjust.title: Stock durust karein
adjust.body: Jab ginti shelf se na mile to haath se durust karein: mile hue piece shamil karein ya kharab / gum shuda nikalein. Wajah likhna zaroori hai aur tabdeeli history mein rehti hai.
adjust.example: App 12 batati hai, shelf par 10 hain kyunke 2 toot gaye → −2 karein, wajah "damaged".

delta.title: Tabdeeli (+/−)
delta.body: Kitne piece shamil (+) ya kam (−) karne hain.
delta.example: Do toote cover ke liye −2; godam mein mile teen cable ke liye +3.

adjustCost.title: Ek ki laagat
adjustCost.body: Sirf piece shamil karte waqt: shamil kiya gaya ek piece kitne ka hai. Khali = abhi ki ausat laagat.
adjustCost.example: +3 cable, ek ki laagat Rs. 150 → stock ki maaliyat Rs. 450 barh jaye gi.

reason.title: Wajah
reason.body: Ginti kyun badli gayi. Yeh tabdeeli ke saath mehfooz rehti hai taake owner baad mein dekh sake.
reason.example: Baarish mein kharab hue; stock ginne ke baad durusti.

labels.title: Sticker print
labels.body: Is cheez ke barcode sticker print karta hai, piece ya shelf par lagane ke liye. Sticker scan karne se cheez foran mil jati hai.
labels.example: Naye cables ke liye 20 sticker print karein; sale par ek scan karein to cable bill mein aa jaye ga.

makeUnit.title: Ek ko serial se rakhein
makeUnit.body: Ginti wali watches aur tablets ke liye: ginti se ek piece nikal kar use alag unit banata hai, apne serial, history, barcode aur qeemat ke saath.
makeUnit.example: 5 smart watch ikathi gini hui; ek warranty card ke saath bikni hai → use unit banayein taake us ka serial record mein rahe.

avgCost.title: Ausat laagat
avgCost.body: Ek piece ki ausat khareed qeemat, har khareedari ki apni qeemat se nikali gayi. Sirf owner aur manager dekhte hain.
avgCost.example: 10 piece Rs. 400 mein aur 10 piece Rs. 500 mein khareede → ausat laagat Rs. 450.

profitEach.title: Ek par munafa
profitEach.body: Ek piece ki bechne ki qeemat mein se ausat laagat; % us munafe ka laagat se muqabla hai.
profitEach.example: Rs. 1,800 mein bikta hai, ausat laagat Rs. 1,200 → ek par Rs. 600 munafa, 50%.

stockValue.title: Stock ki maaliyat
stockValue.body: Dukan mein pare piece aap ko kitne ke pare: stock ke piece × ausat laagat.

batches.title: Khareedari ke batch
batches.body: Is cheez ki har khareedari apni khareed qeemat ke saath, aur us mein se kitne abhi bache hain. Sale mein sab se purana batch pehle nikalta hai.
batches.example: Batch 1: 20 piece Rs. 400, 0 bache; batch 2: 20 piece Rs. 450, 12 bache → agli sale batch 2 se ho gi.

timeline.title: History
timeline.body: Is cheez ka har aana jana: khareeda, becha, wapas aaya, repair mein laga, durust kiya, aur qeemat ki tabdeeli, tareekh aur baad ki ginti ke saath.
timeline.example: 3 May Bilal ko 2 beche (= 10 bache); 5 May qeemat 1,800 → 1,700.

page.title: Items ki reports
page.body: Charger, cover aur doosri ginti wali cheezon ki reports: kya mangwana hai, stock ki maaliyat, kya bikta hai, kitna munafa hua, kya para hai, aur kis se khareedte hain.
page.example: Har mahine "Dead stock" dekhein taake woh cover milein jo 60 din se nahi bike.

low.title: Low stock (order list)
low.body: "Reorder at" tak ya us se kam wali cheezein, us supplier ke hisaab se jis se aakhri baar khareedi, aur kitni mangwani hain.
low.example: Ali Traders: Samsung charger 3 bache / 5, mangwayein 12; Type-C cable 2 bache / 5, mangwayein 13.

suggest.title: Kitne mangwayein
suggest.body: Kitne mangwane hain: cheez ke maximum stock tak (agar nahi likha to "Reorder at" ka teen guna), bache hue kam kar ke.
suggest.example: Reorder at 5, maximum nahi likha, 3 bache → 15 − 3 = 12 mangwayein.

estimate.title: Andazan laagat
estimate.body: Is supplier ka order taqreeban kitne ka ho ga: mangwane wali tadaad × cheez ki ausat laagat, sab jama.

value.title: Stock ki maaliyat
value.body: Dukan ki tamam cheezon ki abhi ki maaliyat: laagat par (jo aap ne diya) aur bechne ki qeemat par, aur sab bik jaye to mutawaqqa munafa.
value.example: Laagat par Rs. 2,40,000, bechne ki qeemat par Rs. 3,50,000 → mutawaqqa munafa Rs. 1,10,000.

atCost.title: Laagat par
atCost.body: Har cheez ke stock ke piece × ausat laagat, sab jama.

atRetail.title: Bechne ki qeemat par
atRetail.body: Har cheez ke stock ke piece × bechne ki qeemat, sab jama.

expected.title: Mutawaqqa munafa
expected.body: Bechne ki qeemat wali maaliyat mein se laagat wali maaliyat: agar har piece poori qeemat par bike to munafa.

byCategory.title: Qisam ke hisaab se
byCategory.body: Yehi stock ki maaliyat qisam ke hisaab se: kitni cheezein aur piece, laagat par (bara number) aur bechne ki qeemat par (chhota number).
byCategory.example: Cover: 12 cheezein · 100 piece · laagat par Rs. 25,000 · bechne ki qeemat par Rs. 50,000.

movers.title: Tez / sust
movers.body: Chune hue dinon mein kin cheezon ke sab se ziyada piece bike, aur stock mein pari kin cheezon ke sab se kam.
movers.example: Pichhle 30 din: Type-C cable 60 bike (tez); Nokia 105 cover 0 bika aur 15 pare hain (sust).

fast.title: Tez bikne wali
fast.body: Woh 20 cheezein jin ke in dinon mein sab se ziyada piece bike (wapsi shamil nahi), bacha hua, munafa, aur is raftaar se stock kitne din chale ga.
fast.example: 30 din mein 60 cable bike = roz 2; 20 bache → taqreeban 10 din ka stock.

slow.title: Sust bikne wali
slow.body: Woh cheezein jo stock mein hain magar in dinon mein sab se kam bikin. Discount dene ya mazeed na khareedne ka sochein.
slow.example: Nokia 105 cover: 15 stock mein, 30 din mein 0 bika.

profit.title: Munafa
profit.body: Chune hue dinon mein biki cheezon ka munafa: jitne mein bikin us mein se laagat, qisam ya brand ke hisaab se. Wapas aaye piece aur cancel bill shamil nahi.
profit.example: Charger: 40 bike Rs. 72,000 mein, laagat Rs. 48,000 → munafa Rs. 24,000.

group.title: Qisam / brand ke hisaab se
group.body: Munafe ko kaise group karein: cheez ki qisam se, ya banane wali company se.
group.example: Brand ke hisaab se: Anker Rs. 9,000, Samsung Rs. 15,000.

dead.title: Para hua maal
dead.body: Stock ki woh cheezein jo aap ke chune hue dinon se nahi bikin (ya kabhi nahi bikin), mehngi pehle, aur un mein laagat ke hisaab se kitna paisa phansa hai.
dead.example: 60 din se nahi bike: 20 purane Infinix cover × Rs. 200 = Rs. 4,000 phanse hue.

notSoldFor.title: Kitne din se nahi bika
notSoldFor.body: Kitne din baghair sale ko para hua maal samjha jaye.
notSoldFor.example: 60 → woh cheezein jin ki aakhri sale 60 din se pehle hui, ya kabhi nahi bikin.

suppliers.title: Supplier
suppliers.body: Chune hue dinon mein har supplier se yeh cheezein kitni khareedin: bill, piece aur raqam. Wapas ki gayi lines shamil nahi.

field.title: Kaun si qeemat
field.body: Chunein ke bohat si cheezon ki kaun si qeemat ek saath badalni hai: bechne ki, wholesale ya kam se kam qeemat.
field.example: Dollar barh gaya: tamam chargers ki bechne ki qeemat 10% barhayein.

pct.title: % se badlein
pct.body: Chuni hui qeemat itne % barhayein (+) ya kam karein (−).

amount.title: Ya raqam se
amount.body: Chuni hui qeemat mein muqarrara rupay jorein (+) ya kam karein (−). Dono likhein to pehle % lage ga, phir raqam.

scope.title: Kaun si cheezein
scope.body: Tamam cheezein, ya sirf ek qisam. Har tabdeeli har cheez ki history mein rehti hai.
scope.example: Qisam "Glass protector" → sirf glass ki qeematein badlein gi.

page.title: Repair
page.body: Har phone jo repair ke liye aap ke paas hai, aur har kaam kahan hai: liya gaya, theek ho raha, tayyar ya wapas diya. Tayyar wale pehle aate hain taake customer ko call kar sakein.
page.example: Samsung A54 screen badalni · tayyar → Usman ko lene ke liye call karein.

view.title: Khule / Sab
view.body: Khule: woh kaam jo abhi wapas nahi diye. Sab: woh bhi jo wapas de diye ya baghair theek kiye lauta diye.
view.example: Khule mein 6 phone hain jo abhi dukan mein hain; Sab mein pichhle mahine ke mukammal kaam bhi.

new.title: Phone repair ke liye lein
new.body: Likhein phone kis ka hai, kaun sa phone, kya kharabi hai, andazan kharcha aur kab tayyar ho ga. Save karne par customer ke liye parchi print hoti hai.
new.example: Ahmed ka Infinix Hot 40, charging ka masla, andazan Rs. 1,500, kal tayyar → job no. R-0042 ki parchi print.

device.title: Phone ka naam
device.body: Repair ke liye chhore phone ka brand, model aur rang, taake kabhi doosre se na mile.

faults.title: Kya masla hai?
faults.body: Customer jo bhi kharabi bataye us par tap karein. Yeh parchi par print hoti hain.

faultText.title: Koi aur masla
faultText.body: Woh kharabi jo list mein nahi, apne alfaaz mein.
faultText.example: Call ke dauran speaker kharkharata hai.

estimate.title: Andazan kharcha
estimate.body: Woh qeemat jo aap repair se pehle customer ko batate hain. Yeh parchi par print hoti hai; asal bill theek hone par banta hai.
estimate.example: A54 screen ka andazan Rs. 4,500; aakhri bill Rs. 4,800 bana.

advance.title: Advance liya
advance.body: Woh paise jo customer abhi, repair se pehle deta hai. Yeh galle mein jate hain aur phone wapas dete waqt bill se kam ho jate hain.
advance.example: Bill Rs. 4,800, advance Rs. 2,000 → Rs. 2,800 lena baqi.

promised.title: Kab tayyar ho ga
promised.body: Woh din jab aap phone tayyar hone ka waada karte hain. Is din ke baad kaam late dikhta hai.
promised.example: Jumma ka waada, hafte ko bhi theek nahi hua → kaam laal ho kar late dikhe ga.

received.title: Phone ke saath liya
received.body: Woh cheezein jo customer phone ke saath chhor gaya. Yeh parchi par print hoti hain taake sab wapas dein.
received.example: Phone ke saath SIM + memory card + cover rakha.

job.title: Repair ka kaam
job.body: Ek repair: customer, kharabiyan, kaam kahan hai, bill aur har qadam kis ne kiya.
job.example: R-0042 · Ahmed · Infinix Hot 40 · theek ho raha · bill Rs. 1,500, advance Rs. 500.

stages.title: Repair ke marhale
stages.body: Har repair ke chaar qadam: liya gaya → theek ho raha → tayyar → wapas diya. Gehri pattiyan batati hain kaam kahan tak pohncha.
stages.example: Teen pattiyan gehri = tayyar; customer ko call karein.

steps.title: Kaam aage barhayein
steps.body: "Theek ho gaya" bill kholta hai (parts aur kaam ki ujrat) aur phone tayyar kar deta hai. "Theek karna shuru" aur "parts ka intezar" sirf marhala badalte hain; "theek nahi ho sakta" baghair repair band karta hai.
steps.example: Hall Road se screen mangwayi → parts ka intezar; screen lag gayi → theek ho gaya, bill Rs. 4,800.

bill.title: Repair ka bill
bill.body: Lage hue parts aur kaam ki ujrat mil kar total bante hain; advance kam ho kar jo bache woh customer se lena hai. Bill banne se pehle andazan kharcha dikhta hai.
bill.example: Screen Rs. 3,800 + ujrat Rs. 1,000 = Rs. 4,800; advance Rs. 2,000 → baqi Rs. 2,800.

labour.title: Kaam ki ujrat
labour.body: Aap apne kaam ke jo paise lete hain, parts ke ilawa. Yeh repair ki aamdani hai.
labour.example: Battery Rs. 2,500 + ujrat Rs. 500 → bill Rs. 3,000.

total.title: Total
total.body: Parts aur kaam ki ujrat: is repair ka poora bill.

left.title: Lena baqi
left.body: Customer ne abhi kitne dene hain: total mein se advance kam kar ke.

paid.title: Ada kiya
paid.body: Is repair ke liye customer ne jo kuch diya: advance aur phone wapas lete waqt diye paise. Jo nahi diya woh us ke khate mein hai.
paid.example: Advance Rs. 2,000 + wapsi par Rs. 2,000 = Rs. 4,000 ada; Rs. 800 khate mein.

history.title: History
history.body: Is kaam ka har qadam tareekh aur karne wale ke naam ke saath.
history.example: 2 May liya gaya (Ali) · 3 May parts ka intezar · 4 May tayyar (Bilal).

part.title: Part
part.body: Phone mein lagaya gaya part. Neeche apne stock se chunein, ya naam likhein.

partPrice.title: Part ki qeemat
partPrice.body: Is part ke ek ke aap customer se kitne lete hain.

fromStock.title: Stock se parts
fromStock.body: Apne stock ki kisi cheez par tap karein to woh part mein aa jaye gi (number batata hai kitne hain). Phone wapas dete waqt woh piece apni laagat par stock se nikal jata hai.
fromStock.example: + Hot 40 battery (4) → Rs. 2,500 par shamil; wapsi par stock 3 ho jaye ga.

outsideCost.title: Bahar ke mistri ko diya
outsideCost.body: Dukan ke apne phone ke liye: use theek karwane ke liye doosre mistri ko jo diya. Yeh us phone ki laagat mein jur jata hai.
outsideCost.example: Aap ka iPhone 11 Rs. 70,000 ka tha; bahar repair Rs. 3,000 → us ki laagat Rs. 73,000.

page.title: Qistein
page.body: Har qiston wali sale: kaun kitne aur kab deta hai. Dekhne ka tareeqa chunein: aaj ki, late, chal rahi ya mukammal.
page.example: Kamran ne Samsung A15 ki 6 qistein Rs. 6,000 ki lein; aakhri qist tak woh yahan nazar aaye ga.

today.title: Aaj ki
today.body: Chalte plan jin ki agli qist aaj hai ya tareekh guzar chuki hai.
today.example: Kamran ki qist 10 tareekh ko thi; aaj 10 hai → woh yahan hai.

overdue.title: Late
overdue.body: Chalte plan jin ki kam az kam ek qist ki tareekh guzar gayi aur poori ada nahi hui.
overdue.example: 5 tareekh ko thi, aaj 12 hai aur kuch nahi diya → 7 din ki der.

active.title: Chal rahi
active.body: Tamam plan jin ki abhi raqam baqi hai.
active.example: 6 mein se 3 qistein di gayin → chal rahi.

closed.title: Mukammal
closed.body: Woh plan jo poore ada ho chuke.
closed.example: Rs. 6,000 ki tamam 6 qistein mil gayin → mukammal.

plan.title: Qiston ka plan
plan.body: Ek customer ka qiston ka plan: bill, kitna diya aur kitna baqi, har mahine ki tareekh aur raqam, aur zamin.
plan.example: Samsung A15 Rs. 46,000 ka: advance Rs. 10,000, phir har mahine ki 10 tareekh ko 6 × Rs. 6,000.

total.title: Total
total.body: Qiston par beche gaye bill ki poori raqam.
total.example: Samsung A15 qiston par Rs. 46,000 ka.

paid.title: Ada hua
paid.body: Is bill par ab tak milne wala sab: advance aur qistein.

remaining.title: Baqi
remaining.body: Abhi kitna milna hai: total mein se ada hua kam kar ke.

planLine.title: Plan
planLine.body: Sale par diya gaya advance, kitni mahana qistein kitni raqam ki, aur mahine ki kis tareekh ko.
planLine.example: Advance Rs. 10,000 · 6 × Rs. 6,000 · har mahine ki 10 tareekh.

collect.title: Qist lein
collect.body: Is mahine ke paise wasool karein. Yeh bill par aam payment hai: galla ya account barhta hai aur baqi kam hota hai.
collect.example: Kamran Easypaisa se Rs. 6,000 deta hai → baqi Rs. 24,000 se Rs. 18,000.

remind.title: WhatsApp par yaad dehani
remind.body: Customer ko wajib qist ka WhatsApp message bhejta hai. Agar WhatsApp bhejna set nahi to WhatsApp message ke saath khulta hai aur aap send dabate hain.
remind.example: 10 tareekh se ek din pehle Kamran ko yaad karayein: "10 June ko Rs. 6,000 ki qist".

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: Har qist apni tareekh aur raqam ke saath, aur yeh ke ada hui, kuch ada, aaj, late ya abhi aani hai.
schedule.example: 10 May Rs. 6,000 Paid · 10 June Rs. 6,000 Part (Rs. 2,000 mile) · 10 July Due.

guarantor.title: Customer aur zamin
guarantor.body: Qistein kaun deta hai, aur woh zamin jis ne waada kiya ke customer na de to woh de ga. Yahan se call ya WhatsApp karein.
guarantor.example: Kamran 0300-1234567; zamin us ka bhai Imran 0321-7654321.

nextDue.title: Agli qist
nextDue.body: Agli qist ki tareekh jo abhi poori ada nahi hui.

amount.title: Raqam
amount.body: Customer abhi kitne deta hai. Yeh agli qist se shuru hoti hai; aap baqi raqam tak kam ya ziyada le sakte hain.
amount.example: Qist Rs. 6,000, woh Rs. 4,000 laya → 4,000 likhein; woh mahina Part dikhe ga.

page.title: Kharche
page.body: Dukan ka woh kharcha jo maal nahi: kiraya, bill, tankhwah, chai, kiraya bhara. Har kharcha galle se nikalta hai; kharchon ke baad munafa ise kam karta hai. Din bhi yahin band karein.
page.example: Aaj bijli ka bill Rs. 8,000 aur chai Rs. 300 → Rs. 8,300 ka kharcha.

dayClose.title: Din band karein
dayClose.body: Raat ko galle ki naqdi ginein aur likhein. App ise us se milati hai jo hona chahiye aur farq save karti hai. Ek din ek baar band hota hai.
dayClose.example: App Rs. 52,000 batati hai, aap Rs. 51,500 ginte hain → us din Rs. 500 kam save ho ga.

opening.title: Shuru ki naqdi
opening.body: Din shuru hote waqt galle mein naqdi: kal raat galle ka balance.
opening.example: Kal raat galle mein Rs. 20,000 bache → aaj ki shuru ki naqdi Rs. 20,000.

in.title: Naqdi aayi
in.body: Aaj galle mein aane wali tamam naqdi: sale, logon se mili raqam, advance waghera.
in.example: Sale Rs. 35,000 + udhaar wasool Rs. 5,000 = Rs. 40,000 aayi.

out.title: Naqdi gayi
out.body: Aaj galle se nikalne wali tamam naqdi: kharche, naqd khareeda maal, dealers ko payment, wapsi.
out.example: Kharcha Rs. 3,000 + dealer ko Rs. 5,000 = Rs. 8,000 gayi.

expected.title: Galle mein hona chahiye
expected.body: Abhi galle mein kitna hona chahiye: shuru ki naqdi + aayi − gayi.

counted.title: Gini hui naqdi
counted.body: Abhi galle mein jo naqdi aap waqai ginte hain, note aur sikke.

difference.title: Farq
difference.body: Gini hui mein se honi chahiye wali. Minus ka matlab naqdi kam hai; plus ka matlab ziyada hai.

category.title: Qisam
category.body: Paise kis cheez par kharch hue. Reports kharchon ko qisam ke hisaab se jama karti hain.

categories.title: Aqsaam
categories.body: Kharche ki qismon ki list. Pehle se bani rehti hain; apni banayi hui ka naam badal ya hata sakte hain.

categoryName.title: Qisam ka naam
categoryName.body: Apni kharche ki qisam ka naam.

description.title: Tafseel
description.body: Chand alfaaz ke yeh kya tha, taake baad mein yaad rahe.
description.example: June ka bijli ka bill; Ali ka Eid bonus.

all.title: Sab
all.body: Aap ki khata book ka har shakhs: customer, dealer, doosri dukanein aur mistri.

customer.title: Customer
customer.body: Woh log jo aap se khareedte hain, ya apna used phone aap ko bechte hain.

supplier.title: Dealer
supplier.body: Wholesaler aur distributor jin se aap maal khareedte hain.

shop.title: Doosri dukanein
shop.body: Doosri mobile dukanein jin se aap khareedte, bechte ya phone udhaar dete hain.
shop.example: Saath wali Madina Mobiles ne 2 phone udhaar liye → doosri dukan.

balance.title: Balance wale
balance.body: Sirf woh log jin ka khata saaf nahi: unhon ne dena hai, ya aap ne dena hai.
balance.example: Bilal ne Rs. 12,000 dene hain aur aap ne Ali Traders ko Rs. 50,000 → dono yahan hain.

detail.title: Shakhs ka khata
detail.body: Ek shakhs ka page: balance, paise aana jana, len-den, us se khareede ya use beche phone, aur khate ki poori history.
detail.example: Bilal: Rs. 12,000 lene hain; use 2 phone beche; khate ki history mein har bill aur payment.

balance.title: Balance
balance.body: Poora khata ek number mein: is shakhs ke saath har bill, payment, len-den aur shuru ka balance. "Main ne lene hain" yaani us ne dene hain; "main ne dene hain" yaani aap ne dene hain.
balance.example: Use Rs. 40,000 ka phone becha, us ne Rs. 28,000 diye → main ne Rs. 12,000 lene hain.

unitsReceivable.title: Unhon ne dena (phones)
unitsReceivable.body: Balance mein se, is shakhs ko beche phones par abhi jo baqi hai, har phone ka jama.
unitsReceivable.example: Use A15 (Rs. 8,000 baqi) aur Redmi (Rs. 4,000 baqi) beche → Rs. 12,000.

unitsPayable.title: Hum ne dena (phones)
unitsPayable.body: Balance mein se, is shakhs se khareede phones par abhi aap ne jo dena hai.
unitsPayable.example: Us se iPhone 12 Rs. 85,000 mein khareeda, Rs. 60,000 diye → Rs. 25,000.

other.title: Deegar / shuru ka
other.body: Balance ka woh hissa jo phones par nahi: purani diary ka shuru ka balance, charger cover jaisi cheezein, len-den aur durustiyan.
other.example: Balance Rs. 15,000, phones Rs. 12,000 → deegar Rs. 3,000 (purani diary ka udhaar).

kinds.title: Qisam
kinds.body: Yeh shakhs dukan ke liye kya hai: customer, dealer, doosri dukan ya mistri. Ek shakhs ek se ziyada ho sakta hai.
kinds.example: Madina Mobiles: doosri dukan aur dealer, kyunke aap un se khareedte bhi hain aur bechte bhi.

gotMoney.title: Paise mile
gotMoney.body: Yeh shakhs apne bills ka baqaya dene ke liye jo paise deta hai. Us ka khata kam hota hai. Baghair bill ke qarz ke liye neeche len-den istemal karein.
gotMoney.example: Bilal ne Rs. 12,000 dene hain aur Rs. 5,000 deta hai → ab Rs. 7,000 baqi.

gaveMoney.title: Paise diye
gaveMoney.body: Is shakhs se khareedari ka baqaya ada karne ke liye aap jo paise dete hain. Aap ka dena kam hota hai. Baghair bill ke qarz ke liye neeche len-den istemal karein.
gaveMoney.example: Aap ne Ali Traders ko Rs. 50,000 dene hain aur Rs. 20,000 diye → ab Rs. 30,000 baqi.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Alag WhatsApp number, agar is shakhs ka mobile number se mukhtalif ho.

city.title: Shehar
city.body: Woh shehar jahan yeh shakhs ya dukan hai. Doosre sheharon ke dealers ke liye kaam ka hai.

statement.title: Khate ki history
statement.body: Is shakhs ke khate ka har indraaj, naya pehle, aur us ke baad ka balance. Cancel indraaj par lakeer hoti hai. Use bhejne ke liye download karein.

wholesale.title: Dealer / wholesale customer
wholesale.body: On: is shakhs ko cheezein bechte waqt aam qeemat ki bajaye wholesale qeemat aati hai.
wholesale.example: Charger retail Rs. 1,800, wholesale Rs. 1,450 → is dealer ka bill Rs. 1,450.

journey.title: Safar
journey.body: Dukan ke saath is shakhs ki poori kahani: beche aur khareede phone, dono taraf paise, wapsi, munafa aur balance. Koi din chunein to us din ki tasveer. Sirf owner aur manager.
journey.example: January 2025 se: use 4 phone beche, 2 khareede, Rs. 1,60,000 mile, balance Rs. 12,000.

firstLast.title: Pehla / aakhri len-den
firstLast.body: Is shakhs ke saath kisi bhi bill, payment ya wapsi ka pehla aur sab se taaza din.

soldTo.title: Unhein beche
soldTo.body: Is shakhs ko beche phone (wapas aaye shamil nahi), bills ki tadaad aur wapsi ke baad un ki raqam.

boughtFrom.title: Un se khareede
boughtFrom.body: Is shakhs se khareede phone (wapas kiye shamil nahi), bills ki tadaad aur un ki raqam.

received.title: Paise mile
received.body: Is shakhs ne aap ko jo bhi paise diye: bill bante waqt counter par, aur baad mein laayi gayi payments.
received.example: Counter par Rs. 1,20,000 · baad mein Rs. 40,000 → Rs. 1,60,000.

paid.title: Paise diye
paid.body: Aap ne is shakhs ko jo bhi paise diye: khareedte waqt counter par, aur baad ki payments.
paid.example: Counter par Rs. 70,000 · baad mein Rs. 25,000 → Rs. 95,000.

profitOnSales.title: Sale par munafa
profitOnSales.body: Is shakhs ko beche phones par (wapas nahi aaye): bechne ki qeemat mein se phone ki laagat, sab jama.
profitOnSales.example: A15 Rs. 46,000 mein becha jo Rs. 41,000 ka tha → Rs. 5,000 munafa.

profitOnSourced.title: Un ke phones par munafa
profitOnSourced.body: Is shakhs se khareede phone jo baad mein kisi ko bhi beche: kitne bike aur un par kitna munafa hua.
profitOnSourced.example: Us se 2 iPhone khareede; 1 laagat se Rs. 8,000 ziyada mein bika → 1 bika, Rs. 8,000.

returns.title: Wapsi
returns.body: Is shakhs ne kitni baar phone wapas kiya, ya aap ne use wapas kiya, raqam, aur use kitne wapas diye.
returns.example: 1 wapsi Rs. 40,000 ki; use Rs. 38,000 wapas diye (dukan ne Rs. 2,000 rakhe).

balance.title: Balance
balance.body: Chune hue din ka khate ka balance (koi din na chunein to aaj): us ne dena hai, aap ne dena hai, ya barabar.
balance.example: 30 June ko: us ne Rs. 20,000 dene thay; aaj Rs. 12,000.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.body: Is shakhs ke saath har bill, payment aur wapsi, tarteeb se. Kisi par tap karein to khule ga.
timeline.example: 3 January sale S-0102 Rs. 46,000 · 10 January wasool Rs. 10,000.

units.title: Phones
units.body: Is shakhs se khareeda ya use becha har phone: tay qeemat, kitna diya aur kitna abhi dena ya lena hai. Phone par tap karein to khule ga; button isi ek phone ki payment leta hai.
units.example: iPhone 12 Rs. 85,000 mein khareeda · Rs. 60,000 diye · Rs. 25,000 dene baqi.

moreDetails.title: Mazeed tafseel
moreDetails.body: Shuru ke liye naam, phone aur qism kaafi hain. CNIC (ya us ki photo), shehar, pata, notes ya wholesale rate daalna ho to ye tick karein.
moreDetails.example: Naya aam customer: sirf naam aur phone. Dealer: tick kar ke wholesale rate on karein.

title.title: Len-den
title.body: Baghair bill ke is shakhs ko diye ya us se liye paise, qarz ki tarah. Yeh isi khate ka hissa hai, aur number batata hai is mein se kitna abhi khula hai.
title.example: Bilal ko Rs. 10,000 diye, us ne Rs. 4,000 lautaye → len-den khula Rs. 6,000 (us ne dena hai).

due.title: Wapsi ki tareekh
due.body: Khule len-den mein sab se pehli waada ki gayi wapsi ki tareekh: kab hai, kitne din der, aur aakhri yaad dehani kab hui.
due.example: 1 June ko wapsi ka waada, aaj 4 June → 3 din ki der.

remind.title: Yaad dehani bhejein
remind.body: Is shakhs ko us ke wajib paison ka WhatsApp message bhejta hai. Agar khud ba khud bhejna set nahi to WhatsApp message ke saath khulta hai. Agar udhaar ki yaad dehani on ho to raat ka kaam bhi wajib hone par, ziyada se ziyada har 3 din, yaad karata hai.
remind.example: Bilal 3 din late hai → yaad dehani: "Rs. 6,000 ki wapsi 1 June ko thi".

lent.title: Diye
lent.body: Dukan ne is shakhs ko len-den mein jo bhi paise diye (cancel shamil nahi).
lent.example: March mein Rs. 10,000 aur May mein Rs. 5,000 diye → Rs. 15,000.

borrowed.title: Liye
borrowed.body: Dukan ne is shakhs se len-den mein jo bhi paise liye, qarz ki wapsi samait (cancel shamil nahi).
borrowed.example: Us ne qarz mein se Rs. 4,000 lautaye → Rs. 4,000 liye.

fromBills.title: Bills se
fromBills.body: Khate ke balance ka woh hissa jo bills aur payments se hai, len-den se nahi: balance mein se khula len-den.
fromBills.example: Balance Rs. 18,000, khula len-den Rs. 6,000 → bills se Rs. 12,000.

give.title: Paise diye (len-den)
give.body: Dukan is shakhs ko baghair bill ke jo paise deti hai, qarz ki tarah, woh likhein. Yeh us ke khate mein jate hain; wapsi ki tareekh bhi likh sakte hain.
give.example: Bilal ko galle se Rs. 10,000 diye, 1 June ko wapsi.

take.title: Paise liye (len-den)
take.body: Dukan is shakhs se baghair bill ke jo paise leti hai woh likhein: woh aap ko qarz de, ya apna qarz lautaye.
take.example: Madina Mobiles ne aap ko ek hafte ke liye Rs. 50,000 diye → paise liye Rs. 50,000.

settle.title: Bills se milayein
settle.body: Pehle se advance ya len-den mein diye paise khule bill ada kar sakte hain: us ke paise us ke unpaid sale bills par, dukan ke paise us ke unpaid khareedari bills par, purana pehle. Khate ka total nahi badalta; sirf bill ada dikhte hain.
settle.example: Us ne Rs. 10,000 len-den diye aur Rs. 8,000 ka bill baqi hai → milayein: bill ada ho gaya, Rs. 2,000 len-den mein rahe.

entries.title: Len-den ke indraaj
entries.body: Is shakhs ke saath taaza len-den: diye (−) ya liye (+), tareekh aur note. Cancel par lakeer hoti hai. Wapsi ki tareekh lagane ya badalne ke liye tareekh wali line par tap karein.

dueDate.title: Wapsi ki tareekh
dueDate.body: Jis din paise wapas aane chahiye. Koi tareekh na ho to khali chhor dein. Is din ke baad indraaj late dikhta hai aur yaad dehani ja sakti hai.
dueDate.example: 15 June likhein; 16 June ko "1 din ki der" dikhe ga.

category.title: Device ki qisam
category.body: Mobile, tablet ya smart watch. Har qisam sirf apni cheezen poochti hai: watch mein storage nahi, Wi-Fi tablet mein IMEI nahi.
category.example: iPad khareeda: Tablet dabayen, phir Wi-Fi only ya Wi-Fi + SIM chunen.

connection.title: Kya is mein SIM lagti hai?
connection.body: Jis tablet ya watch mein SIM lagti ho woh phone ki tarah check hoti hai: IMEI aur PTA status chahiye. Baghair SIM wali serial number se pehchani jati hai.
connection.example: Galaxy Tab A9 sirf Wi-Fi → IMEI nahi, serial likhen. Galaxy Tab A9 LTE → Wi-Fi + SIM, IMEI likhen.

serial.title: Serial number
serial.body: Company ka is ek piece ka number, dabbe par ya Settings → About mein. Baghair SIM wali device ki pehchan yehi hai: app ise IMEI ki tarah purane stock se milati hai.
serial.example: Apple Watch SE GPS: Settings → General → About → serial "F4KXJ2Q1HQ".

imei2.title: IMEI 2
imei2.body: Do SIM wale phone ke do IMEI hote hain, har SIM ke liye ek. Dono dekhne ke liye *#06# milayen. Dabba scan karen to pehle IMEI 1 phir IMEI 2 bharta hai.
imei2.example: Infinix Hot 40: *#06# par 35xxxxxxxxxxxx1 aur 35xxxxxxxxxxxx9 → doosra yahan likhen.

brand.title: Brand
brand.body: Banane wali company. Ek dabayen; agar list mein nahi to "New brand" ise aainda ke liye bhi daal deta hai.
brand.example: Samsung, Infinix, Apple. Naya brand jaise "Itel" ek baar daalen, list mein rahega.

model.title: Model
model.body: Us brand ka sahi model. Dhoondne ke liye chand huroof likhen. Model chunne se, agar app ko maloom ho, spec sheet bhi bhar jati hai.
model.example: Brand Samsung, "A15" likhen → Galaxy A15 dabayen.

watchSize.title: Case size
watchSize.body: Watch ki body ki chaurai millimetre mein, dabbe ya peeche likhi hoti hai. Ek hi model kai size aur qeemat mein aata hai.
watchSize.example: Apple Watch Series 9: 41mm ya 45mm — 45mm aam tor par Rs. 8,000–10,000 mehngi bikti hai.

storage.title: Storage
storage.body: Phone mein kitna data aata hai (ROM), GB mein. Is se qeemat bohat badalti hai, is liye rate ki tajweez bhi isi se milati hai. "New size" kami poori karta hai.
storage.example: iPhone 13 128GB aur 256GB: ek hi phone, taqreeban Rs. 15,000 ka farq.

colour.title: Rang
colour.body: Is piece ka rang. Shelf par sahi phone dhoondne mein madad deta hai aur sticker par chhapta hai. Pehle se maujood rang likhen to wohi chun liya jata hai.
colour.example: Stock mein do Galaxy A15: ek Blue Black, ek Light Blue — customer ko light blue chahiye.

condition.title: Halat
condition.body: Box pack: naya aur seal band. Open box: naya magar seal khuli hui. Used: kisi ne istemal kiya. Patched (sirf phone): koi purza ya board badla gaya — likhen kya kiya gaya.
condition.example: Customer apna 1 saal purana Galaxy A54 bechta hai → Used. Dealer ka seal band Infinix Hot 40 → Box pack.

patch.title: Patch ki tafseel
patch.body: Patch wale phone ke andar kya badla gaya. Yeh phone ki history mein rehta hai taake agle customer ko sach bata saken.
patch.example: "Board badla hua hai, dabbe ka IMEI nahi milta" ya "China screen lagi hai".

battery.title: Battery health %
battery.body: Nayi (100%) ke muqable mein battery kitni mazboot hai. iPhone: Settings → Battery → Battery Health. iPad / watch: Settings → Battery. Bohat se Android phone yeh nahi dikhate; tab khali chhor dein.
battery.example: Purana iPhone 12 par 84% → 84 likhen. 80% se kam ho to customer kam daam deta hai.

pta.title: PTA status
pta.body: PTA approved: Pakistan mein registered, har SIM hamesha chalti hai. Non-PTA: registered nahi — Pakistani SIM kuch waqt hi chalti hai, phir PTA tax na den to phone block ho jata hai. JV: "jugaad" se chalaya gaya (patch ya kisi aur IMEI par register) — is ka bhi SIM time mehdood hai aur khareedne mein sab se zyada khatra hai.
pta.example: Dubai se aaya iPhone 13, tax nahi diya, SIM 2 mahine aur chalegi → Non-PTA, SIM time 2. JV iPhone 12 → JV, aur khareedar ko batayen.

simTime.title: SIM time (mahine)
simTime.body: Non-PTA ya JV phone mein: Pakistani SIM mazeed kitne mahine chalegi. Yeh bharna zaroori hai, aur sale ki screen khareedar ko khabardar karti hai.
simTime.example: Non-PTA Pixel 7 jis mein taqreeban 2 mahine baqi → 2 likhen. Is ke baad PTA tax tak SIM band.

warrantyMonths.title: Warranty (mahine)
warrantyMonths.body: Is piece ki kitne mahine warranty hai. Dealer se ho to 12 se shuru, customer se ho to 0. Yeh sale ki raseed par chhapti hai.
warrantyMonths.example: Box pack Galaxy A15, 12 mahine company warranty → 12. Customer ka used phone → 0.

lock.title: Lock check
lock.body: Used device khareedne se pehle dekhen ke koi account lock baqi na ho (iCloud, Google / FRP, Samsung, paired watch). Jis par lock "Still on" ho woh na khareedi ja sakti hai na bechi. Tablet aur watch mein hamesha zaroori; phone mein jab dukaan ne on kiya ho.
lock.example: Purana iPad: Find My abhi on hai → iCloud "Still on" — jab tak bechne wala na hataye app khareedne nahi degi.

activation.title: iCloud / activation lock
activation.body: Apple device par: maalik ki Apple ID abhi lagi hai (Find My). Reset ke baad wohi ID maangti hai, is liye koi aur istemal nahi kar sakta.
activation.example: Reset ke baad iPhone 11 maalik ki Apple ID maange → Still on. Bechne wala aap ke samne iCloud se sign out kare → Cleared.

frp.title: Google / FRP lock
frp.body: Android par: factory reset ke baad phone pichla Google account maangta hai. Agar bechne wale ne nahi hataya to agla khareedar phans jata hai.
frp.example: Reset ke baad Galaxy A32 par "Verify your account" → Still on. Bechne wala pehle Google account hataye → Cleared.

account.title: Samsung / account lock
account.body: Company ka apna account lock (Samsung account, Xiaomi Mi account waghera) jo reset ke baad bhi purane maalik ka account maangta hai.
account.example: Redmi Note 12 par Mi account ka password maange → Still on.

paired.title: Paired-device lock
paired.body: Smart watch jo abhi purane maalik ke phone se juri hai. Jab tak alag na ki jaye, naye phone se nahi chalti.
paired.example: Apple Watch abhi bechne wale ke iPhone se juri hai → Still on. Woh Watch app mein unpair kare → Cleared.

carrier.title: Carrier lock
carrier.body: America ya UK ke kuch phone sirf ek company ki SIM se chalte hain (maslan AT&T). "Factory unlocked" phone har SIM lete hain.
carrier.example: America ka iPhone 12 Jazz SIM par "SIM not supported" dikhaye → carrier lock Still on.

modelNumber.title: Model number
modelNumber.body: Company ka sahi version ka code, Settings → About ya dabbe par. Is se pata chalta hai kaun se mulk / version ka hai.
modelNumber.example: Galaxy A15 "SM-A155F/DS" — DS ka matlab do SIM.

ram.title: RAM (GB)
ram.body: Kaam karne wali memory jis se phone tez chalta hai. Yeh storage se alag hai. Dabbe par "8GB + 256GB" likha hota hai (pehla RAM hai).

grade.title: Grade
grade.body: Used piece kitna saaf hai, taake qeemat theek lage. Used A: taqreeban naya. Used B: nishan ya chhoti kharabi. Refurbished: marammat / dobara tayyar. Copy / China: asal brand nahi. Maalik list badal sakta hai.
grade.example: Galaxy S21 baghair kharash → Used A, Rs. 85,000. Wohi phone tooti back ke sath → Used B, Rs. 72,000.

warrantyBy.title: Warranty kis ki
warrantyBy.body: Warranty kaun poori karega: khud dukaan, jis dealer se khareeda, ya company (official service centre).
warrantyBy.example: Box pack Galaxy A15 → Company (Samsung service centre). Used iPhone par aap ki 1 mahine ki warranty → Dukaan.

specs.title: Spec sheet
specs.body: Phone ki khususiyat: screen, battery, camera waghera. Zaroori nahi. Ek model ki ek baar bhar den to usi model ka agla piece khud bhar jata hai.
specs.example: Galaxy A15 ek baar bharen (6.5", 5000 mAh, 50 MP) → agla A15 khareeden to pehle se bhara hoga.

accessoriesBuy.title: Saath kya aaya
accessoriesBuy.body: Har cheez ke liye (dabba, charger, cable…): Nahi, Haan abhi (mil gaya), ya Haan baad mein (bechne wala abhi dega — din likhen). Baad wali cheezen phone par baqi dikhti hain.
accessoriesBuy.example: Customer iPhone 13 dabbe ke sath bechta hai, charger kal layega → Dabba: Haan abhi; Charger: Haan baad mein, kal.

accessoriesSell.title: Saath kya jayega
accessoriesSell.body: Har cheez ke liye: Nahi, Haan abhi (counter par diya), ya Haan baad mein (dukaan baad mein degi — din likhen). Yeh raseed par chhapta hai taake baad mein jhagra na ho.
accessoriesSell.example: Galaxy A15 becha, cover abhi diya, asal charger agle hafte → Charger: Haan baad mein.

status.title: Abhi kahan hai
status.body: In stock, On loan (doosri dukaan), customer ke paas (dekhne ke liye), Sold, Repair mein, Kharab, ya supplier ko wapas. Har sale, amanat ya repair se khud badalta hai.
status.example: Phone Ali Mobiles ko amanat par diya → "On loan" jab tak wapas na aaye ya woh rakh len.

verification.title: ID check status
verification.body: Check zaroori nahi: dealer ka box pack phone. Check baqi: kisi shakhs se khareeda phone jis ke kaghaz poore nahi. Check ho gaya: poora, becha ja sakta hai. Chori? Na bechen: eGadget ne flag kiya — becha nahi ja sakta.
verification.example: Walk-in customer se Galaxy A54 khareeda, abhi CNIC ki photo nahi → "ID check pending".

badges.title: Is phone ke nishan
badges.body: Ek qatar mein khaas baaten: halat, grade, PTA, lock check, ID check, aur "Cycle N" jab dukaan ne yehi phone N baar khareeda ho.
badges.example: iPhone 13 · Used · Used A · Non-PTA · Locks cleared · Cycle 2 = khareeda, becha, phir wapas khareeda.

retype.title: Qisam badlen
retype.body: Ghalat qisam (phone / tablet / watch) mein mehfooz piece ko theek karta hai. Pehle Check dabayen: jo cheez fit na ho woh dikhata hai. History, IMEI / serial, barcode aur raqam waise hi rehte hain.
retype.example: Galaxy Tab Mobile mein save ho gaya → Tablet mein badlen → Check → Apply.

os.title: OS / version
os.body: Device ka software aur us ka version, Settings → About mein.

chipset.title: Processor / chipset
chipset.body: Phone ka "engine". Achha chipset yani tez game aur apps.
chipset.example: Helio G99, Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, Apple A15.

display_in.title: Screen size
display_in.body: Screen ka size inch mein, ek kone se doosre kone tak.

display_type.title: Screen ki qisam
display_type.body: Screen kis qisam ki hai. AMOLED / OLED ke rang gehre hote hain aur badlwana LCD / IPS se mehnga hai.
display_type.example: Galaxy A15: Super AMOLED; Redmi A3: IPS LCD.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.body: Screen kitni saaf hai, chaurai × lambai mein nuqte. Zyada nuqte = saaf tasweer.

refresh_hz.title: Refresh rate (Hz)
refresh_hz.body: Screen ek second mein kitni baar badalti hai. 90 ya 120 Hz, 60 Hz se zyada smooth lagta hai.

battery_mah.title: Battery (mAh)
battery_mah.body: Dabbe par likha battery ka size. Bara number aam tor par zyada chalta hai.
battery_mah.example: 5000 mAh aam istemal mein taqreeban poora din chalti hai.

expandable.title: microSD slot
expandable.body: Haan, agar zyada jagah ke liye memory card lag sakta ho.
expandable.example: Galaxy A15: Haan (1TB tak). iPhone: Nahi.

sim_type.title: SIM type
sim_type.body: Nano aam chhota card hai. eSIM andar bani hoti hai, card nahi; Pakistani eSIM company se leni parti hai.
sim_type.example: iPhone 14 (US): sirf eSIM — Jazz card ki jagah nahi.

camera_rear_mp.title: Rear camera (MP)
camera_rear_mp.body: Peeche ke main camera ke megapixel (sab se bara).

stylus_support.title: Stylus / pencil support
stylus_support.body: Haan, agar tablet pen se chalta ho.

unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.body: Screen kaise khulti hai: fingerprint, face, dono, ya sirf PIN.

port.title: Charging port
port.body: Charger cable ka socket, taake sahi cable di jaye.

fast_charge_w.title: Fast charge (W)
fast_charge_w.body: Sab se zyada charging taqat watt mein. Zyada watt = jaldi charge.
fast_charge_w.example: Galaxy A15: 25 W; Infinix Note 40: 45 W.

case_material.title: Case material
case_material.body: Watch ki body kis cheez ki hai. Steel aur titanium aluminium se mehnge hain.
case_material.example: Apple Watch Series 9: aluminium ya steel.

band_color.title: Band ka rang
band_color.body: Patte ka rang, agar watch se mukhtalif ho.

band_size.title: Band size
band_size.body: Kalai ke liye patte ka size: S, M, L ya one size.
band_size.example: Apple Watch sport band S/M patli kalai par aata hai.

compatible_with.title: Kis ke saath chalti hai
compatible_with.body: Watch kin phones se jurti hai. Apple Watch sirf iPhone se chalti hai.
