compatible_with.example: Galaxy Watch 6 → Android; Apple Watch → iOS.

sensors.title: Sensor
sensors.body: Watch sehat ki kaun si paimaish karti hai: dil ki dhadkan, SpO2 (khoon mein oxygen), neend, ECG (dil ki lay).
sensors.example: Galaxy Watch 6: dhadkan, SpO2, neend, ECG.

water.title: Water resistance
water.body: Kitna pani bardasht karta hai. IP68 / 5ATM barish aur haath dhona seh lete hain; "none" ko khushk rakhen.
water.example: Galaxy S23: IP68. Zyada tar saste phone: none.

aod.title: Always-on display
aod.body: Haan, agar watch kalai uthaye baghair har waqt time dikhaye.
aod.example: Apple Watch Series 9: Haan; SE: Nahi.

calling.title: Bluetooth calling
calling.body: Haan, agar watch par call suni ja sake (phone ke zariye).
calling.example: Rs. 8,000 wali bohat si smart watches mein Bluetooth calling hoti hai.

battery_days.title: Battery (din)
battery_days.body: Ek charge par watch kitne din chalti hai, company ke mutabiq.
battery_days.example: Apple Watch: 1 din; Huawei Watch Fit: 10 din.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
bluetooth.body: Bluetooth version, earbuds aur watch ke liye. Naya zyada mustahkam.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.body: Kaun sa Wi-Fi chalta hai. Wi-Fi 6 naye router par tez hai.

nfc.title: NFC
nfc.body: Haan, agar phone tap kar ke payment ya connect kar sake.
nfc.example: Galaxy A55: Haan — apps mein tap-to-pay chalta hai.

gps.title: GPS
gps.body: Haan, agar phone ke baghair apni location ho (naqsha, daur).

year.title: Saal
year.body: Model kis saal aaya. Purane model kam mein bikte hain.

region.title: Region code
region.body: Part number ke aakhir ke huroof batate hain ke iPhone kis mulk ke liye bana. Settings → General → About → Model Number mein dekhein (agar A2633 jaisa code dikhe to ek dafa dabayein): MLPF3LL/A → LL/A. LL/A = America, ZA/A = Singapore / Hong Kong, ZP/A = Hong Kong, CH/A = China, J/A = Japan, B/A = UK, AE/A = Dubai, HN/A = India, X/A = Australia, C/A = Canada, KH/A = Korea. List mein nahi? Naya dabayein aur likh dein.
region.example: Americi iPhone 14 Pro: Model Number MQ0D3LL/A → LL/A dabayein.

simType.title: SIM
simType.body: Phone mein SIM kaise lagti hai. Americi iPhone 14 aur us ke baad walon mein SIM tray nahi hoti (Double eSIM). Zyada tar doosre ek physical SIM aur ek eSIM lete hain. China aur Hong Kong wale do physical SIM lete hain. Phone ki side par SIM tray dekhein, aur eSIM ke liye Settings → Mobile Data. List mein nahi? Naya dabayein aur likh dein.
simType.example: LL/A iPhone 15 baghair SIM tray → Double eSIM.

cycles.title: Battery cycle count
cycles.body: Battery kul kitni dafa 0 se 100% tak charge hui. Kam ho to behtar hai: iPhone ki battery 500 cycles tak (iPhone 15 aur naye: 1000) taqreeban 80% health rakhne ke liye bani hai. iPhone 15 aur naye yeh Settings → General → About aur Settings → Battery → Battery Health mein dikhate hain. Purane iPhone phone par nahi dikhate; computer ka 3uTools jaisa tool parh leta hai. Maloom na ho to khali chhor dein.
cycles.example: Used iPhone 15 Pro, 312 cycles aur 91% health → 312 likhein; stock list mein "Battery 91% · 312 cycles" dikhega.

page.title: Stock daalen
page.body: Dukaan ke liye phone, tablet, watch ya accessories khareedna, 3 qadam mein: kis se, kya aur kitne ka, phir mukammal. Har phone ki apni history aur sticker banta hai.
page.example: Hall Road ke dealer se 3 Galaxy A15, Rs. 1,05,000 mein → stock mein aa gaye, ada na kiye to Rs. 1,05,000 us ke khate mein.

source.title: Kahan se aa raha hai
source.body: Dealer se (wholesaler, naya / box pack) ya customer se jo apna phone bech raha ho. Customer ka phone bechne se pehle ID check zaroori hai.
source.example: Distributor se Infinix ka dabba → Dealer se. Ek student apna iPhone 11 bechta hai → Customer ka phone.

fromDealer.title: Dealer se
fromDealer.body: Wholesaler ya distributor ka maal. Phone Box pack aur 12 mahine warranty se shuru hote hain, aur box pack ka ID check zaroori nahi.
fromDealer.example: Hall Road ke wholesaler se 10 Redmi A3, Rs. 22,500 fi piece.

fromCustomer.title: Customer ka phone khareeden
fromCustomer.body: Koi shakhs apna used phone bechta hai. Phone Used aur 0 warranty se shuru hote hain. Us ka CNIC aur photo rakhen (ID check) taake chori nikle to dikha saken kis ne becha.
fromCustomer.example: Customer apna Galaxy A54, Rs. 70,000 cash mein bechta hai → ID check screen par CNIC ki photos len.

dealer.title: Kaun sa dealer
dealer.body: Dealer ka khata. Jo abhi ada na karen woh wahan "dena hai" mein jur jata hai. Naya ho to + dabayen.
dealer.example: "Rehman Traders, Hall Road" chunen → is bill ke baad khate mein Rs. 2,40,000 dena hai.

seller.title: Kaun bech raha hai
seller.body: Phone bechne wala shakhs. Us ka naam aur mobile number (aur baad mein CNIC) save karen taake phone ki history mein dikhe kahan se aaya.
seller.example: Ahmed Raza, 0300 1234567, iPhone 12 bechta hai → naya shakhs, + daba kar save karen.

lines.title: Is bill ke phone
lines.body: Har phone, tablet ya watch ek ek kar ke daalen, IMEI aur qeemat ke sath. Save karne se pehle theek karne ke liye line dabayen.
lines.example: 2 Galaxy A15, Rs. 35,000 + 1 iPhone 13, Rs. 1,40,000 → 3 lines, kul Rs. 2,10,000.

items.title: Accessories / ginti wali cheezen
items.body: Charger, cover, aam ghariyan aur doosri cheezen jo ginti se rakhte hain, IMEI se nahi. Khareedne se stock mein ginti barhti hai.
items.example: 20 Type-C cable, Rs. 150 fi → cable ki ginti 20 barh gayi.

packUnit.title: Piece / darjan / dabba
packUnit.body: Chunen dealer ne kis hisaab se diya. Tadaad aur qeemat usi hisaab se; stock hamesha piece mein rehta hai.
packUnit.example: 2 darjan cover, Rs. 1,800 fi darjan → 24 piece, Rs. 150 fi piece.

miscItem.title: Doosri cheez
miscItem.body: Dealer ke bill par koi aur cheez jo stock mein nahi rakhi jati. Yeh sirf bill ke kul mein jurti hai.

unitCost.title: Fi unit qeemat
unitCost.body: Ek unit ki qeemat (ek piece, ya ek darjan / dabba agar woh chuna). Tadaad × qeemat = yeh line.

paidHow.title: Kaise ada kiya
paidHow.body: Galle se cash, bank, wallet (Easypaisa / JazzCash), ya Udhaar — baad mein denge. Udhaar mein raqam bechne wale ke khate mein "dena hai" ban jati hai.
paidHow.example: Bill Rs. 80,000 Easypaisa se bheja → Easypaisa. Abhi nahi diya → Udhaar.

idCheck.title: ID card check
idCheck.body: Abhi / baad mein: phone "ID check pending" rehta hai jab tak CNIC, photos, eGadget aur dastakhat wala kaghaz mukammal na hon. Skip, main janta hoon: phone abhi checked ho jata hai aur yeh baat history mein likhi jati hai.
idCheck.example: Purana customer Bilal apna phone bechta hai → Skip. Ajnabi → Abhi check karen.

paidNow.title: Abhi ada kiya
paidNow.body: Udhaar mein: aaj bechne wale ko kitna diya. Baqi us ke khate mein "dena hai" rehta hai.
paidNow.example: Bill Rs. 1,50,000, abhi Rs. 50,000 diye → Rs. 1,00,000 dena hai.

dueDate.title: Hum kab tak denge
dueDate.body: Jis din baqi dene ka waada kiya. Zaroori nahi. Us din ke baad audit ise late dikhata hai; tareekh na ho to sirf umar dikhata hai.
dueDate.example: Dealer se 10 tareekh ka waada → 10 ke baad overdue dikhega.

when.title: Kab khareeda
when.body: Abhi, ya Pehle — tareekh aur waqt ke sath. Pehle ki tareekh khareedari ko usi din ke hisaab aur report mein daalti hai.
when.example: Hafte ki khareedari daalna bhool gaye → Pehle, hafta shaam 5 baje.

discount.title: Bechne wale ki riayat
discount.body: Bechne wale ne poore bill se jo kam kiya. Yeh qeemat ke hisaab se lines mein bat jata hai, is liye har cheez ki laagat kam hoti hai.
discount.example: Rs. 50,000 ke 2 phone, discount Rs. 2,000 → har phone ki laagat Rs. 49,000.

reference.title: Hawala
reference.body: Koi number ya lafz jis se yeh khareedari baad mein mile, jaise dealer ki parchi ya lot number. Sirf talash ke liye.

supplierBill.title: Supplier bill no.
supplierBill.body: Dealer ke apne bill par chhapa number, taake koi sawal ho to us ke kaghaz se mila saken.

extraCosts.title: Kiraya / loading
extraCosts.body: Yeh maal laane ka kharch (courier, rickshaw, loading). Qeemat ke hisaab se lines mein bat kar har cheez ki laagat mein jurta hai, taake munafa sahi ho.
extraCosts.example: Rs. 50,000 ke 2 phone, courier Rs. 1,000 → har phone Rs. 50,500 ka.

extraNote.title: Kiraye ka note
extraNote.body: Izafi kharch kis cheez ka tha, yaad rakhne ke liye.

total.title: Kul
total.body: Sab lines jama, discount minus, kiraya jama. Is khareedari par dukaan ko itna dena hai.
total.example: Lines Rs. 1,00,000 − discount Rs. 2,000 + kiraya Rs. 500 = Rs. 98,500.

stillToGive.title: Abhi dena hai
stillToGive.body: Kul mein se abhi diya hua nikaal kar. Yeh bechne wale ke khate mein jata hai.
stillToGive.example: Kul Rs. 98,500, diye Rs. 40,000 → Rs. 58,500 dena hai.

openingTotal.title: Purane stock ka kul
openingTotal.body: Jo phone daal rahe hain un ki khareed qeematen jama. Galle se koi paisa nahi jata — sirf stock ki maliyat poori hoti hai.

cnicScan.title: CNIC scan
cnicScan.body: Shanakhti card ke samne ki photo len: app number aur naam khud parhti hai aur photo CNIC front ke tor par rakhti hai. Jo bhara ho use zaroor dekhen.
cnicScan.example: Card ki photo → "35202-1234567-1, Ahmed Raza" bhar gaya; koi hindsa ghalat ho to theek karen.

sheet.title: Qeemat ke sticker
sheet.body: Phone ya dabbe par lagane ke chhote sticker: model, qeemat, barcode aur jo aap chunen. Baad mein sticker scan karne se phone foran khul jata hai.
sheet.example: Naye Galaxy A15 ke 5 sticker → dabbon par lagayen; counter par ek scan se sahi phone.

size.title: Sticker size
size.body: Apne label roll ka size chunen (chaurai × unchai mm mein), 65 wali A4 sheet, ya apna size.

customSize.title: Apna size (mm)
customSize.body: Chaurai 20–110 mm aur unchai 10–110 mm, apne roll ke ek label se naapen.

fields.title: Is par kya ho
fields.body: Sticker par har cheez daalne ya hatane ke liye dabayen: dukaan ka naam, model, storage · rang, qeemat, barcode, IMEI, halat, PTA, tareekh, cost code.
fields.example: Chhote 38 × 25 sticker par sirf model, qeemat aur barcode rakhen.

costCode.title: Cost code
costCode.body: Khareed qeemat ek khufia 10 harfi lafz ke huroof mein, taake aap laagat parh saken magar customer nahi. Pehla harf = 0, doosra = 1, waghera. Yeh sirf maalik aur manager ko dikhta hai.
costCode.example: Lafz BLACKHORSE (B=0 L=1 A=2 C=3 K=4 H=5 O=6 R=7 S=8 E=9): laagat Rs. 45,000 → "KHBBB".

copies.title: Har ek ki copies
copies.body: Har phone ya cheez ke kitne sticker chhapne hain.
copies.example: 2 copies: ek phone par, ek dabbe par.

remember.title: Yeh intikhab yaad rakhen
remember.body: Yeh size aur cheezen agli baar ke liye rakhta hai. Maalik poori dukaan ke liye save karta hai; baqi sirf is device par.
remember.example: Ek baar 50 × 30, model, qeemat, barcode → har baar aise hi khulega.

barcode.title: Barcode
barcode.body: Is phone ka dukaan ka apna code, khareedte waqt mila aur kabhi nahi badalta. Sticker par chhapta hai; scan karne se yehi phone khulta hai.
barcode.example: Dabbe par sticker "MS000123" → counter par scan → yehi iPhone 13 sale ke liye khulta hai.

manufacturer.title: Company ka barcode
manufacturer.body: Dabbe par company ka pehle se chhapa barcode. Save karne se baad mein dabba scan kar ke yeh phone milta hai. Zaroori nahi.
manufacturer.example: Samsung dabbe ka barcode "8806095..." scan → yahan save.

ownBarcode.title: Apna barcode
ownBarcode.body: Khali chhoren to app sticker ke liye barcode banati hai. Sirf tab likhen jab aap pehle se apne code istemal karte hon. Save hone ke baad kabhi nahi badalta.
ownBarcode.example: Khali → app "MS000124" deti hai. Purana code "HR-77" → HR-77 likhen.

hint.title: Is phone ka aap ka rate
hint.body: Aap ki dukaan ne pichle 6 mahine mein yehi model kitne mein becha — pehle usi storage aur halat ka — aur abhi stock mein yehi model. "Use" darmiyani qeemat, Rs. 100 tak gol, khane mein daalta hai.
hint.example: Pichle 4 used Galaxy A15 128GB, Rs. 33,000–36,000 mein bike → "Use 34,500".

reason.title: Wajah
reason.body: Qeemat kyun badal rahi hai. Yeh phone ki history mein badalne wale ke naam ke sath save hoti hai.

ownerPin.title: Maalik ka PIN
ownerPin.body: Agar maalik ne qeemat badalne par manzoori laazmi ki ho to staff yahan maalik ka PIN likh kar ijazat leta hai.
ownerPin.example: Salesman iPhone 13 ki qeemat Rs. 1,45,000 se Rs. 1,40,000 karta hai → maalik apna 4 hindson ka PIN likhta hai.

page.title: Stock
page.body: Dukaan ka har phone, tablet aur smart watch, har ek ka ek card. Ginti wali cheezen jaise charger aur cover Accessories mein hain.
page.example: "In stock" ke neeche 12 card = abhi shelf par 12 devices.

search.title: Stock mein talash
search.body: Model, IMEI ya barcode ka kuch hissa likhen. Scanner bhi chalta hai: sticker scan karen to wohi phone foran khulta hai.
search.example: "A15" likhen → sab Galaxy A15. Aakhri hindse "4512" → woh phone jis ka IMEI 4512 par khatam ho.

brands.title: Brand
brands.body: Sirf us brand ki devices dekhne ke liye dabayen. Number batata hai list mein us brand ki kitni hain.

statusFilter.title: Kaun se phone dikhayen
statusFilter.body: In stock: aap ki shelf par. On loan: doosri dukaan ke paas amanat par. Sold: pehle bik chuke. Faulty: jin mein kharabi likhi gayi. All: har cheez.
statusFilter.example: Customer pichle hafte bike phone ka poochta hai → Sold dabayen aur IMEI talash karen.

sort.title: List ki tarteeb
sort.body: Newest / Oldest: phone ke sath aakhri kaam ke hisaab se (khareed, qeemat badli, amanat…). Price low / high: bechne ki qeemat se.
sort.example: Oldest pehle woh phone dikhata hai jinhein hafton se kisi ne nahi chheda — qeemat kam karne ka waqt.

filters.title: Mazeed filter
filters.body: Grade, RAM, qeemat ki had, ya jin devices ka lock check nahi hua, un se list chhoti karen.
filters.example: Customer ko Rs. 40,000 se kam mein 8GB RAM phone chahiye → RAM 8, price to 40000.

priceRange.title: Qeemat se / tak
priceRange.body: Sirf woh devices jin ki bechne ki qeemat in do raqmon ke beech ho. Ek khali chhoren to us taraf koi had nahi.
priceRange.example: 25000 se 35000 → har phone jis ki qeemat Rs. 25,000–35,000 ho.

lockUnchecked.title: Lock check nahi hua
lockUnchecked.body: Woh used devices jin ka lock check (iCloud, Google / FRP…) abhi save nahi, taake customer ke poochne se pehle check kar len.
lockUnchecked.example: 3 purane iPad aaye → har ek kholen, Lock check dabayen, Cleared lagayen.

card.title: Card par kya hai
card.body: Har card: model, rang aur qeemat; phir storage (ya watch size), PTA (ya Wi-Fi / GPS), halat, aur Days = aakhri kaam ko kitne din hue. Poora page kholne ke liye card dabayen.
card.example: Galaxy A15 par Days 45 = 45 din se is ke sath kuch nahi hua — sust maal.

seenBefore.title: Pehle aa chuka hai
seenBefore.body: Yeh IMEI pehle se dukaan ke record mein hai: kitni baar khareeda aur abhi kahan hai. Agar abhi stock mein ho to dobara nahi khareeda ja sakta.
seenBefore.example: Customer woh iPhone 12 lata hai jo March mein use becha → "Seen before · 1 baar khareeda", Sold — wapas khareed sakte hain.

notSeen.title: Is dukaan mein naya
notSeen.body: Yeh IMEI aap ki dukaan mein kabhi nahi aaya. Khareed sakte hain — used phone ho to ID check zaroor karen.
notSeen.example: Walk-in customer Galaxy A54 lata hai → "Not seen before" → Add stock.

newKind.title: Nayi qisam ki cheez
newKind.body: Agar cheez list ki kisi qisam mein nahi to ek baar us ki qisam likhen; phir agli cheezon ke liye bhi milegi.

itemKinds.title: Cheezon ki qismen
itemKinds.body: Sirf woh cheezen dekhne ke liye qisam dabayen, ya sab ke liye "All".

itemSearch.title: Cheez dhoondhen
itemSearch.body: Naam ka kuch hissa ya code likhen: dukaan ka barcode, company ka code ya supplier ka SKU. Scan se bhi bharta hai.

countPage.title: Stock ginti
countPage.body: Shelf ko app se milayen: har nazar aane wala phone aur cheez scan karen, phir Check dabayen. App batati hai kya ghayab hai aur kya nahi hona chahiye.
countPage.example: App kehti hai 40 phone; aap ne 39 scan kiye → 1 Missing mein apne IMEI ke sath.

countScanned.title: Scan hue
countScanned.body: Ab tak kitne code scan ya likhe. List is device par rehti hai jab tak saaf na karen, app band ho tab bhi.
countScanned.example: 25 dabbe scan, khane ka waqfa, wapas aaye → abhi bhi 25.

countType.title: Code likhen
countType.body: Agar sticker scan na ho to IMEI ya barcode likh kar Enter dabayen.

countFound.title: Mil gaye
countFound.body: Woh phone jo aap ne scan kiye aur app ke mutabiq bhi stock mein hain. Sab theek.
countFound.example: 38 mil gaye = 38 phone apni jagah par.

countMissing.title: Ghayab
countMissing.body: Woh phone jo app ke mutabiq stock mein hain magar aap ne scan nahi kiye. Unhein dhoondhen, ya dekhen kahin baghair entry ke becha ya amanat par to nahi diya.
countMissing.example: Missing: Infinix Hot 40 → saath wali dukaan ko baghair amanat entry ke diya gaya tha.

countUnexpected.title: Yahan nahi hona chahiye
countUnexpected.body: Scan kiye code jo app mein stock mein nahi: bik chuke, amanat par, ya bilkul na-maloom. Shayad koi wapsi ya khareedari darj nahi hui.
countUnexpected.example: iPhone 11 scan kiya jo "Sold" dikhata hai → us ki wapsi darj nahi hui.

countItems.title: Cheezen
countItems.body: Ginti wali cheezen jo scan kin: kitne piece scan hue aur app mein kitne hain.
countItems.example: Type-C cable: 20 mein se 18 scan → 2 cable kam.

countInStock.title: Stock mein hone chahiye
countInStock.body: App ke mutabiq abhi kitne phone "In stock" hain. Mile + Ghayab = yeh number.

detail.title: Ek phone ka page
detail.body: Is ek device ki har baat: kahan hai, qeematen, tafseel, saath ki cheezen, is par di gayi aur baqi raqam, aur pehle din se poori history.
detail.example: iPhone 13 kholen → Ahmed se Rs. 1,30,000 mein khareeda, Sana ko Rs. 1,45,000 mein becha, Rs. 5,000 lena baqi.

withParty.title: Kis ke paas
withParty.body: Woh dukaan ya shakhs jis ke paas phone abhi hai (amanat, dekhne ya repair ke liye).
withParty.example: "With: Ali Mobiles" → Ali Mobiles ke paas amanat par.

actions.title: Kaam
actions.body: Is phone ke sath abhi kya kar sakte hain. Sirf wohi dikhta hai jo halat se mel khaye: stock wala phone amanat ya repair par ja sakta hai, kharab wala theek likha ja sakta hai. Har kaam history mein save hota hai.
actions.example: Screen band ho gayi → Mark faulty. Mistri se wapas aaya → Repair returned.

deviceInfo.title: Device ki tafseel
deviceInfo.body: Is piece ki save baaten: doosra IMEI, serial, SIM time, warranty, RAM, specs, lock check, patch ki tafseel aur note. "Edit details" se theek karen.
deviceInfo.example: Warranty 12 mahine · Company — yahan aur raseed par.

accessories.title: Saath ki cheezen
accessories.body: Is phone ke sath kya aaya aur kya baqi hai: hara = saath aaya, peela = bechne wale ne abhi dena hai, laal = dukaan ne khareedar ko abhi dena hai.
accessories.example: Charger · bechne wala baad mein dega → phone bechne se pehle dealer ko yaad karayen.

history.title: History
history.body: Pehle din se is phone ka har qadam: khareeda, qeemat badli, check hua, amanat, repair, bika, wapas aaya, aur har payment. Kuch nahi mitaya jata. Peeche ka bill kholne ke liye line dabayen.
history.example: 1 October khareeda → 15 October qeemat badli → 20 October bika → 25 October Rs. 5,000 wasool.

title.title: Is phone par raqam
title.body: Is ek phone ka hisaab: laagat, bechne wale ko kitna diya aur kitna baqi, kitne mein bika, khareedar ne kitna diya aur kitna baqi, aur margin.
title.example: Laagat Rs. 60,000, dena baqi Rs. 10,000; bika Rs. 68,000, lena baqi Rs. 3,000; margin Rs. 8,000.

stillToPay.title: Abhi dena hai
stillToPay.body: Is phone ke liye dukaan ne bechne wale ko abhi kitna dena hai: khareed bill par is ki qeemat minus jo is ke liye diya gaya.
stillToPay.example: Rs. 60,000 mein khareeda, Rs. 50,000 diye → Rs. 10,000 dena hai.

askingNow.title: Abhi ki qeemat
askingNow.body: Aaj is phone par lagi bechne ki qeemat.

askingFirst.title: Pehli qeemat
askingFirst.body: Pehli baar daalte waqt ki bechne ki qeemat, kisi tabdeeli se pehle. Sirf tab dikhti hai jab baad mein qeemat badli ho.
askingFirst.example: Pehle Rs. 72,000, ab Rs. 68,000 → Rs. 4,000 kam ki.

soldFor.title: Kitne mein bika
soldFor.body: Sale bill par is phone ki qeemat, discount ka hissa nikaal kar.
soldFor.example: Rs. 70,000 ka bill, Rs. 2,000 discount, sirf yehi phone → Rs. 68,000 mein bika.

stillToGet.title: Abhi lena hai
stillToGet.body: Is phone ke liye khareedar par abhi kitna baqi: bikne ki qeemat minus jo us ne diya.
stillToGet.example: Rs. 68,000 mein bika, Rs. 65,000 mile → Rs. 3,000 lena hai.

margin.title: Margin
margin.body: Bikne ki qeemat minus laagat, sirf is phone ka. Dukaan ke kharche yahan nahi nikale jate.
margin.example: Bika Rs. 68,000 − laagat Rs. 60,000 = Rs. 8,000 margin.

bought.title: Kis se khareeda
bought.body: Yeh phone kis ne becha aur kis bill par. Khata kholne ke liye naam dabayen. Bill par aur cheezen hon to neeche ki raqmen is phone ka hissa hain.
bought.example: Rehman Traders se khareeda, bill P-0042, Rs. 1,80,000 doosri cheezon ke sath.

sold.title: Kis ko becha
sold.body: Yeh phone kis ne khareeda aur kis bill par. Khata kholne ke liye naam dabayen.
sold.example: Sana Khan ko becha, bill S-0310.

agreed.title: Tay shuda
agreed.body: Is bill par is phone ki qeemat.

paidOut.title: Diya
paidOut.body: Is phone ke liye dukaan ne jo kuch diya: bill ke waqt aur baad ki payments jo is ke bill par lagin.
paidOut.example: Usi din Rs. 30,000 + ek hafte baad Rs. 20,000 = Rs. 50,000 diye.

receivedIn.title: Wasool
receivedIn.body: Is phone ke liye khareedar ne jo kuch diya: counter par aur baad ki payments jo is ke bill par lagin.
receivedIn.example: Counter par Rs. 60,000 + baad mein Rs. 5,000 = Rs. 65,000 wasool.

upfront.title: Usi waqt
upfront.body: Bill bante din di gayi raqam. Neeche baad ki har payment apni raseed ke sath.
upfront.example: Usi waqt Rs. 30,000 · phir RV-0012, Rs. 20,000.

seller.title: Bechne wala
seller.body: Jis ne yeh phone becha, us ka CNIC number aur photos: CNIC ka aaga aur peecha, us ka chehra, aur phone. Check poora hone ke liye CNIC aur chehre wali sab cheezen zaroori hain.
seller.example: Ahmed Raza, 35202-1234567-1, counter par CNIC front, back aur us ki photo li.

photos.title: Photos
photos.body: Photo lene ke liye khana dabayen: CNIC front, CNIC back, bechne wale ka chehra, aur phone. Hara nishan yani save. Phone ki photo izafi saboot hai; baqi teen zaroori hain.
photos.example: CNIC front ✓, back ✓, seller ✓ → sirf eGadget aur dastakhat wala kaghaz baqi.

egadget.title: eGadget check
egadget.body: Punjab Police ki website jahan chori ke phone darj hote hain. Kholen, IMEI likhen, aur nateeja yahan lagayen. Check poora karne ke liye Clear zaroori; Flagged phone ki sale rok deta hai.
egadget.example: egadget.punjab.gov.pk par IMEI ka "No record found" → Clear lagayen.

egadgetRef.title: Hawala number
egadgetRef.body: eGadget site aap ki talash ka jo number dikhaye, taake saabit ho ke check kiya. Zaroori nahi.

pta.title: PTA check
pta.body: IMEI ko SMS se 8484 par bhejen; PTA jawab deta hai approved hai ya nahi. Nishan lagayen aur jo PTA ne kaha woh chunen. Yeh check ke sath save hota hai (poore check ke liye laazmi nahi).
pta.example: "356789104512345" ko 8484 par SMS → jawab "Non-compliant" → Non-PTA chunen.

declaration.title: Dastakhat shuda iqrar nama
declaration.body: Chhapa kaghaz jis mein bechne wala likhta hai ke phone us ka hai, chori ka nahi, aur dastakhat karta hai. Chhapen, dastakhat len, rakhen, phir yahan nishan lagayen. Check poora karne ke liye zaroori.
declaration.example: Print → Ahmed dastakhat karta hai → file mein rakhen → nishan.

notes.title: Zahiri halat ka note
notes.body: Khareedte waqt phone kaisa tha, taake baad mein jhagra na ho.
notes.example: "Back glass toota, Face ID chalta hai, battery 84%".

result.title: Nateeja
result.body: Clear: sab mukammal aur eGadget clear — phone becha ja sakta hai. Not checked: abhi kuch baqi hai. Flagged: eGadget mein chori darj — becha nahi ja sakta.
result.example: Sab kaghaz aur eGadget clear → Clear.

missing.title: Abhi baqi
missing.body: Check poora hone se pehle kya reh gaya: CNIC number, CNIC front, CNIC back, seller photo, eGadget clear, dastakhat shuda iqrar nama.
missing.example: Baqi: CNIC back, declaration → back ki photo len aur kaghaz par dastakhat karayen.

override.title: Maalik ki ijazat
override.body: Maalik ya manager kaghaz kam hone par bhi phone ko bechne ki ijazat de sakta hai, likhi hui wajah ke sath. Wajah aur kis ne kiya, phone ki history mein rehta hai.
override.example: Cousin se phone khareeda, CNIC ki copy nahi → override, wajah "Khandan ka jaana pehchana".

overrideReason.title: Ijazat ki wajah
overrideReason.body: Poore check ke baghair kyun clear kar rahe hain — kam az kam 5 huroof. Aisa likhen jo baad mein samjha saken.
overrideReason.example: "3 saal se mustaqil customer, CNIC dekha".

signature.title: Bechne wale ke dastakhat
signature.body: Jo banda aap ko phone bech raha hai woh screen par dastakhat karta hai ke phone us ka hai aur chori ka nahi. Yeh jaanch ke sath mehfooz hota hai aur iqrar name par chhapta hai.
signature.example: Usman ne purana Redmi becha: us ne ungli se dastakhat kiye, aap ne Save dabaya — ab iqrar name par line ke upar us ke dastakhat hain.

page.title: Amanat
page.body: Doosri dukaan ko dikhane ya bechne ke liye diye gaye phone. Phone aap ka hi rehta hai jab tak wapas na aaye ya woh rakh len — phir us dukaan ko sale ban kar un ke khate mein jata hai.
page.example: Peer ko Ali Mobiles ko iPhone 13 diya; unhon ne bech diya, to aap unhein Rs. 1,40,000 mein "bechte" hain.

outCount.title: Abhi bahar phone
outCount.body: Aap ke kitne phone abhi amanat par doosri dukaanon ke paas hain.
outCount.example: 4 → chaar phone doosri dukaanon par hain.

overdue.title: Der ho gayi
overdue.body: Amanat ke woh phone jin ki wapsi ki tareekh guzar gayi aur wapas nahi aaye. Us dukaan ko call karen.
overdue.example: 1 tareekh ko 7 din ke liye diya, 9 tak wapas nahi → overdue.

views.title: Bahar / Wapas / Unhein becha
views.body: Out: abhi doosri dukaan par. Returned: aap ke stock mein aa gaya. Sold to them: unhon ne rakh liya aur un ke khate mein sale bana.
views.example: "Sold to them" dabayen — amanat ke woh sab phone jo sale bane.

price.title: Tay shuda qeemat
price.body: Jo phone unhon ne rakh liya us ki un se tay qeemat. Yeh un ke naam sale ka bill banta hai.
price.example: Ali Mobiles ne Galaxy S23, Rs. 1,95,000 mein rakh liya → Rs. 1,95,000 ka bill.

paidNow.title: Abhi ada
paidNow.body: Us dukaan ne aaj phone ke liye kitna diya. Baqi un ke khate mein.
paidNow.example: Qeemat Rs. 1,95,000, unhon ne Rs. 1,50,000 diye → Rs. 45,000 un ke khate mein.

onKhata.title: Un ke khate mein
onKhata.body: Tay qeemat minus abhi ada: is ke baad woh dukaan aap ko kitna degi.
onKhata.example: Rs. 1,95,000 − Rs. 1,50,000 = Rs. 45,000 unhein dena hai.

pickPhone.title: Kaun sa phone
pickPhone.body: Apne stock se phone dhoond kar chunen. Sirf stock wale phone amanat par diye ja sakte hain.

toShop.title: Kaun si dukaan
toShop.body: Phone lene wali doosri dukaan. Yeh party ke tor par save hoti hai, taake phone rakh len to bill un ke khate mein jaye.

expectedBack.title: Kab tak wapas
expectedBack.body: Phone kab tak wapas aana chahiye. Us din ke baad overdue dikhega. Koi tareekh tay nahi to "No date".
expectedBack.example: 1 November se 7 din → 9 November se overdue.

page.title: Brand aur model
page.body: Stock daalte waqt chunne wali lists: brand, model, storage size aur rang. Built-in sab ke liye hain aur nahi badaltin; dukaan ki apni ka naam badal ya mita sakte hain.
page.example: Infinix mein model "Hot 50 Pro" ek baar daalen → har khareedari mein dikhega.

brands.title: Brand
brands.body: Phone, tablet aur watch ki companiyan. Saath ka number batata hai kitne model hain.

models.title: Model
models.body: Ek brand ke model. Pehle brand chunen, phir us ke model daalen ya naam badlen.

storages.title: Storage size
storages.body: Chunne ke liye memory size. 128GB ya 1TB ki tarah likhen.

colours.title: Rang
colours.body: Phone daalte waqt chunne ke liye rangon ke naam.

pickBrand.title: Brand chunen
pickBrand.body: Model kisi brand ke hote hain, is liye woh brand dabayen jis ke model dekhne ya daalne hain.

builtin.title: Built-in
builtin.body: App ke sath har dukaan ke liye aata hai, is liye naam nahi badalta na mitta hai. Jin par yeh nishan nahi woh aap ki dukaan ne daale, badle ja sakte hain.
builtin.example: "Samsung" built-in hai; aap ka apna "Itel" naam badal sakta hai.

quickAdd.title: Naya daalen
quickAdd.body: Ghayab naam likhen aur Save dabayen: aap ki dukaan ki list mein jur jata hai; stock daalte waqt foran chun bhi liya jata hai.
quickAdd.example: Model "Spark 30C" list mein nahi → likhen → Save → chun liya gaya.

home.title: Home (dukaan counter)
home.body: Aap ki pehli screen: phone dhoondein, bechein, stock daalein, aur dukaan ka asal hisaab dekhein. Kisi bhi card ko dabayen to us ki tafseel khulti hai.
home.example: Subah sale Rs. 0 hai. Aap ne Samsung A15 cash mein Rs. 32,000 ka becha → sale Rs. 32,000 dikhaye gi.

search.title: Stock mein talaash
search.body: Model ya IMEI likhein, ya dabbe ka barcode scan karein. Stock ki list khule gi jis mein sirf milte julte phone hon ge.
search.example: "A15" likhein → list mein aap ke 3 Samsung A15 phone apni qeemat ke saath aa jayen ge.

sell.title: Bechein
sell.body: Nayi sale shuru karein: phone ya saman chunein, qeemat aur payment ka tareeqa likhein (cash, online, udhaar). Bill ban jata hai aur stock khud kam ho jata hai.
sell.example: iPhone 13 becha Rs. 1,45,000 ka: Rs. 1,00,000 cash, Rs. 45,000 udhaar → bill ban gaya, phone stock se nikal gaya, Rs. 45,000 customer ke khate mein chale gaye.

addStock.title: Stock daalein
addStock.body: Khareeda hua phone ya saman darj karein: dealer se naya ya customer se purana. Yeh khareed ki qeemat par stock mein aa jata hai; jo raqam abhi deni hai woh dealer ke khate mein chali jati hai.
addStock.example: Hall Road ke dealer se 2 Infinix Hot 40 liye, Rs. 38,000 fi phone, aur Rs. 50,000 diye → 2 phone stock mein, Rs. 26,000 dealer ke khate mein.

otherJobs.title: Baqi kaam
otherJobs.body: Roz ke baqi kaamon ke foran button: udhaar khata, stock, repair, wapsi, bill aur kharcha. Har button apni screen kholta hai.
otherJobs.example: Customer phone wapis laya → "Wapsi" dabayen. Bijli ka bill Rs. 6,500 diya → "Kharcha" dabayen.

glanceAll.title: Aik nazar mein
glanceAll.body: Dukaan ka asal hisaab. Sale, munafa, haath mein raqam aur kharcha neeche chune gaye dinon ke hain; cash & bank, udhaar aur stock abhi ke hain.
glanceAll.example: "Is mahine" chunein: sale Rs. 8,50,000 aur kharcha Rs. 60,000 is mahine ke hain; "Mujhe lene hain" Rs. 1,20,000 aaj tak ka saara udhaar hai.

sales.title: Sale
sales.body: In dinon mein bane billon ka jor, discount ke baad aur wapis aaye saman ko nikaal kar (tax lagaya ho to shamil). Cancel bill nahi gine jate. Neeche ki line bike hue phone ginti hai.
sales.example: 3 phone Rs. 1,20,000 ke beche; aik Rs. 40,000 wala wapis aa gaya → sale Rs. 80,000, bike phone 2.

profit.title: Munafa
profit.body: In dinon ka asal munafa: sale mein se bike saman ki khareed qeemat aur kharche nikaal kar, repair aur doosri aamdan jor kar. Yeh sirf maalik aur manager dekhte hain.
profit.example: Sale Rs. 3,00,000, un ki khareed Rs. 2,60,000, kharche Rs. 15,000, repair ki aamdan Rs. 5,000 → munafa Rs. 30,000.

cashBank.title: Cash aur bank
cashBank.body: Dukaan ke paas abhi ki saari raqam: galla (cash daraaz) aur bank, Easypaisa, JazzCash aur baqi account mila kar. Yeh aaj ka balance hai, chune gaye dinon ka nahi.
cashBank.example: Galla Rs. 40,000 + Meezan Bank Rs. 1,50,000 + Easypaisa Rs. 10,000 → Rs. 2,00,000.

toGet.title: Mujhe lene hain
toGet.body: Abhi tak logon par dukaan ka saara udhaar: har woh khata jis ka balance aap ke haq mein hai, jor kar.
toGet.example: Ali par Rs. 25,000 aur Bilal par Rs. 15,000 → mujhe lene hain Rs. 40,000.

toGive.title: Mujhe dene hain
toGive.body: Abhi dukaan ne doosron ko jo dena hai: dealer jin ki poori payment nahi hui, bagair bill ke li gayi raqam, customer jin ki raqam aap ke paas hai. Har woh khata jo un ke haq mein hai, jor kar.
toGive.example: Hall Road dealer Rs. 60,000 + Usman Rs. 10,000 → mujhe dene hain Rs. 70,000.

inStock.title: Stock mein phone
inStock.body: Abhi dukaan mein kitne phone, tablet aur ghariyan hain (bike hue aur amanat par gaye nahi gine jate). Maaliyat maalik aur manager ko khareed qeemat par, baqi staff ko bechne ki qeemat par dikhti hai.
inStock.example: Dukaan mein 12 phone, Rs. 4,80,000 mein khareede → stock 12, maaliyat 4,80,000.

expenses.title: Kharche
expenses.body: In dinon ke likhe gaye dukaan ke kharche: kiraya, bill, tankhwahen, chai waghera. Cancel kiye gaye kharche nahi gine jate.
expenses.example: Kiraya Rs. 30,000 + bijli Rs. 8,000 + chai Rs. 2,000 → kharche Rs. 40,000.

week.title: Pichle 7 din
week.body: Pichle 7 dinon mein har din ki aik patti: us din ki sale, wapsi nikaal kar. Patti dabayen to us din ka hisaab khulta hai.
week.example: Mangal ki patti sab se oonchi hai, Rs. 2,10,000 → use daba kar dekhein us din kya bika.

moneySplit.title: Raqam kahan hai
moneySplit.body: Aap ka karobar chaar hisson mein: cash & bank, logon par udhaar, jo aap ne doosron ko dena hai, aur stock ki maaliyat. Kisi hisse ko dabayen to woh khulta hai.
moneySplit.example: Cash Rs. 2,00,000, lene hain Rs. 1,00,000, dene hain Rs. 50,000, stock Rs. 5,00,000 → zyada tar raqam stock mein lagi hai.

hazri.title: Hazri
hazri.body: Dukaan pohanch kar "Hazri lagayein" dabayen aur jate waqt "Chhutti karein". Maalik Staff mein sab ke auqaat aur ghante dekhta hai.
hazri.example: Subah 10:00 aaye, raat 8:00 gaye → aaj ke 10 ghante.

ai.title: Assistant
ai.body: Apni dukaan ke baare mein saada alfaaz mein poochein; yeh aap ke apne record se jawab deta hai.
ai.example: Poochein "Sab se zyada udhaar kis par hai?" → jawab maslan "Ali, Rs. 45,000".

reports.title: Munafa aur reports
reports.body: Maalik ki reports kholta hai: kharchon ke baad asal munafa, tax, sab se zyada bikne wale, purana stock aur agle hafte ka andaaza.
reports.example: Dekhein ke is mahine Infinix Hot 40 ke 9 piece bike, aur kaun se phone 60 din se pare hain.

attention.title: Tawajjo talab
attention.body: Woh kaam jo aap ka intezar kar rahe hain. Har line mein tadaad hai; dabayen to list khulti hai.
attention.example: "2 repair khule hain" → daba kar dekhein kaun se phone abhi repair mein hain.

pendingCheck.title: ID card check baqi
pendingCheck.body: Stock ke woh phone jin ke bechne wale ka ID card check mukammal nahi, ya jin par shak ka nishaan laga hai. Bechne se pehle check mukammal karein.
pendingCheck.example: Aap ne purana Vivo Y20 liya aur CNIC ki photo chhor di → jab tak photo nahi daalen ge yeh yahan dikhe ga.

openRepairs.title: Khule repair
openRepairs.body: Repair ke liye aaye woh phone jo abhi customer ko wapis nahi diye gaye.
openRepairs.example: Screen aur battery ke liye 3 phone aaye → 3 repair khule hain.

instOverdue.title: Qistain late
instOverdue.body: Qiston ke woh plan jin ki kam az kam aik mahana qist apni tareekh guzarne ke baad bhi ada nahi hui.
instOverdue.example: Kashif ki Rs. 8,000 ki qist 10 tareekh ko thi; aaj 15 hai → us ka plan late dikhe ga.

instToday.title: Aaj ki qistain
instToday.body: Woh plan jin ki agli qist aaj ada honi hai (aur koi qist late nahi).
instToday.example: Teen customer 10 tareekh ko dete hain aur aaj 10 hai → aaj 3 qistain.

lendLate.title: Len-den late
lendLate.body: Woh log jinhon ne dukaan se bagair bill ke raqam li (len-den) aur wapsi ki tareekh guzar gayi.
lendLate.example: Aap ne Usman ko Rs. 20,000 diye, pehli ko wapis karne the; aaj 5 tareekh hai → woh yahan dikhe ga.

lendWeOwe.title: Len-den wapis dena hai
lendWeOwe.body: Dukaan ne kisi se bagair bill ke jo raqam li, jis ki wapsi 3 din ke andar hai ya tareekh guzar chuki hai.
lendWeOwe.example: Aap ne Imran se Rs. 50,000 liye, Jumma ko wapis karne hain; aaj Budh hai → yeh yahan dikhe ga.

lowStock.title: Kam stock wala saman
lowStock.body: Ginti wala saman (charger, cover, ghariyan waghera) jis ki tadaad aap ki rakhi hui kam az kam hadd ke barabar ya us se kam ho gayi hai.
lowStock.example: Samsung 25W charger ki hadd 5 hai aur 4 bache hain → yeh yahan dikhe ga.

dayReport.title: Din ka hisaab
dayReport.body: Aik din ya kuch dinon ka karobar: kya bika, raqam kaise aayi, kitna udhaar diya aur wapis aaya, kharche, haath mein bachi raqam aur bike saman ki list.
dayReport.example: Kal chunein: bika Rs. 1,50,000, cash Rs. 1,00,000, udhaar diya Rs. 50,000, kharche Rs. 5,000.

cameIn.title: Aaya
cameIn.body: In dinon mein galle, bank aur wallet mein aayi saari raqam, wajah ke saath: sale, udhaar wasooli, repair, len-den, apne account se muntaqli, deegar.
cameIn.example: Sale Rs. 80,000 + udhaar wasooli Rs. 20,000 → aaya Rs. 1,00,000.

wentOut.title: Gaya
wentOut.body: In dinon mein galle, bank aur wallet se nikli saari raqam, wajah ke saath: stock khareeda, wapsi, kharche, logon ko diya, len-den, apne account mein muntaqli, deegar.
wentOut.example: Stock khareeda Rs. 75,000 + kharche Rs. 5,000 → gaya Rs. 80,000.

cashIn.title: Cash wasool
cashIn.body: In dinon ke billon par counter par mila cash. Baad mein wapis aaya udhaar "Udhaar wapas mila" mein gina jata hai.
cashIn.example: Do sales: Rs. 30,000 cash aur Rs. 20,000 udhaar → cash wasool Rs. 30,000.

digital.title: Bank / Easypaisa
digital.body: In billon par counter par bank, Easypaisa ya JazzCash mein mili raqam.
digital.example: Customer ne Redmi 13 ke Rs. 45,000 Easypaisa se diye → yahan Rs. 45,000.

udhaarGiven.title: Udhaar diya
udhaarGiven.body: In billon ka woh hissa jo counter par ada nahi hua; yeh customers ke khate mein chala gaya.
udhaarGiven.example: Bill Rs. 1,45,000, ada Rs. 1,00,000 → udhaar diya Rs. 45,000.

udhaarBack.title: Udhaar wasooli
udhaarBack.body: In dinon mein logon ki apne khate ya kisi bhi tareekh ke purane billon ke badle di gayi raqam. Len-den ki raqam yahan nahi gini jati.
udhaarBack.example: Bilal ne aaj pichle mahine ke bill ke Rs. 15,000 diye → yahan Rs. 15,000.

refunded.title: Wapsi par lautaya
refunded.body: In dinon mein wapsi par customers ko lautayi gayi raqam. Dukaan ne jo rakha woh "Wapsi par kaate" mein hai.
refunded.example: Rs. 1,00,000 ka phone wapis aaya aur aap ne Rs. 90,000 lautaye → yahan Rs. 90,000, katauti Rs. 10,000.

items.title: Kya bika
items.body: In dinon ke billon ki har cheez, khareedar, bechne wale aur payment ke tareeqe ke saath. Kati hui line baad mein wapis aa gayi. Line dabayen to us ka bill khulta hai.
items.example: "Samsung A15 · Ali · Kuch udhaar · 32,000" → dabayen to Ali ka bill khule ga.

sales.title: Sale
sales.body: Bill bante waqt counter par di gayi raqam (cash, online, cheque...). Baad mein aaya udhaar yahan nahi.
sales.example: iPhone 13 becha Rs. 1,45,000 ka, abhi Rs. 1,00,000 mile → yahan Rs. 1,00,000.

udhaarBack.title: Udhaar wasooli
udhaarBack.body: Logon ne baad mein apne khate ya purane billon ke badle jo raqam di, qistain bhi shamil.
udhaarBack.example: Ali ne purane udhaar mein se Rs. 10,000 diye → yahan Rs. 10,000.

repairs.title: Repair
repairs.body: Repair ke kaamon par liya gaya advance aur aakhri payment.
repairs.example: Screen badalna Rs. 6,000 ka, aaj Rs. 2,000 advance → yahan Rs. 2,000.

lendingIn.title: Len-den aaya
lendingIn.body: Bagair bill ke aayi raqam: kisi ne dukaan ko udhaar diya, ya dukaan se li raqam wapis ki.
lendingIn.example: Usman ne aap ke diye hue Rs. 20,000 wapis kiye → yahan Rs. 20,000.

lendingOut.title: Len-den gaya
lendingOut.body: Bagair bill ke gayi raqam: dukaan ne kisi ko udhaar diya, ya li hui raqam wapis ki.
lendingOut.example: Aap ne saath wali dukaan ko Rs. 30,000 cash udhaar diye → yahan Rs. 30,000.

transfer.title: Apne accounts mein muntaqli
transfer.body: Apne aik account se doosre mein muntaqil ki gayi raqam, maslan galle se bank. Yeh aik baar aaya mein aur aik baar gaya mein dikhti hai, is liye kul hisaab nahi badalta.
transfer.example: Galle se Rs. 1,00,000 Meezan Bank mein jama karaye → aaya aur gaya dono mein Rs. 1,00,000.

other.title: Deegar
other.body: Woh len-den jo kisi aur wajah mein nahi aata, maslan wapis kiye phone par dealer ki wapsi, cancel bill, shuru ka cash, ya bahar ke technician ko payment.
other.example: Kharab phone wapis kiya to dealer ne Rs. 30,000 lautaye → deegar (aaya) mein Rs. 30,000.

stock.title: Stock khareeda
stock.body: Stock (phone, saman) khareedte waqt di gayi raqam. Yeh zaya nahi hui: ab yeh aap ki dukaan mein maal ki soorat mein hai.
stock.example: 2 Infinix Hot 40 cash Rs. 76,000 mein khareede → yahan Rs. 76,000, aur stock mein 2 phone barh gaye.

returns.title: Wapsi
returns.body: Wapis aaye saman par customers ko lautayi gayi raqam, aur exchange mein wapis diya gaya farq.
returns.example: Customer ne Redmi 13 wapis kiya aur aap ne Rs. 40,000 lautaye → yahan Rs. 40,000.

expenses.title: Kharche
expenses.body: Dukaan ke kharchon par di gayi raqam: kiraya, bill, tankhwahen, chai waghera.
expenses.example: Galle se dukaan ka kiraya Rs. 30,000 diya → yahan Rs. 30,000.

paidOut.title: Logon ko diya
paidOut.body: Khate ke badle payment: dealer ka purana bill dena, ya customer ki aap ke paas pari raqam wapis karna.
paidOut.example: Hall Road dealer ko purane balance mein se Rs. 50,000 diye → yahan Rs. 50,000.

reminders.title: Udhaar ki yaad dihani
reminders.body: Har woh shakhs jis par dukaan ka udhaar hai, aur us ki aakhri khata entry ko kitne din hue. Aik shakhs ya sab ko WhatsApp par yaad dihani bhejein.
reminders.example: Ali par Rs. 25,000 hain aur aakhri entry 40 din pehle thi → hara button dabayen, WhatsApp message ke saath khul jaye ga.

remindFilter.title: Is se purane
remindFilter.body: Sirf woh log dikhata hai jin ki aakhri khata entry (bill ya payment) kam az kam itne din purani hai. "Sab jin par udhaar hai" har udhaar wale ko dikhata hai.
remindFilter.example: "30 din se purana" chunein: Bilal (45 din) dikhe ga, Ali (10 din) nahi.

stockPage.title: Stock ki maaliyat
stockPage.body: Dukaan mein kitne phone hain aur un ki maaliyat kya hai, pehle brand war aur phir model war.
stockPage.example: Samsung ke 8 phone Rs. 3,20,000 ke, Infinix ke 5 phone Rs. 1,90,000 ke → kul 13 phone, Rs. 5,10,000.

stockValue.title: Dukaan mein stock
stockValue.body: Is waqt stock mein maujood phone, tablet aur ghariyon ki kul maaliyat. Maalik aur manager ko khareed qeemat par, baqi staff ko bechne ki qeemat par dikhti hai. Ginti wala saman (charger, cover) shamil nahi.
stockValue.example: 10 phone Rs. 4,00,000 mein khareede, bechne ki qeemat Rs. 4,50,000 → maalik ko Rs. 4,00,000 dikhe ga, salesman ko Rs. 4,50,000.

stockBrands.title: Brand war
stockBrands.body: Har brand ke kitne phone aur un ki maaliyat, sab se bara pehle. Brand dabayen to us ke model khulte hain; model dabayen to woh phone dikhte hain.
stockBrands.example: Samsung dabayen → A15 (4 phone), A35 (2), S23 (2); A15 daba kar 4 phone dekhein.

page.title: Bechein
page.body: Sale marhala war: phone ya saman chunein, qeemat aur payment ka tareeqa likhein, phir bill print ya share karein. Stock aur khata khud update ho jate hain.
page.example: Infinix Hot 40 chunein, qeemat Rs. 39,000, Cash → Bikri mukammal karein → raseed print aur phone stock se nikal gaya.

search.title: Phone dhoondein
search.body: Stock mein phone dhoondne ke liye model ya IMEI likhein, ya barcode scan karein: scan kiya phone seedha bill mein aa jata hai.
search.example: Samsung A15 ka dabba scan karein → woh phone apni qeemat ke saath bill mein aa jaye ga.

devCat.title: Device ki qism
devCat.body: Neeche ki list mein sirf mobile, tablet ya smart watch dikhayen. "Sab" stock ki har cheez dikhata hai.
devCat.example: Tablet dabayen → sirf aap ke Galaxy Tab aur iPad dikhen ge.

pickPhone.title: Stock ke phone
pickPhone.body: Sirf stock mein maujood phone dikhte hain. Kisi ko dabayen to woh apni qeemat ke saath bill mein aa jata hai. Peela ya laal nishaan matlab ID card check baqi hai ya phone mashkook hai.
pickPhone.example: "Redmi 13 · 128GB" dabayen → yeh apni qeemat Rs. 42,000 par bill mein aa jaye ga.

items.title: Bill mein saman
items.body: "+ Ek aur phone" stock se phone daalta hai. Accessory / ghari ginti wala saman hai: bechne se us ki tadaad kam hoti hai. "+ Charger, cover ya aur saamaan" jo aap khud likhein, stock par asar nahi. "Discount aur customer" woh khane kholta hai.
items.example: A15 ke saath stock se Rs. 1,500 ka cover → cover ki tadaad 10 se 9 ho gayi.

reviseAsking.title: Tay qeemat badlein
reviseAsking.body: Is phone ki tay shuda (bechne ki) qeemat abhi badalne ke liye nishaan lagayen. Tabdeeli aap ke naam ke saath phone ki history mein likhi jati hai; dukaan ke usool ke mutabiq maalik ya manager, ya maalik ka PIN chahiye ho sakta hai.
reviseAsking.example: Market gir gayi: nishaan laga kar A35 ki qeemat Rs. 62,000 se Rs. 58,000 karein.

newAsking.title: Nayi tay shuda qeemat
newAsking.body: Ab se is phone ki bechne ki qeemat. Aap ki bechi qeemat isi se milayi jati hai.
newAsking.example: Pehle Rs. 60,000 thi, nayi Rs. 55,000, becha Rs. 55,000 mein → tay qeemat se kam nahi.

askingReason.title: Wajah
askingReason.body: Tay shuda qeemat kyun badli. Maalik yeh phone ki history mein parhta hai.
askingReason.example: "Naya model aa gaya, rate Rs. 4,000 kam ho gaya."

soldFor.title: Bechne ki qeemat
soldFor.body: Customer is phone ki jo qeemat de ga. Yeh tay shuda qeemat se shuru hoti hai; is se kam par bechne ke liye dukaan ke usool ke mutabiq maalik ya manager, ya maalik ka PIN chahiye ho sakta hai.
soldFor.example: Tay qeemat Rs. 42,000, customer ne bhao kiya → Rs. 40,000 likhein.

belowCost.title: Khareed se kam
belowCost.body: Aap ki likhi qeemat is phone ki khareed se kam hai, yaani nuqsaan. Sirf maalik ya manager neeche ke button se ijazat de sakte hain.
belowCost.example: Khareeda Rs. 50,000 mein, likha Rs. 47,000 → Rs. 3,000 ka nuqsaan; sirf maalik ya manager manzoor kar sakte hain.

tier.title: Qeemat ki qism
tier.body: Is cheez ki kaun si qeemat lagi: dealer customer ke liye dealer rate, promo chalne par promo rate, warna aam rate.
tier.example: Charger ka aam rate Rs. 1,200, dealer rate Rs. 1,000 → customer mein dealer chunein to Rs. 1,000 lag jaye ga.

belowMin.title: Kam az kam qeemat se kam
belowMin.body: Is cheez ki kam az kam bechne ki qeemat rakhi hui hai aur aap ki qeemat us se kam hai. Dukaan ka usool tay karta hai ke maalik ya manager ki manzoori chahiye ya nahi.
belowMin.example: AirPods copy ki kam az kam qeemat Rs. 2,500 hai aur aap ne Rs. 2,200 likha → yahan nishaan lag jaye ga.

itemName.title: Cheez
itemName.body: Aisi cheez ka naam jo ginti wale stock mein nahi, jaise bill par aana chahiye. Is se stock nahi badalta.

unitPrice.title: Aik ki qeemat
unitPrice.body: Aik piece ki qeemat. Line ki raqam = tadaad × yeh qeemat.
unitPrice.example: 3 cover Rs. 500 wale → bill par Rs. 1,500.

taxRate.title: Tax %
taxRate.body: Sales tax ki sharah jo discount ke baad bill par oopar se lagti hai. Yeh settings mein aap ki dukaan ki sharah se shuru hoti hai.

on.title: Qiston par bechein
on.body: Customer abhi advance deta hai aur baqi mahana. Tareekhon ke saath plan banta hai, zaamin likha jata hai, aur late qistain Home par dikhti hain.
on.example: Phone Rs. 1,20,000, advance Rs. 30,000, 6 mahine → Rs. 15,000 mahana.

advance.title: Advance
advance.body: Customer aaj jo deta hai, oopar chune gaye tareeqe se. Baqi mahana qiston mein bat jata hai.
advance.example: Bill Rs. 80,000, advance Rs. 20,000 → qiston ke liye Rs. 60,000 baqi.

months.title: Mahine
months.body: Baqi raqam kitni mahana qiston mein bate gi.
months.example: Baqi Rs. 60,000, 6 mahine → Rs. 10,000 ki 6 qistain.

monthly.title: Mahana
monthly.body: Aik qist ki raqam. Yeh baqi ÷ mahine se banti hai, lekin aap badal sakte hain; aakhri mahina jo bache woh leta hai.
monthly.example: Rs. 90,000, 6 mahine → Rs. 15,000. Rs. 16,000 likhein → 5 × Rs. 16,000 aur aakhri mahina Rs. 10,000.

dueDay.title: Mahine ki tareekh
dueDay.body: Har mahine ki woh tareekh jis din qist deni hai (1 se 28).

firstDue.title: Pehli qist
firstDue.body: Pehli qist ki tareekh. Khaali chhorein to agle mahine oopar wali tareekh ko.
firstDue.example: 5 March ko becha, tareekh 10, yeh khaali → pehli qist 10 April.

guarantor.title: Zaamin
guarantor.body: Woh shakhs jo customer ki zamanat deta hai. Customer payment rok de to aap us se raabta karte hain. Us ka naam, mobile aur CNIC plan ke saath rakha jata hai.
guarantor.example: Kashif qiston par leta hai; us ka bhai Asif, mobile aur CNIC ke saath, zaamin hai.

gName.title: Zaamin ka naam
gName.body: Zaamin ka poora naam jaisa ID card par hai. Yeh plan ke saath print hota hai.

gCnic.title: Zaamin ka CNIC
gCnic.body: Zaamin ke ID card ke 13 hindse; dash khud lag jate hain.

promiseDate.title: Waade ki tareekh
promiseDate.body: Jis din customer udhaar dene ka waada karta hai. Is ke baad audit mein yeh udhaar late dikhta hai; tareekh na ho to sirf yeh dikhta hai ke kitna purana hai.
promiseDate.example: Udhaar Rs. 20,000, waada 30 tareekh ka → 31 se yeh late dikhe ga.

flagged.title: Chori ka shak
flagged.body: ID card check ke waqt is phone par chori ka shak laga tha. Sirf maalik ise bech sakta hai, aur wajah likhni ho gi.
flagged.example: Purane iPhone 12 par khareed ke waqt nishaan laga → salesman nahi bech sakta; maalik wajah likh kar bech sakta hai.

override.title: Phir bhi bechne ki wajah
override.body: Likhein ke check saaf hue bagair kyun bech rahe hain (kam az kam 3 huroof). Yeh sale aur phone ki history mein mehfooz hoti hai.
override.example: "Bechne wala asal CNIC aur dabbe ka bill le kar aa gaya."

pendingCheck.title: ID card check baqi
pendingCheck.body: Is purane phone ke bechne wale ka CNIC check nahi hua. Abhi check karein, ya jaante hain to "Chhor kar bechein" dabayen; chhorna phone ki history mein likha jata hai.
pendingCheck.example: Aap ne apne jaane pehchane purane customer se liya tha → "Chhor kar bechein" dabayen.

total.title: Kul
total.body: Poore bill ki raqam jo customer de ga: saari lines, discount nikaal kar, tax laga ho to jor kar.
total.example: Phone Rs. 50,000 + cover Rs. 1,000 − discount Rs. 1,000 → kul Rs. 50,000.

held.title: Roki gayi sales
held.body: Customer thori der ke liye jaye to bill rok lein, agle customer ko nimtayen, phir kisi bhi counter phone se bill dobara kholein. Mukammal hone tak kuch nahi bikta aur stock nahi hilta.
held.example: Customer ATM gaya → us ka A15 ka bill "Ali ATM" naam se rokein, agle ko bechein, phir Ali ka bill kholein.

confirm.title: Bechne se pehle dekhein
confirm.body: Bill banne se pehle aakhri nazar: har phone ki bechi qeemat us ki tay shuda qeemat ke muqable mein, aur maalik o manager ke liye khareed aur munafa.
confirm.example: Tay qeemat Rs. 42,000, becha Rs. 40,000 → tasdeeq se pehle "tay qeemat se Rs. 2,000 kam" dikhe ga.

lineProfit.title: Is phone ka munafa
lineProfit.body: Bechi qeemat mein se is phone ki khareed qeemat nikaal kar. Yahan kharche nahi nikale jate.
lineProfit.example: Khareeda Rs. 52,000, becha Rs. 58,000 → munafa Rs. 6,000.

underAsking.title: Tay qeemat se kam
underAsking.body: Aap tay shuda qeemat se itna kam bech rahe hain. Dukaan ke usool ke mutabiq maalik ya manager, ya maalik ka PIN chahiye ho sakta hai, aur yeh phone ki history mein likha jata hai.
underAsking.example: Tay qeemat Rs. 65,000, becha Rs. 62,000 → Rs. 3,000 kam, aap ke naam ke saath mehfooz.

ownerPin.title: Maalik ka PIN
ownerPin.body: Dukaan ke usool ke mutabiq is qeemat ke liye maalik ka PIN chahiye. Maalik isi phone par likhta hai, aur sale mein darj ho jata hai ke us ne manzoori di.
ownerPin.example: Salesman tay qeemat se Rs. 2,000 kam bechta hai → maalik apna 4 hindson ka PIN likhta hai aur sale ho jati hai.

list.title: Sales
list.body: Sale ka har bill, naya sab se oopar, aur us par kitna lena baqi hai. Kisi ko dabayen to kholein, print karein, saman wapis lein ya cancel karein.
list.example: Ali ka bill INV-0042: kul Rs. 45,000, Rs. 15,000 baqi → daba kar payment lein ya print karein.

statusFilter.title: Ada / ghair ada
statusFilter.body: "Paise nahi mile": abhi kuch nahi mila. "Kuch mile": kuch udhaar baqi hai. "Pure mile": poora mil gaya. "Sab" har bill dikhata hai.
statusFilter.example: "Kuch mile" dabayen → sirf woh bill jin par kuch udhaar baqi hai, maslan Rs. 45,000 ka bill jis par Rs. 15,000 baqi.

detail.title: Sale ka bill
detail.body: Aik bill: customer, saman, raqam, kitna ada hua aur kitna baqi hai. Yahin se print, share, saman wapsi ya cancel karein.
detail.example: INV-0042 kholein → Ali ko becha A15, Rs. 30,000 ada, Rs. 15,000 baqi, aur dobara print karein.

customer.title: Customer
customer.body: Bill kis ke naam hai. "Cash gahak" matlab koi khata nahi. Naam dabayen to us ka khata khulta hai.
customer.example: Bill "Ali Mobile Zone" ke naam → naam daba kar us ka poora khata dekhein.

soldBy.title: Bechne wala
soldBy.body: Staff ka woh login jis ne yeh bill banaya.
soldBy.example: Bechne wala Hamza → Hamza ke login se bana, chahe qeemat maalik ke PIN se manzoor hui ho.

subtotal.title: Saman ka jor
subtotal.body: Discount aur tax se pehle saari lines ka jor.
subtotal.example: Phone Rs. 50,000 + cover Rs. 1,000 → discount se pehle Rs. 51,000.

paidSoFar.title: Ada hua
paidSoFar.body: Is bill par ab tak mili saari raqam: counter par aur baad ki payments jo is bill par lagin.
paidSoFar.example: Counter par Rs. 30,000 + agle hafte Rs. 10,000 → ada Rs. 40,000.

returnedTotal.title: Wapis aaya saman
returnedTotal.body: Is bill ki wapis aayi cheezon ki raqam. Yeh customer ke zimme raqam se nikal jati hai.
returnedTotal.example: Bill Rs. 51,000, Rs. 1,000 ka cover wapis aaya → yahan Rs. 1,000.

billProfit.title: Is bill ka munafa
billProfit.body: Bill ki kul raqam mein se tax aur us ki har cheez ki khareed qeemat nikaal kar. Yahan wapsi aur kharche nahi nikale jate.
billProfit.example: Kul Rs. 58,000, tax nahi, khareed Rs. 52,000 → munafa Rs. 6,000.

settlement.title: Hisaab kaise
settlement.body: Wapis aaye saman par customer ki di hui raqam ka kya ho. "Abhi paise wapas": aap raqam lauta dein. "Khate mein rakhein": us ke khate mein rahe, baad mein kaam aaye. "Aamdani mein rakhein": dukaan rakh le.
settlement.example: Rs. 5,000 ke earbuds wapis: "Abhi paise wapas" → Rs. 5,000 lautayen; "Khate mein rakhein" → us ke khate mein Rs. 5,000 us ke haq mein.

returnPage.title: Wapsi
returnPage.body: Customer khareedi cheez wapis laata hai: use chunein, tay karein kitna lautana hai, aur phone wapis stock mein aa jata hai. Bill aur khata khud theek ho jate hain.
returnPage.example: Ali Rs. 32,000 ka A15 wapis laata hai → aap Rs. 30,000 lautate hain, dukaan Rs. 2,000 rakhti hai, A15 wapis stock mein.

returnSearch.title: Bika hua phone dhoondein
returnSearch.body: IMEI, khareedar ka naam ya mobile likhein, ya scan karein. Scan kiya phone seedha apna bill kholta hai.
returnSearch.example: A15 ka IMEI scan karein → Ali ka bill khule ga aur woh phone chuna hua ho ga.

recentSales.title: Haaliya sales
recentSales.body: Taaza tareen bill. Kisi ko dabayen to us ka saman wapis lein.
recentSales.example: Ghanta pehle bika charger kharab nikla → oopar woh bill dabayen.

returnLines.title: Kya wapis aaya
returnLines.body: Is bill ki jo cheezen wapis aayin un par nishaan lagayen. Pehle wapis aayi cheezen halki dikhti hain.
returnLines.example: Bill mein A15 aur cover hai; sirf cover wapis aaya → sirf cover par nishaan lagayen.

onUdhaarOnly.title: Sirf udhaar se kam
onUdhaarOnly.body: In cheezon ki koi raqam ada nahi hui thi, is liye kuch nahi lautaya jata; un ki qeemat sirf customer ke udhaar se kam ho jati hai.
onUdhaarOnly.example: Poora udhaar par diya Rs. 20,000 ka phone wapis aaya → us ka udhaar Rs. 20,000 kam, cash nahi hila.

paidForIt.title: Customer ne diye the
paidForIt.body: Wapis aane wali cheezon ki jo raqam customer ne waqai di thi: un ki qeemat mein se is bill ka baqi udhaar nikaal kar.
paidForIt.example: Bill Rs. 1,00,000, Rs. 20,000 abhi udhaar, poora bill wapis → us ne Rs. 80,000 diye the.

giveFrom.title: Kahan se lautayen
giveFrom.body: Raqam kis account se wapis jaye: galla (cash), bank ya wallet. "Khate mein rakhein": abhi kuch nahi diya jata; raqam us ke khate mein us ke haq mein rehti hai.
giveFrom.example: Cash se lautayen → galla wapsi jitna kam. Khate mein rakhein → agli khareedari mein kaam aaye gi.

giveBack.title: Wapis dein
giveBack.body: Customer ko kitna lautana hai. Yeh poori raqam se shuru hota hai; kam likhein to baqi dukaan ki katauti hai.
giveBack.example: Us ne Rs. 32,000 diye the, aap Rs. 30,000 likhein → dukaan ki katauti Rs. 2,000.

returnReason.title: Wajah
returnReason.body: Yeh kyun wapis aaya. Yeh wapsi ke saath aur phone ki history mein mehfooz hoti hai.
returnReason.example: "2 din baad speaker ne kaam chhor diya."

cashGiven.title: Gahak ne naqad diye
cashGiven.body: Gahak ne jitni naqad raqam di woh likhein. Screen aur chhapa hua bill wapas dene wali raqam dikhate hain. Zaroorat na ho to khaali chhor dein.
cashGiven.example: Bill Rs. 41,180, gahak Rs. 42,000 deta hai → wapas Rs. 820.

toKhata.title: Zaid raqam purane udhaar mein
toKhata.body: Customer ne is bill se zyada diye aur pehle ka udhaar bhi dena hai. Ye tick karein to zaid raqam change ki jagah us ke purane udhaar mein jama ho jati hai. Khata kam hota hai aur bill par chhapta hai.
toKhata.example: Bill Rs. 2,000, woh Rs. 5,000 deta hai aur pichhle mahine ka Rs. 3,000 dena hai → tick karein: wapas Rs. 0, purana udhaar khatam.

page.title: Exchange / upgrade
page.body: Customer purana phone de kar naya leta hai. Purana tay shuda qeemat par aap ke stock mein aa jata hai, naya bik jata hai, aur sirf farq ada hota hai.
page.example: Naya iPhone 13 Rs. 1,50,000, purana iPhone 11 Rs. 80,000 mein liya → customer Rs. 70,000 de ga.

oldPhone.title: Purana phone
oldPhone.body: Customer ka phone khareedari ki tarah darj karein: model, IMEI, haalat aur jo qeemat aap us ki de rahe hain.
oldPhone.example: iPhone 11, 64GB, PTA, halke kharash, qeemat Rs. 80,000.

tradeValue.title: Purane phone ki qeemat
tradeValue.body: Customer ke purane phone ki jo raqam aap dete hain. Yeh naye phone ki qeemat se kam hoti hai aur aap ke stock mein purane phone ki khareed qeemat ban jati hai.
tradeValue.example: Purana Redmi Note 12 Rs. 35,000 mein liya → bill se Rs. 35,000 kam, aur stock mein Rs. 35,000 khareed par.

newPrice.title: Naye phone ki qeemat
newPrice.body: Jo phone customer le raha hai us ki qeemat. Yeh us ki tay shuda qeemat se shuru hoti hai.
newPrice.example: Samsung A35 ki tay qeemat Rs. 75,000 → Rs. 73,000 par baat bani, wahi likhein.

previous.title: Pichla balance
previous.body: Is exchange se pehle customer ke khate mein jo tha (plus matlab us ne aap ko dena hai).
previous.example: Us par pehle se Rs. 5,000 the → yeh exchange ke baad ki baqi raqam mein jur jate hain.

difference.title: Farq
difference.body: Naye phone ki qeemat mein se purane ki qeemat nikaal kar. Zyada ho to customer deta hai; kam ho to aap galle se farq lautate hain.
difference.example: Naya Rs. 60,000, purana Rs. 70,000 → aap customer ko Rs. 10,000 dein ge.

newBalance.title: Naya balance
newBalance.body: Is exchange ke baad customer ka khata: pichla balance + farq − abhi ada.
newBalance.example: Pichla Rs. 0, farq Rs. 70,000, ada Rs. 50,000 → naya balance Rs. 20,000 us ke khate mein.

page.title: Bill
page.body: Dukaan ka har bill aik jagah: sale, khareedari, wapsi aur repair. Koi bhi bill dhoondein, baqi raqam dekhein, kholein aur print karein.
page.example: Customer pichle mahine ka bill maangta hai → us ka mobile number talaash karein, bill kholein aur dobara print karein.

search.title: Bill dhoondein
search.body: Bill number, naam, mobile number ya IMEI likhein, ya scan karein. Talaash saari tareekhon mein hoti hai, sirf chune gaye dinon mein nahi.
search.example: Wapis aaye phone ka IMEI scan karein → us ka sale bill aur khareed bill dono dikhen ge.

kind.title: Bill ki qism
kind.body: Sirf sale, khareedari (sirf maalik aur manager), wapsi ya repair dikhayen. "Sab" har qism dikhata hai.
kind.example: Repair dabayen → is mahine ke sirf repair bill.

state.title: Raqam
state.body: Udhaar baqi: abhi raqam leni hai (ya khareedari par deni hai). Ada: poora hisaab saaf. Repair mein: repair ka kaam abhi khatam nahi. Wapis aur cancel band bill hain.
state.example: "Udhaar baqi" dabayen → har woh bill jis par abhi raqam baqi hai, maslan Ali ke Rs. 15,000.

toGet.title: Abhi lene hain
toGet.body: Is list ke sale aur repair billon par baqi raqam (in dinon aur filter ke mutabiq). Khate ka jor mukhtalif ho sakta hai: us mein bill se na juri payments aur len-den bhi gine jate hain.
toGet.example: List mein do bill, Rs. 15,000 aur Rs. 5,000 baqi → abhi lene hain Rs. 20,000.

toGive.title: Abhi dene hain
toGive.body: Is list ke khareed billon par dukaan ne abhi jo dena hai.
toGive.example: Hall Road se Rs. 1,00,000 ki khareedari, Rs. 60,000 diye → abhi dene hain Rs. 40,000.

balance.title: Khate ka balance
balance.body: Is shakhs ka abhi ka khata. Plus raqam matlab us ne dukaan ko dena hai; minus matlab dukaan ne use dena hai.
balance.example: Balance Rs. 25,000 → Ali ne aap ko Rs. 25,000 dene hain. Balance −Rs. 10,000 → aap ne use Rs. 10,000 dene hain.

forBill.title: Is bill ke liye
forBill.body: Yeh payment sirf isi aik bill par lagti hai, jitna is par baqi hai.
forBill.example: Bill INV-0042 par Rs. 15,000 baqi; woh Rs. 15,000 deta hai → yeh bill saaf.

amount.title: Raqam
amount.body: Kitni raqam mili ya di gayi. Yeh pehle is shakhs ke sab se purane ghair ada billon par lagti hai; zyada ho to us ke khate mein rehti hai.
amount.example: Ali ke do bill Rs. 10,000 aur Rs. 15,000 hain, woh Rs. 20,000 deta hai → pehla saaf aur doosre par Rs. 10,000 lag gaye.

lending.title: Len-den
lending.body: Bagair bill ke di ya li gayi raqam, maslan saath wali dukaan cash udhaar leti hai. Yeh us shakhs ke khate mein rehti hai, reports mein sale se alag rakhi jati hai, aur baad mein kisi bill se adjust ho sakti hai.
lending.example: Aap Usman ko Rs. 20,000 dete hain → us ke khate mein Rs. 20,000 len-den, sale nahi.

lendAmount.title: Len-den ki raqam
lendAmount.body: Kitni raqam di ya li gayi. Yeh abhi kisi bill par nahi lagti.
lendAmount.example: Imran aik hafte ke liye dukaan ko Rs. 50,000 deta hai → 50000 likhein.

lendDue.title: Wapsi ki tareekh
lendDue.body: Raqam kab wapis aani hai, ya dukaan ne kab lautani hai. Is tareekh ke baad Home par late dikhti hai, aur WhatsApp yaad dihani bheji ja sakti hai.
lendDue.example: Rs. 20,000 diye, pehli ko wapis → 2 tareekh se woh "Len-den late" mein dikhe ga.

allocated.title: Kin billon par lagi
allocated.body: Yeh payment kin billon par lagi aur har aik par kitni.

advance.title: Advance rakha
advance.body: Payment ka woh hissa jo us ke khule billon se zyada tha. Yeh us ke khate mein us ke haq mein rehta hai aur agli baar us ki raqam kam karta hai.
advance.example: Us ne Rs. 15,000 dene the aur Rs. 20,000 diye → Rs. 5,000 advance.

cash.title: Cash
cash.body: Noton mein raqam, galle (cash daraaz) mein aayi ya galle se gayi. Galle ka balance itna badal jata hai.
cash.example: Customer Rs. 32,000 noton mein deta hai → galla Rs. 32,000 barh gaya.

online.title: Online
online.body: Bank transfer ya Easypaisa, JazzCash ya koi aur app. Bank ya app chunein; raqam usi account mein gini jati hai, galle mein nahi.
online.example: Customer Easypaisa se Rs. 45,000 bhejta hai → raqam aap ke Easypaisa account mein, galla nahi badalta.

bank.title: Kaun sa bank ya app
bank.body: Jis bank ya wallet se raqam gayi. Aam wale button hain; baqi neeche ki list mein hain.
bank.example: Meezan Bank se aayi → Meezan dabayen. Bank Alfalah se aayi → list se chunein.

chequeDate.title: Cheque ki tareekh
chequeDate.body: Cheque par likhi tareekh; usi din se cash ho sakta hai.
chequeDate.example: Cheque par 15 March → 15 March likhein, is se pehle jama na karayen.

foreign.title: Ghair mulki raqam
foreign.body: Kitni raqam bheji gayi, doosre mulk ki currency mein.
foreign.example: Riyadh se us ke bhai ne 500 SAR bheje → 500 likhein.

rate.title: Rate
rate.body: Is payment ke liye us currency ki aik ikaai kitne rupay ki hai.

inRupees.title: Rupon mein
inRupees.body: Raqam × rate. Yahi rupay bill ya khate mein likhe jate hain.

sender.title: Bhejne wale ka naam
sender.body: Bahar se raqam kis ne bheji, taake baad mein dhoond sakein.

service.title: Kis zariye se
service.body: Raqam kis service se aayi, maslan Western Union ya bank. Ikhtiyari.
service.example: Western Union se aayi → Western Union dabayen.

mtcn.title: Reference / MTCN
mtcn.body: Transfer ka tracking number (Western Union ke liye MTCN). Ikhtiyari, lekin baad mein sawal ho to kaam aata hai.
mtcn.example: Bhejne wale ke SMS se MTCN 1234567890.

fee.title: Service fee
fee.body: Raqam bhejne wali service ne jo kaata. Yeh sirf international report mein istemal hoti hai (khaalis = raqam − fee); bill mein poori raqam hi rehti hai.
fee.example: Rs. 37,100 aaye aur service ne Rs. 600 kaate → report mein khaalis Rs. 36,500.

status.title: Raqam ki haalat
status.body: Baqi: abhi wasool nahi hui. Mausool: mil gayi. Tay: poora kaam khatam. Yeh international report mein aap ki apni nigrani ke liye hai.
status.example: MTCN mil gaya lekin bank se abhi raqam nahi li → Baqi.

party.title: Shakhs chunein
party.body: Apne customer aur dealer naam ya mobile se talaash kar ke dabayen, ya naya shakhs daalne ke liye + dabayen. Naam ke saath likhi raqam us ke khate ka balance hai.
party.example: "0300" likhein → Ali (0300 1234567) Rs. 25,000 baqi ke saath dikhe ga; use dabayen.

walkIn.title: Walk-in customer
walkIn.body: Jo abhi poori raqam de aur khata na chahiye. Har sale walk-in se shuru hoti hai; bill kisi ke khate mein daalna ho to "Customer chunein" dabayein.
walkIn.example: Koi Rs. 800 ka charger cash mein khareedta hai → walk-in customer hi rehne dein.

docLang.title: Document ki zabaan
docLang.body: Print ya share hone wale bill ki zabaan: English ya Urdu. Is se app ki apni zabaan nahi badalti.
docLang.example: App English mein hai lekin customer Urdu parhta hai → اردو dabayen, phir raseed print karein.

shop.title: Dukaan
shop.body: Aap ki dukaan ka naam, shehar aur phone. Ye har bill ke upar chhapte hain aur WhatsApp messages mein jaate hain.
shop.example: Naam "Star Mobiles", shehar Lahore, phone 0321 5550002 → bill ke upar yehi likha aayega.

name.title: Dukaan ka naam
name.body: Woh naam jis se customer aap ki dukaan ko jaante hain. Bill, parchi aur messages par aata hai.
name.example: "Star Mobiles Hall Road" → har bill isi naam se shuru hoga.

city.title: Shehar
city.body: Dukaan ka shehar. Bill par naam ke neeche chhapta hai.
city.example: Lahore → bill par "Star Mobiles, Lahore" aayega.

phone.title: Dukaan ka phone
phone.body: Woh number jis par customer call karte hain. Bill par chhapta hai taake warranty ya baqaya ke liye rabta ho sake.
phone.example: Bill par 0300 1234567 → kharabi ho to customer isi number par call karega.

language.title: Print ki zubaan
language.body: Bill, iqrar nama aur dukaan se jaane wale WhatsApp messages ki zubaan. Har banda apni screen par apni zubaan alag chun sakta hai.
language.example: Urdu chunein → bill aur udhaar reminder Urdu mein jayenge, chahe salesman app English mein chalaye.

staffLogin.title: Staff login
staffLogin.body: Aap ka staff apne phone par app kaise kholta hai. Aap faisla karte hain ke woh fingerprint use kar sakein ya nahi.
staffLogin.example: Ali (salesman) apne mobile number aur password se, ya ijazat ho to finger se login karta hai.

fingerprint.title: Staff ka fingerprint login
fingerprint.body: On: staff apne phone par finger se login chalu kar sakta hai. Off: har dafa password ya PIN likhna hoga. Finger ka nishan phone se bahar nahi jaata.
fingerprint.example: On → Ali "fingerprint se login" dabata hai aur ek second mein andar. Off → Ali password likhta hai.

tax.title: Sales tax
tax.body: Sirf un dukaanon ke liye jo FBR mein sales tax ke liye registered hain. On ho to bill par aap ki sharah se tax lagta hai.
tax.example: Registered nahi → band rakhein, bill par tax ki line nahi aayegi. 18% par registered → on karein.

taxEnabled.title: Sales tax lagayein
taxEnabled.body: On: har naye bill par neeche wali sharah se tax lagega aur bill par dikhega. Off: bill par tax nahi. Jama shuda tax hukoomat ka paisa hai, aap ki aamdani nahi.
taxEnabled.example: 18% par on: phone Rs. 10,000 → bill par tax Rs. 1,800. Off → bill sirf Rs. 10,000.

taxRate.title: Tax ki sharah %
taxRate.body: Bill par lagne wale sales tax ka percent. Sirf number likhein.
taxRate.example: 18 likhein → Rs. 10,000 ki sale par Rs. 1,800 tax.

taxInclusive.title: Qeemat mein tax shamil
taxInclusive.body: On: jo qeemat aap likhte hain us ke andar tax pehle se shamil hai, customer wohi qeemat deta hai. Off: tax qeemat ke upar jama hota hai.
taxInclusive.example: 18% par qeemat Rs. 11,800. On → customer Rs. 11,800 dega (is mein Rs. 1,800 tax). Off aur qeemat Rs. 10,000 → customer Rs. 11,800 dega.

receipt.title: Raseed
receipt.body: Aap ke bill number kaise shuru hon aur har bill ke neeche kaun si line chhape.
receipt.example: Shuru "SM" aur neeche "Shukriya, dobara tashreef layein" → bill SM-000123 aur aakhir mein ye line.

invoicePrefix.title: Bill number ka shuru
invoicePrefix.body: Har sale bill number ke aage aane wale huroof. Number khud ginte rehte hain; naya shuru sirf naye bills par lagta hai.

footer.title: Raseed ki aakhri line
footer.body: Har English bill ke neeche chhapne wali chhoti line — shukriya ya wapsi ka usool.
footer.example: "No return after 7 days. Thank you!" total ke neeche aayega.

footerUr.title: Raseed ki aakhri line (Urdu)
footerUr.body: Urdu mein chhapne wale bills ke liye yehi neeche ki line. Khaali ho to English wali line aayegi.
footerUr.example: "7 din baad wapsi nahi. Shukriya!" Urdu bill ke total ke neeche.

codeWord.title: Sticker par khareed ka code
codeWord.body: 10 huroof ka ek khufia lafz jo khareed qeemat ko sticker par huroof mein badal deta hai. Aap ek nazar mein apni qeemat parh lein, customer nahi.
codeWord.example: Lafz BLACKHORSE: 0=B, 1=L, 2=A, 3=C, 4=K, 5=H … qeemat Rs. 45,000 → sticker par KHBBB.

codeWordInput.title: Code ka lafz (10 huroof)
codeWordInput.body: Bilkul 10 mukhtalif huroof likhein. Pehla harf 0 hai, doosra 1, isi tarah 9 tak. Khaali chhorein to code nahi chhapega.
codeWordInput.example: MOBILESHOP nahi chalega (O do dafa hai). BLACKHORSE chalega: 3,200 → CABB.

rules.title: Qeemat ke usool
rules.body: Kaun phone ko asking price se kam par bech sakta hai, aur kaun asking price badal sakta hai. Owner aur manager hamesha kar sakte hain. Aisi har sale Reports → Prices mein aati hai.
rules.example: Usool "Owner / manager": salesman Ali Rs. 52,000 ka phone khud se Rs. 50,000 mein nahi bech sakta.

rulesBelow.title: Asking se kam par bechna
rulesBelow.body: Kaun phone par likhi asking price se kam mein sale mukammal kar sakta hai. Koi bhi: koi rok nahi. Owner / manager: sirf wohi. Owner ke PIN se: owner mauqe par PIN likhe to staff bhi kar sakta hai.
rulesBelow.example: Asking Rs. 45,000, customer Rs. 44,000 dena chahta hai. "Owner ke PIN se" → owner PIN likhta hai aur sale ho jaati hai, us ke naam se darj.

rulesAsking.title: Asking price badalna
rulesAsking.body: Stock mein maujood phone par likhi asking (bechne ki) qeemat kaun badal sakta hai. Har tabdeeli badalne wale ke naam se darj hoti hai.
rulesAsking.example: Usool "Owner / manager": salesman iPhone 13 ki qeemat Rs. 1,45,000 se Rs. 1,35,000 khud nahi kar sakta.

rulesPin.title: Owner ke PIN se
rulesPin.body: Owner salesman ki screen par apna PIN likh kar ijazat deta hai, salesman logout nahi hota. Ijazat owner ke naam se mehfooz hoti hai.
rulesPin.example: Salesman kam qeemat par bechna chahta hai; counter par khara owner 4321 likhta hai → ijazat mili aur darj ho gayi.

auditPrefs.title: Stock audit ki hadein
auditPrefs.body: Woh hadein jin se Shop Audit aap ke stock ko chhaant-ta hai: kitne din fresh, slow ya dead, mehnga phone kaun sa, kam munafa kya, aur ID check chhorna kab ajeeb lage. Apni dukaan ke mutabiq badlein.
auditPrefs.example: Hadein 15 / 30 / 60 / 90: dukaan mein 40 din wala phone "slow" dikhega; 90 din ke baad "dead stock".

ageFresh.title: Fresh (din tak)
ageFresh.body: Jo phone itne ya kam din se stock mein ho, audit mein fresh gina jaata hai.
ageFresh.example: 15 → 10 din pehle khareeda Samsung A15 fresh hai.

ageNormal.title: Normal (din tak)
ageNormal.body: Fresh dinon ke baad is din tak phone normal hai. Is ke baad mehnga phone alert dikhane lagta hai.
ageNormal.example: 30 → 25 din wala phone normal; 31 din par mehnga phone flag.

ageSlow.title: Slow (din tak)
ageSlow.body: Normal dinon ke baad is din tak phone slow chal raha hai: qeemat kam karne ka sochein.
ageSlow.example: 60 → 45 din se na bikne wala Infinix Hot 40 slow hai.

ageAttention.title: Attention (din tak)
ageAttention.body: Is din tak phone par tawajjo chahiye. Is ke baad phone dead stock hai aur alert mein aata hai.
ageAttention.example: 90 → dukaan mein 100 din wala phone dead stock: is mein paisa phansa hai.

highValue.title: Mehnga phone (Rs. se)
highValue.body: Jis phone ki khareed qeemat itni ya zyada ho woh "high value" hai. Normal dinon se zyada para rahe to audit khabardar karta hai.
highValue.example: Rs. 50,000 → Rs. 1,20,000 ka iPhone 13 jo 35 din se nahi bika, alert dikhayega.

lowMargin.title: Kam munafa (% se kam)
lowMargin.body: Agar asking price khareed se is % se kam zyada ho to audit phone ko "low margin" likhta hai.
lowMargin.example: 5% → khareed Rs. 40,000, asking Rs. 41,000 (2.5% zyada) → low margin.

bypassMin.title: Ghair mamooli (chhorne ki ginti)
bypassMin.body: Ek banda purana phone khareedte waqt ID / CNIC check kitni dafa chhore to audit use ghair mamooli kahe (neeche wale percent ke saath).
bypassMin.example: 3 → Ali ne is mahine 4 purane phones par check chhora → woh list mein aayega.

bypassShare.title: … aur apni khareed ka percent
bypassShare.body: Chhore gaye checks us bande ki khareed ka kam az kam itna % bhi hon. Dono hadein mil kar faisla karti hain.
bypassShare.example: 50% → Ali ne 6 purane phone khareede, 4 par check chhora (67%) → ghair mamooli. 20 khareede, 4 chhore (20%) → nahi.

items.title: Item settings
items.body: Accessories aur doosri gini jaane wali cheezon ki qeemat kaise lage, ginti zero se neeche ja sake ya nahi, aur darjan, dabba, carton mein kitne piece.
items.example: Charger: average qeemat, zero se neeche bechna nahi, 1 dabba = 10 piece.

valuation.title: Stock ki qeemat ka tareeqa
valuation.body: Bikne wali accessory ki khareed qeemat kaise nikle. Average: sab khareed ki average. FIFO: purana maal pehle, apni qeemat par. Is se munafa badalta hai, bechne ki qeemat nahi.
valuation.example: 10 cable Rs. 100 ki, phir 10 Rs. 140 ki; 1 bechi. Average → qeemat Rs. 120. FIFO → qeemat Rs. 100 (purana maal).

negative.title: Zero se neeche bechne dein
negative.body: Off: ginti zero se neeche jaaye to app sale rok deti hai. On: sale ho jaati hai aur ginti minus dikhti hai jab tak khareed darj na ho.
negative.example: App mein handsfree 0 hain magar shelf par 5 hain (khareed abhi darj nahi). On → 2 bech sakte hain, ginti -2 dikhegi.

units.title: Pack mein piece
units.body: Aap ki dukaan mein ek darjan, dabbe ya carton mein kitne piece. Dabbe se khareedein to app isi se piece ginti hai.
units.example: Dabba = 10: charger ke 3 dabbe khareedein to stock mein 30 piece.

unitDozen.title: Darjan mein piece
unitDozen.body: Aam tor par 12. Darjan se khareed ya farokht par use hota hai.

unitBox.title: Dabbe mein piece
unitBox.body: Supplier ke ek dabbe mein kitne piece aate hain.

unitCarton.title: Carton mein piece
unitCarton.body: Ek carton mein kitne piece aate hain.

devices.title: Device settings
devices.body: Phone, tablet aur ghari ke usool: purane mobile ka lock check lazmi ho ya nahi, aur purane unit ke grade.
devices.example: Lock check on aur grade "a, b, refurbished" → har khareeda purana phone check aur grade hoga.

lockCheck.title: Purane mobile ka lock check
lockCheck.body: On: purana mobile tab hi khareeda jayega jab aap us ke lock (iCloud / Google account / FRP) saaf hain ya nahi darj karein. Jis par lock laga ho woh kabhi nahi bikega. Tablet aur ghari par hamesha lazmi.
lockCheck.example: On → purana iPhone 11 khareedte waqt app poochegi "iCloud saaf hai?". Off → phone par chhor sakte hain.

grades.title: Purane unit ke grade
grades.body: Purana phone, tablet ya ghari khareedte waqt chunne ke liye haalat ke grade, comma se alag. Stock aur sticker par dikhte hain.
grades.example: "a, b, refurbished, copy" → saaf purana Samsung A15 grade "a", kharash wala "b".

phonesTaxAtImport.title: Mobile: tax import par ada
phonesTaxAtImport.body: Mobile phone Sales Tax Act ke Naveen Schedule mein hain: sales tax import karne ya banane wala deta hai, dukaan ke bechne par sales tax nahi lagta. On ho to tax wale bill par tax sirf accessories aur doosri cheezon par lagta hai, aur bill likhta hai ke mobile par kyun nahi. Band ho to har line par bill ki rate lagti hai (pehle ki tarah).
phonesTaxAtImport.example: Tax wala bill: mobile Rs. 40,000 + charger Rs. 1,000 par 18% → tax Rs. 180 (sirf charger par).

card.title: Logo aur karobar ki tafseel
card.body: Aap ka logo aur karobar ki tafseel. In se chhapa hua bill aap ki dukaan ka apna lagta hai.
card.example: Logo aur pata ek dafa daalein → har sale bill aur repair parchi par aayenge.

logo.title: Logo
logo.body: Aap ki dukaan ki tasveer ya nishan. "Printed bill" mein logo on ho to bill ke upar chhapta hai. Bari tasveer khud chhoti ho jaati hai.
logo.example: Signboard ki tasveer daalein → har bill par dukaan ke naam ke upar aayegi.

legalName.title: Registered karobari naam
legalName.body: Tax ya company ke kaghzaat wala naam, agar dukaan ke naam se mukhtalif ho.
legalName.example: Dukaan "Star Mobiles", registered naam "Star Traders (SMC-Pvt) Ltd".

tagline.title: Tagline (English)
tagline.body: English bills par naam ke neeche ek chhoti line.

taglineUr.title: Tagline (Urdu)
taglineUr.body: Urdu mein chhapne wale bills ke liye wohi chhoti line.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp number
whatsapp.body: Dukaan ka WhatsApp number, bill par chhapta hai taake customer message bhej sakein.
whatsapp.example: 0321 5550002 → customer kharabi ki tasveer isi number par bhejta hai.

email.title: Email
email.body: Dukaan ka email, bill aur dealers ke liye. Zaroori nahi.

website.title: Website / page
website.body: Aap ki website ya online page, agar ho.

type.title: Karobar ki qisam
type.body: Karobar ki milkiyat kaisi hai: ek owner, partnership, company waghera. Dobara dabayein to hat jayega.
type.example: Do bhai mil kar dukaan chalate hain → Partnership.

registration.title: Registration number
registration.body: SECP ya chamber of commerce ka registration number, agar ho.
registration.example: SECP 0123456, un dealers ke liye jo maangein.

since.title: Kab se karobar
since.body: Jis saal dukaan shuru hui. Purani dukaan par customer bharosa karte hain.

province.title: Soobah
province.body: Dukaan ka soobah. Tax registration ke liye kaam aata hai. Dobara dabayein to hat jayega.

hours.title: Auqaat
hours.body: Dukaan kab khulti hai, apne alfaaz mein.

social.title: Social page
social.body: Aap ka Facebook, Instagram ya TikTok naam. Bill par tab hi chhapega jab "Printed bill" mein social on ho.
social.example: Instagram "starmobiles.pk" → customer aap ke naye stock ki videos dekhein.

owner.title: Owner ki tafseel
owner.body: Owner ka naam aur CNIC. Bill par tab hi chhapta hai jab "Owner ka naam" on ho; tax kaghzaat ke liye bhi.

ownerName.title: Owner ka naam
ownerName.body: Dukaan ke owner ka poora naam.

ownerCnic.title: Owner ka CNIC
ownerCnic.body: Owner ke shanakhti card ka 13 hindson ka number. Dash khud lagte hain.

taxCard.title: Tax registration (FBR)
taxCard.body: Aap ke FBR number. Bhare hon aur "NTN / STRN" on ho to bill par chhapte hain. Tax lagana Sales tax wale card mein hai.
