taxCard.example: NTN 1234567-8 har bill par, us company customer ke liye jise chahiye.

ntn.title: NTN
ntn.body: FBR ka National Tax Number, income tax ke liye.

strn.title: STRN
strn.body: Sales Tax Registration Number, sirf agar aap sales tax mein registered hain.

fbrPos.title: FBR POS ID
fbrPos.body: Sirf FBR ki point of sale scheme wali dukaanon ke liye: aap ke counter ki ID. Warna khaali chhorein.

currency.title: Currency
currency.body: Raqam hamesha Pakistani rupee hai. Yahan sirf ye chunein ke screen aur bill par raqam kaise likhi jaaye.

symbol.title: Nishan
symbol.body: Har raqam ke saath likha jaane wala nishan.
symbol.example: PKR → PKR 45,000. روپے → 45,000 روپے ("baad mein" ke saath).

position.title: Nishan kahan
position.body: Number se pehle ya baad mein.

paisa.title: Paise
paisa.body: "Sirf rupee" paise chhupa deta hai; "hamesha paise" har raqam ke saath .00 lagata hai. Raqam nahi badalti.
paisa.example: Sirf rupee → Rs. 45,000. Hamesha paise → Rs. 45,000.00.

preview.title: Aisa dikhega
preview.body: Save karne se pehle namoona ke aap ke intikhab se raqam kaisi dikhegi.
preview.example: "Baad mein" aur PKR → namoona 45,000 PKR dikhata hai.

printCard.title: Printed bill
printCard.body: Sale bill aur repair parchi par kya aaye, on ya off karein, aur apni sharait aur bank ki tafseel likhein.
printCard.example: Logo on, owner ka naam off, sharait on → bill par logo aur wapsi ka usool, naam nahi.

logo.title: Bill par logo
logo.body: On: aap ka logo upar chhapega. Off: sirf naam.
logo.example: On → bill ke upar Star Mobiles ka logo.

tagline.title: Bill par tagline
tagline.body: On: naam ke neeche aap ki tagline chhapegi.
tagline.example: On → dukaan ke naam ke neeche "All brands · New & used".

ntn.title: Bill par tax number
ntn.body: On: NTN, STRN aur FBR POS ID (jo bhare hon) bill par chhapenge.

owner.title: Bill par owner ka naam
owner.body: On: owner ka naam bill par chhapega.
owner.example: On → har bill par "Owner: Abdur Rehman".

bank.title: Bill par bank ki tafseel
bank.body: On: aap ke bank aur wallet ki tafseel chhapegi, taake baqaya wala customer online de sake.
bank.example: On → udhaar bill ke neeche "HBL 1234… / Easypaisa 0300 1234567".

terms.title: Bill par sharait
terms.body: On: aap ki sharait (wapsi / warranty) neeche chhapengi.
terms.example: On → har bill par "7 din baad wapsi nahi".

social.title: Bill par social page
social.body: On: aap ke Facebook / Instagram / TikTok naam chhapenge.

qr.title: Bill par QR code
qr.body: On: har sale bill par aik chhota QR code. Gahak use scan kar ke bill online dekhta hai, baghair login ke, taake copy rakhe aur jaan le ke bill asli hai. Is mein gahak ka naam, phone ya khate ka baqaya kabhi nahi dikhta. Jis computer ka internet pata na ho, wahan QR mein bill number chhapta hai.
qr.example: On → gahak bill INV-0042 ka QR scan karta hai aur bill us ke phone par khul jata hai.

terms.title: Sharait (English)
terms.body: Wapsi aur warranty ke usool, sharait on hon to English bill par chhapte hain.
terms.example: "No return after 7 days. Warranty by the company."

termsUr.title: Sharait (Urdu)
termsUr.body: Urdu mein chhapne wale bills ke liye yehi usool.
termsUr.example: "7 دن بعد واپسی نہیں۔ وارنٹی کمپنی کی۔"

bank.title: Bill par bank ki tafseel
bank.body: Woh account jis mein customer baqaya jama kara sake. Tab hi chhapta hai jab "Bank / wallet" on ho.
bank.example: Customer par Rs. 12,000 baqi → woh bill par likhe HBL account mein bhejta hai.

bankTitle.title: Account title
bankTitle.body: Jis naam par account hai, bilkul jaisa bank dikhata hai.
bankTitle.example: Star Mobiles ya Abdur Rehman Afzal.

iban.title: IBAN
iban.body: PK se shuru hone wala 24 huroof ka account code. Doosre bank se raqam bhejne ke liye chahiye.

wallet.title: Easypaisa / JazzCash
wallet.body: Mobile wallet number jis mein customer raqam bhej sakein.
wallet.example: Easypaisa 0300 1234567 → customer phone se Rs. 5,000 bhejta hai.

card.title: Barcode settings
card.body: Har phone aur item ko khareedte hi apna barcode milta hai. Barcode kabhi nahi badalta. Yahan chunein ke naye barcode kaise banein.
card.example: Samsung A15 khareeda → use MS000124 mila; counter par wohi sticker scan kar ke bechein.

type.title: Barcode ki qisam
type.body: Naye label par chhapne wale barcode ki qisam. Code 128 har scanner parhta hai; EAN-13 sirf hindse; QR ke liye 2-D scanner ya phone ka camera. Purane label chalte rahenge.
type.example: Sasta laser scanner → Code 128 rakhein. Phone camera se scan → QR.

prefix.title: Dukaan ka shuru
prefix.body: Har naye barcode number ke aage 6 tak huroof ya hindse, taake aap ke label alag pehchane jayein.

start.title: Number yahan se shuru
start.body: Agla barcode is number se shuru hoga. Ye sirf aage ja sakta hai, taake do labels ka ek code na ho.
start.example: Purana system 5,000 par khatam hua → 5001 se shuru karein; agla label MS005001.

mode.title: Barcode mein kya
mode.body: Naye phone ke barcode mein kya ho: shuru + number, ya phone ka apna IMEI. Accessories ko hamesha shuru + number milta hai.
mode.example: IMEI chuna → naye Infinix Hot 40 ka sticker us ka IMEI 356789012345678 parhega.

next.title: Agla barcode
next.body: Agle khareede jaane wale phone ya item ko milne wala code aur us ki qisam.
next.example: Agla: MS000125 · code128 → agli khareed ko MS000125 milega.

testPrint.title: Test print
testPrint.body: Chuni hui qisam ka ek namoona label chhaapta hai, taake printer aur scanner check kar lein.
testPrint.example: Print karein, phir neeche "Test scan" mein scan karein → beep aani chahiye.

backfill.title: Purane stock ke barcode
backfill.body: Barcode se pehle darj har phone aur item ko barcode deta hai. Aur kuch nahi badalta; purane barcode wohi rehte hain.
backfill.example: Baghair code ke 40 purane phone → ek dafa dabayein → sab ko code mil gaya; label chhaapein.

testScan.title: Test scan
testScan.body: Yahan koi bhi label scan karein (ya code likh kar Enter dabayein) aur dekhein app kya dhoondti hai. Is se kuch nahi bikta.
testScan.example: iPhone 13 ka sticker scan karein → "iPhone 13 · 3567…" dikhega. "Item nahi mila" yani code aap ke stock mein nahi.

daily.title: Rozana ka kaam
daily.body: Counter par roz ke kaam: bechna, khareedna, wapsi, khata, repair aur din ka hisaab.
daily.example: Customer phone khareedta hai → "Sell". Koi apna purana phone bechta hai → "Add stock".

stock.title: Stock
stock.body: Dukaan mein maujood maal ke baare mein sab: phone, accessories, un ki maaliyat, ginti aur brand o model ki list.
stock.example: Jaanna hai kitne Samsung A15 baqi hain → "Stock list".

records.title: Record
records.body: Pehle kiye gaye har kaam ki lists: bill, sale, khareed, aane jaane wali raqam, wapsi aur log.
records.example: Customer pichle mahine ka bill maangta hai → "Invoices" mein us ka naam dhoondein.

accounts.title: Raqam aur reports
accounts.body: Kharche, din band karna, cash aur bank account, reports aur shop audit. Sirf owner aur manager.
accounts.example: Mahine ke aakhir mein: "Reports" kiraya aur tankhwah ke baad asal munafa dikhati hai.

admin.title: Dukaan aur staff
admin.body: Owner ke auzaar: dukaan ki settings, staff, notifications, software fees aur aap ka PIN.

sell.title: Sell
sell.body: Sale bill banayein: phone ya item scan karein ya chunein, qeemat likhein, cash, online ya udhaar lein. Stock, khata aur galla khud badal jaate hain.
sell.example: Samsung A15 Rs. 38,000 mein becha, customer ne Rs. 30,000 diye → Rs. 8,000 us ke khate mein.

addStock.title: Add stock
addStock.body: Khareed darj karein: dealer se naye phone, kisi customer se purana phone, ya accessories. Har phone ko barcode aur history milti hai.
addStock.example: Hall Road ke dealer se 5 Infinix Hot 40, Rs. 33,000 fi, udhaar par → stock +5, dealer ka khata +Rs. 1,65,000.

returnJob.title: Wapsi
returnJob.body: Customer khareedi hui cheez wapis laaye, ya aap supplier ko wapis karein. Raqam wapis ya khate mein adjust, aur phone dobara stock mein.
returnJob.example: Customer Rs. 1,500 ka handsfree wapis karta hai → galle se Rs. 1,500 wapis, stock +1.

installments.title: Qistein
installments.body: Mahana qiston par bechein: advance, mahine aur tareekhein likhein, aur dekhein kis ki qist wajib ya late hai.
installments.example: iPhone 13 Rs. 1,50,000 mein: advance Rs. 50,000, phir 10 mahine Rs. 10,000.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.body: Apni dukaan ke baare mein apne alfaaz mein sawal poochein aur apne record se jawab paayein.
assistant.example: "Is hafte kitne phone beche?" → "14 phone, Rs. 5,20,000".

repairs.title: Repair
repairs.body: Repair ke liye phone lein, kaam aur purzon ka hisaab rakhein, aur bill ke saath wapis dein.
repairs.example: Redmi Note 12 ki screen badalni: aaj job card, kal tayyar, customer Rs. 6,500 deta hai.

exchange.title: Exchange (purana de kar naya)
exchange.body: Customer apna purana phone deta hai aur doosra leta hai, farq ada karta hai. Ek bill mein khareed aur farokht dono.
exchange.example: Purana Samsung A12 Rs. 18,000 mein liya, naya A15 Rs. 38,000 mein diya → customer Rs. 20,000 deta hai.

loans.title: Amanat
loans.body: Doosri dukaan ko diya gaya phone jis ki raqam abhi nahi aayi. Wapis aane tak aap ka hai; woh dukaan rakh le to usi dukaan ko sale ban jaata hai.
loans.example: Hall Road ki dukaan ko customer dikhane ke liye iPhone 12 diya → wapis aane ya bill banne tak "amanat" mein dikhega.

hisaab.title: Din ka hisaab
hisaab.body: Aaj ka khulasa: sale, khareed, galle aur bank mein aane jaane wali raqam, diya aur mila udhaar.
hisaab.example: Aaj raat: sale Rs. 1,20,000, kharcha Rs. 3,000, galle mein Rs. 62,000 hone chahiye.

stock.title: Stock list
stock.body: Dukaan ka har phone, tablet aur ghari, IMEI, haalat, khareed aur asking price ke saath. Dhoondein, chhaantein aur history kholein.
stock.example: "Used · Non-PTA" chunein → 6 phone; ek dabayein to pata chale kis ne kab becha.

stockWorth.title: Dukaan mein stock
stockWorth.body: Aap ke paas kitne phone hain, brand aur model ke hisaab se, aur un ki maaliyat khareed aur asking price par.
stockWorth.example: Samsung ke 12 phone, khareed Rs. 4,80,000, asking Rs. 5,40,000.

accessories.title: Accessories
accessories.body: Charger, cable, cover, handsfree aur doosri gini jaane wali cheezein: maujood tadaad, khareed, qeemat aur har aamad o raft.
accessories.example: Type-C cable: 38 piece, khareed Rs. 120, qeemat Rs. 250.

imeiSearch.title: IMEI search
imeiSearch.body: Phone ko us ke IMEI se dhoondein (likhein ya scan karein). Stock list search ke saath khulti hai.
imeiSearch.example: Aakhri hindse 4512 likhein → jis phone ka IMEI 4512 par khatam ho woh aa jayega.

openingStock.title: Purana stock
openingStock.body: Woh phone daalein jo app shuru karne se pehle shelf par the. Koi raqam nahi di jaati, is liye din ka hisaab nahi badalta.
openingStock.example: Pehle din: dukaan mein pare 25 phone un ki khareed qeemat ke saath daalein.

count.title: Stock ginti
count.body: Shelf par phone aur item scan kar ke ginein; app dikhati hai record ke muqable mein kya kam ya zyada hai.
count.example: 48 phone scan kiye; app mein 50 the → 2 kam, IMEI ke saath list.

catalogue.title: Brand aur model
catalogue.body: Brand, model, storage aur rangon ki list jin mein se khareedte waqt chunte hain. Spelling theek karein ya apna daalein.
catalogue.example: "Tecno Spark 20 Pro" ek dafa daalein → agli khareed par list mein aa jayega.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.body: Har sale bill, number, customer, raqam aur baqi ke saath. Khol kar dobara chhaapein ya WhatsApp par bhejein.
invoices.example: Bill INV-000231 dhoondein → customer ke liye copy chhaapein.

sales.title: Sale list
sales.body: Har bika hua phone aur item, naya pehle, qeemat aur customer ke saath.
sales.example: Dekhein kal 3 iPhone bike aur kis ko.

purchases.title: Khareed list
purchases.body: Har khareed ka bill: kis se, kab, kul raqam aur jo abhi dena hai. Dabayein to phone dekhein, wapis karein ya bill cancel karein.
purchases.example: Ali Traders se khareed P-000045: Rs. 1,65,000, diye Rs. 1,00,000 → abhi Rs. 65,000 dene hain.

payments.title: Wasool / ada raqam
payments.body: Khate ki har adaigi: customer ne aap ko di, ya aap ne dealer ko di. Hari aayi, laal gayi.
payments.example: Bilal ne Easypaisa par Rs. 10,000 diye → +10,000; aap ne Ali Traders ko Rs. 50,000 diye → -50,000.

returns.title: Wapsi list
returns.body: Har wapsi: customer ki lautayi hui sale aur aap ki lautayi hui khareed, raqam aur ye ke paise wapis hue ya khate mein adjust.
returns.example: Wapsi R-000012: customer ne cover lautaya, Rs. 800 wapis.

parties.title: Log aur khata
parties.body: Jin se aap len den karte hain — customer, dealer, doosri dukaanein — un ke khate ka balance: kis par aap ka hai aur kis ka aap par.
parties.example: Bilal par Rs. 12,000; aap par Ali Traders ke Rs. 65,000.

expenses.title: Kharche
expenses.body: Dukaan ke woh kharche jo maal nahi: kiraya, bijli, tankhwah, chai. Ye munafe se katte hain.
expenses.example: Kiraya Rs. 40,000 bank se diya → is mahine ka munafa Rs. 40,000 kam.

dayClose.title: Din band karein
dayClose.body: Raat ko galle ka cash ginein aur likhein. App use mutawaqqa raqam se milati hai aur farq record mein rakhti hai.
dayClose.example: App ke hisaab se Rs. 62,000, aap ne gine Rs. 61,500 → Rs. 500 kam, aap ke naam se mehfooz.

cash.title: Cash aur bank
cash.body: Dukaan jahan jahan raqam rakhti hai — galla, bank account, Easypaisa, JazzCash — har sale, adaigi aur kharche se nikle balance ke saath. Khol kar cash book dekhein; raqam ek se doosre mein bhejein.
cash.example: Galla Rs. 40,000 + HBL Rs. 2,00,000 + Easypaisa Rs. 15,000.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Kisi bhi dinon ka nafa nuqsan, sab se zyada bikne wale, 7 din ka andaza, purana stock, qisam war stock aur qeemat ki tabdeeliyan. Accountant ke liye download karein.
reports.example: Is mahine: sale Rs. 12,50,000, kharchon ke baad munafa Rs. 1,40,000.

settings.title: Dukaan ki settings
settings.body: App mein aap ki dukaan kaise chale: naam aur bill, tax, zubaan, qeemat ke usool, barcode, item aur device ke usool, audit ki hadein. Sirf owner.
settings.example: "Purane mobile ka lock check" on karein → koi purana phone iCloud / Google check ke baghair nahi khareeda jayega.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Dukaan mein kaam karne walon ko shamil karein, har ek ko role dein, hazri lagayein aur dekhein kis ne kya kiya. Sirf owner.
staff.example: Ali ko salesman banayein → woh bech aur khareed sakta hai magar aap ki khareed qeemat ya munafa nahi dekh sakta.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Chunein ke app kaun se WhatsApp ya email message bheje: har sale par aap ko, raat ki report, udhaar reminder, aur customer ko bill. Sirf owner.
notifications.example: Raat 9:30 par report on → har raat din ka hisaab WhatsApp par.

fees.title: Software fees
fees.body: Is software ka aap ka plan, kab tak ada hai, kahan ada karein, aur adaigi kaise batayein ya renewal code lagayein. Sirf owner.
fees.example: 30 November tak ada; JazzCash par Rs. 2,000 bhejein aur transaction ID ke saath batayein.

pin.title: Quick PIN
pin.body: Poore password ke bajaye phone par app jaldi kholne ke liye 4 se 6 hindson ka PIN. Owner ka PIN salesman ki kam qeemat sale ki ijazat bhi deta hai.
pin.example: PIN 4321 rakhein → agli dafa 4321 likh kar login.

transfers.title: Branch transfer
transfers.body: Is dukaan se mobile aur items apni doosri branch ko bhejein. Mobile is dukaan ke stock se nikal jata hai (us ki history yahin rehti hai) aur branch ke stock mein usi IMEI, barcode, khareed aur farokht ki qeemat ke saath aa jata hai. Items apni khareed ki qeemat ke saath jate hain. Kuch bikta nahi, is liye munafa nahi badalta.
transfers.example: Saddar se Mall Road branch ko ek iPhone 13 aur 10 charger bhejein: Saddar ka stock khareed par Rs. 1,52,000 kam, Mall Road ka utna hi zyada.

pinPassword.title: Aap ka password
pinPassword.body: Aap ka poora login password, taake PIN rakhne se pehle tasdeeq ho ke aap hi hain.
pinPassword.example: Jis password se login karte hain woh likhein, phir naya PIN.

pinNew.title: Naya PIN
pinNew.body: 4 se 6 hindse jo sirf aap jaante hon. 1234 ya apna phone number na rakhein.

shops.title: Meri dukaanein
shops.body: Agar aap ki ek se zyada dukaanein hain to chunein kis mein kaam kar rahe hain. Har dukaan ka stock, khata aur cash alag hai.
shops.example: "Star Mobiles Saddar" dabayein → ab sab kuch isi branch ka dikhega.

app.title: App
app.body: Sirf is phone par app kaisi dikhe: zubaan, rang aur roshan ya andhera. Is se bill ya doosron ki screen nahi badalti.
app.example: Aap yahan Urdu chunein; salesman apne phone par English rakh sakta hai.

language.title: Zubaan
language.body: Is phone par screen ki zubaan: Urdu, Roman Urdu ya English. Bill settings wali print ki zubaan mein chhapte hain.

look.title: Look
look.body: Is phone par app ke rangon ka andaaz. Sirf shakal badalti hai, data nahi.
look.example: "Navy" chunein → gehre neele header aur card.

theme.title: Roshni
theme.body: Roshan, andhera, ya phone ki apni setting ke mutabiq. Raat ko andhera aankhon ke liye aasan hai.
theme.example: "System" chunein → phone andhere par jaaye to app bhi.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint login
fingerprint.body: Password ke bajaye is phone par ek touch se login. Finger ka nishan phone hi mein rehta hai; app use nahi dekhti. Staff tab hi use kar sakta hai jab owner settings mein ijazat de.
fingerprint.example: On karein → agli dafa "fingerprint se login" dabayein aur sensor chhooein.

purchaseDoc.title: Khareed ka bill
purchaseDoc.body: Ek khareed: kis se khareeda, us ke phone aur item, kul raqam, kitni di aur kitni baqi. Yahin se lines wapis ya bill cancel kar sakte hain.
purchaseDoc.example: Ali Traders se P-000045: 5 phone, Rs. 1,65,000, diye Rs. 1,00,000 → baqi Rs. 65,000.

purchaseFrom.title: Kis se khareeda
purchaseFrom.body: Dealer ya banda jis se khareeda. Naam dabayein to us ka khata khulega.
purchaseFrom.example: Ali Traders → un ke khate mein ye bill aur jo aap par hai.

addedBy.title: Darj karne wala
addedBy.body: Staff ka woh banda jis ne ye bill app mein darj kiya.
addedBy.example: Darj karne wala Ali → us ne apne phone se daala.

purchaseTotal.title: Kul
purchaseTotal.body: Is khareed ki poori raqam: sab phone aur item, discount ke baad.

purchasePaid.title: Ada kiya
purchasePaid.body: Is bill ke liye ab tak bechne wale ko kitna diya, khareedte waqt aur baad mein.

purchaseReturned.title: Wapis kiya
purchaseReturned.body: Is bill ke phone ya item jo aap ne bechne wale ko wapis kiye, un ki maaliyat.

purchaseDue.title: Baqi
purchaseDue.body: Is bill par abhi bechne wale ko kitna dena hai: kul minus ada minus wapis. Ye us ke khate mein hai.

purchaseRefund.title: Wapis raqam
purchaseRefund.body: Wapis kiye maal ke badle bechne wala abhi kitna cash lautata hai. Na lautaye to 0 rakhein: tab raqam aap ke khate ke baqaye se kat jayegi.
purchaseRefund.example: Rs. 33,000 ka phone wapis: dealer Rs. 33,000 cash deta hai → 33000 likhein. Baqaye mein kaat-ta hai → 0 rakhein.

returnReason.title: Wajah
returnReason.body: Wapsi ki wajah, chand alfaaz mein. Wapsi ke record par rehti hai.

kindStock.title: Phone (stock)
kindStock.body: Ek sheet mein bohat se phone, har row mein IMEI, brand, model, haalat, PTA, khareed aur asking price. Supplier ho to khareed ka bill, na ho to purana stock.
kindStock.example: Shelf par 50 purane phone → ek sheet, ek upload.

kindPeople.title: Log
kindPeople.body: Customer aur dealer, phone, qisam aur agar ho to purana baqaya.
kindPeople.example: Purana register naqal karein: Bilal, 0321 5550002, par Rs. 12,000.

kindItems.title: Accessories
kindItems.body: Accessories, maujood tadaad, fi piece khareed aur bechne ki qeemat ke saath.
kindItems.example: Type-C cable, 40 piece, khareed Rs. 120, qeemat Rs. 250.

kindSales.title: Sale
kindSales.body: Un phones ki sale jo pehle se app ke stock mein hain: IMEI, qeemat, ada aur customer. Jo ada na ho woh customer ke khate mein.
kindSales.example: Copy se pichle hafte ki 12 sale → ek upload.

kindExpenses.title: Kharche
kindExpenses.body: Kharche, tareekh, qisam, raqam aur jis account se diya.
kindExpenses.example: October ka kiraya Rs. 40,000, bijli Rs. 9,500, chai Rs. 3,000.

step1.title: Sheet download karein
step1.body: Sahi tarteeb wali Excel file, peeli namoona rows, help sheet aur dropdown lists ke saath. Namoona rows khud chhor di jaati hain.
step1.example: Download karein, Excel mein kholein, namoonon ke neeche apne phone likhein.

step2.title: Excel mein bharein
step2.body: Har phone, banda, item, sale ya kharche ki ek row likhein. Column ke naam na badlein.

step3.title: Upload aur check
step3.body: Bhari hui file chunein (Excel ya CSV, 2,000 rows tak) aur Check dabayein. App har row parh kar batati hai kya ghalat hai. Abhi kuch save nahi hota.
step3.example: 50 rows → 47 theek, 2 note, 1 ghalti (IMEI mein 14 hindse).

optCatalogue.title: Naye brand aur model banayein
optCatalogue.body: On: sheet ka jo brand ya model aap ki list mein nahi, khud shamil ho jayega. Off: aisi row ghalti dikhayegi taake aap spelling theek karein.
optCatalogue.example: Sheet mein "Tecno Spark 20". On → model ban jayega. Off → "model nahi mila".

optBelowCost.title: Khareed se kam par bechna
optBelowCost.body: On: sheet ki woh sale jo phone ki khareed qeemat se kam ho, qubool hogi (aap nuqsan ki tasdeeq karte hain). Off: aisi row ghalti dikhayegi.
optBelowCost.example: Phone ki khareed Rs. 40,000, sheet mein Rs. 38,000 mein bika. Off → ghalti. On → Rs. 2,000 nuqsan ke saath save.

optSkip.title: Ghalat rows chhor dein
optSkip.body: Off: kisi ek row mein bhi ghalti ho to kuch nahi daalega (sab ya kuch nahi). On: theek rows daal di jayengi, ghalat wali theek karne ke liye reh jayengi.
optSkip.example: 50 rows, 1 ghalti. Off → pehle theek karein. On → 49 save, 1 reh gayi.

preview.title: Check ka nateeja
preview.body: Save karne se pehle app ko aap ki file mein row ba row kya mila. Row dabayein to har message aur value dikhegi.
preview.example: Row 12: "IMEI pehle se stock mein" → sheet se hata dein.

counts.title: Rows ki ginti
counts.body: ok: save hogi. note: save hogi magar note parhein. error: theek kiye baghair save nahi. skipped: namoona ya khaali rows.
counts.example: 45 ok · 3 note · 2 error · 3 skipped → 2 rows theek karein ya "ghalat chhor dein" lagayein.

done.title: Import ho gaya
done.body: Import se kya save hua: kitne phone, bill, log waghera, aur kitni rows reh gayin.
done.example: 48 phone aur 1 khareed bill save · 2 rows reh gayin.

export.title: Mera data download
export.body: Aap ka maujooda data sheet wali tarteeb mein, Excel ya CSV. Excel mein theek kar ke wapis daalein, ya backup ke tor par rakhein.
export.example: Stock download → Excel mein dekhein → accountant ke liye copy rakhein.

history.title: Pichle import
history.body: Pehle kiya gaya har import: qisam, file, kis ne, kab aur kya bana. Wohi file dobara daalein to app khabardar karti hai.

staff.title: Staff ki list
staff.body: Har woh banda jo aap ki dukaan mein login kar sakta hai, role ke saath. Kisi par dabayein to role badlein, password naya karein ya band karein.
staff.example: Ali · Salesman, Usman · Technician, Kashif · Manager.

hazri.title: Hazri
hazri.body: Chune hue dinon mein har bande ki hazri: present, aadha din, chhutti, absent, aur "record nahi" un dinon ke liye jo kisi ne nahi lagaye. Kisi par daba kar din lagayein.
hazri.example: Is mahine Ali: 20 present, 2 aadha, 1 chhutti, 0 absent, 1 record nahi.

activity.title: Activity
activity.body: Chune hue dinon mein har bande ne kya kiya: sale (ginti · Rs), wasool raqam, khareed, kharche, repair aur app mein kaamon ki ginti. Kisi par dabayein to poori list.
activity.example: Aaj Ali: 4 sale · Rs. 1,52,000, wasool Rs. 90,000, 1 khareed, 23 kaam.

name.title: Naam
name.body: Staff ka naam, jo us ke banaye bills aur reports mein dikhega.

phone.title: Mobile number
phone.body: Us ka apna mobile number. Woh isi number se login karta hai.
phone.example: 0300 1112233 → Ali login ke liye yehi number likhta hai.

password.title: Password
password.body: Kam az kam 6 huroof. Use alag se batayein; woh apne number aur is password se login karega.

pin.title: Quick PIN
pin.body: Ikhtiyari 4 se 6 hindse, dukaan ke phone par password ke bajaye jaldi login ke liye.
pin.example: PIN 2580 → Ali do second mein app kholta hai.

role.title: Role
role.body: Ye banda kya kar sakta hai. Salesman: bechna, khareedna, raqam lena; khareed qeemat ya munafa nahi dekh sakta. Technician: sirf repair ka kaam. Manager: staff aur dukaan ki settings ke siwa sab, khareed aur munafa dekhta hai.
role.example: Salesman Ali phone ki asking Rs. 45,000 dekhta hai, magar ye nahi ke khareed Rs. 40,000 thi.

resetPassword.title: Naya password
resetPassword.body: Woh bhool gaya ho to naya password likhein. Purana kaam karna band kar dega.
resetPassword.example: Ali bhool gaya → ali@1122 likhein aur save karein; use naya batayein.

disable.title: Band / chalu
disable.body: Band karne se woh foran login nahi kar sakega. Us ka kiya hua kuch nahi mit-ta; bill aur history rehti hai. Chalu karein to wapis aa sakta hai.
disable.example: Ali ne naukri chhor di → band karein; us ki purani sale par us ka naam rahega.

hazriMark.title: Hazri lagayein
hazriMark.body: Is bande ki kisi ek din ki hazri lagayein ya durust karein. Usi din dobara lagayein to purani badal jayegi.
hazriMark.example: Ali kal hazri lagana bhool gaya → din = kal, present, save.

hazriStatus.title: Din ki haalat
hazriStatus.body: Present, aadha din, chhutti (ijazat se) ya absent (baghair ijazat nahi aaya).

toOwner.title: Owner ko
toOwner.body: Aap ko aane wale message: har sale ya khareed par, WhatsApp ya email se. Yahan apna number aur email likhein.
toOwner.example: Sale on: Ali 4 baje phone bechta hai → aap ko WhatsApp par "Sale INV-000231 Rs. 38,000".

ownerWhatsapp.title: Owner ka WhatsApp number
ownerWhatsapp.body: Aap ka apna WhatsApp number. Sale ki ittila aur raat ki report yahan aati hai.

ownerEmail.title: Owner ka email
ownerEmail.body: Aap ka email, un messages ke liye jo aap email par chahte hain.

ownerOnSale.title: Har sale par
ownerOnSale.body: On: dukaan mein koi bhi sale kare to aap ko bill number aur raqam ke saath message aayega.
ownerOnSale.example: On → aap dukaan se bahar hon tab bhi har sale foran dikhe.

ownerOnPurchase.title: Stock aane par
ownerOnPurchase.body: On: jab bhi khareed (stock) darj ho aap ko message aayega.
ownerOnPurchase.example: Salesman Rs. 70,000 ka purana iPhone 11 khareedta hai → aap ko foran pata.

sending.title: WhatsApp kaise jaata hai
sending.body: Server par WhatsApp Business API lagi ho to message khud jaate hain. Na ho to har message WhatsApp mein khulta hai aur aap Send dabate hain.
sending.example: API nahi → sale ki ittila neeche "Messages" mein; Share dabayein → WhatsApp tayyar text ke saath khulega.

emailSending.title: Email kaise jaati hai
emailSending.body: Email tab hi jaati hai jab software wala server par email account (SMTP) lagaye. Tab tak email message list mein ruke rehte hain.
emailSending.example: SMTP nahi → email wali raat ki report "Messages" mein ruki hai; software wale se lagwayein.

dailyReport.title: Owner ko raat ki report
dailyReport.body: Din mein ek dafa, aap ke rakhe waqt par, din ka hisaab aap ko bheja jaata hai: bike phone aur sale, haath mein cash, diya aur mila udhaar, kharche, munafa aur stock.
dailyReport.example: Raat 9:30: "Sale Rs. 1,20,000 · Kharche Rs. 3,000 · Galla Rs. 62,000".

dailyReportOn.title: Har raat din ka hisaab bhejein
dailyReportOn.body: On: raat ki report WhatsApp ya email (jo aap chunein) par jayegi. Off: nahi jayegi, magar haath se bhej sakte hain.
dailyReportOn.example: WhatsApp on → har raat 9:30 par hisaab 0321 5550002 par.

reportTime.title: Report ka waqt
reportTime.body: Din ka woh waqt jab raat ki report jaati hai, dukaan ke waqt ke mutabiq.
reportTime.example: 21:30 → dukaan band hone ke baad raat 9:30 par.

sendNow.title: Aaj ka hisaab abhi bhejein
sendNow.body: Aaj ki report abhi aap ke WhatsApp ya email par bhejta hai, raat ka intezar kiye baghair.
sendNow.example: 6 baje jaldi ja rahe hain → dabayein aur ab tak ka hisaab paayein.

reminders.title: Udhaar reminder
reminders.body: App udhaar wale customers ko WhatsApp par yaad dila sakti hai, din mein ek dafa muqarrara waqt par, sirf jab un ka khata kuch din se na hila ho, aur utne din guzarne tak dobara nahi.
reminders.example: 7 din: Bilal par Rs. 12,000, 9 din se kuch nahi diya → subah 11 baje narm reminder.

remindAuto.title: Customers ko khud yaad dilayein
remindAuto.body: On: har din neeche wale waqt par woh customer jin par udhaar hai aur jin ka khata muqarrara dinon se nahi hila, WhatsApp reminder paayenge. Off: sirf haath se.
remindAuto.example: On → 15 customers ko call karne ki zaroorat nahi; app yaad dilati hai.

remindAfter.title: Jab khata itne din se ruka ho
remindAfter.body: Customer ke aakhri bill ya adaigi ke baad kitne din guzrein to reminder jaaye. Usi customer ko utne din guzarne tak dobara yaad nahi dilaya jaata.
remindAfter.example: 7 din: Bilal ne aakhri dafa 1 tareekh ko diya → 8 ko reminder, phir 15 se pehle nahi.

remindTime.title: Reminder ka waqt
remindTime.body: Din ka woh waqt jab khud kaar reminders jaate hain, dukaan ke waqt ke mutabiq. Munasib waqt rakhein.

toCustomer.title: Customer ko
toCustomer.body: Customer ya bechne wale ko jaane wale message: sale ka bill, adaigi par raseed, aur phone bechne wale ko parchi.
toCustomer.example: WhatsApp par sale → Bilal ko adaigi ke foran baad apne phone par bill.

customerOnSale.title: Customer ko bill
customerOnSale.body: On: har sale ke baad customer ko WhatsApp ya email par bill jayega (agar number / email save ho).
customerOnSale.example: 0321… number wala customer cover khareedta hai → use "INV-000232 Rs. 800, shukriya".

customerOnPayment.title: Adaigi par raseed
customerOnPayment.body: On: customer khate mein raqam de to use naye baqaye ke saath WhatsApp raseed milegi.
customerOnPayment.example: Bilal Rs. 5,000 deta hai → "Rs. 5,000 wasool. Baqi Rs. 7,000."

sellerOnPurchase.title: Bechne wale ko parchi
sellerOnPurchase.body: On: jo banda aap ko phone beche use saude ki WhatsApp parchi milegi — kya becha aur kitne mein, is ka saboot.
sellerOnPurchase.example: Ek customer apna Redmi Note 12 Rs. 28,000 mein bechta hai → use WhatsApp par parchi.

language.title: Message ki zubaan
language.body: Customers ko jaane wale messages ki zubaan. "Shop default" settings wali print ki zubaan leti hai.
language.example: Dukaan English mein chhaapti hai magar customer Urdu parhte hain → yahan Urdu chunein.

queue.title: Messages
queue.body: App ka banaya har message, naya pehle: gaya, intezar mein ya nakaam. Intezar wala WhatsApp message Share se khulta hai; phir "Mark sent" dabayein.
queue.example: Bilal ka reminder "Queued" → Share → WhatsApp mein bhejein → Mark sent.

plan.title: Aap ka plan
plan.body: Aap ki dukaan ka software plan aur us ki haalat. Khatam hone ke qareeb rang peela aur khatam hone par laal.
plan.example: Plan "basic", 30 November tak ada, 12 din baqi.

monthly.title: Mahana fees
monthly.body: Software ki har mahine ki fees.

paidUntil.title: Kab tak ada
paidUntil.body: Fees jis din tak kaafi hai. Sab chalta rahe is ke liye pehle ada karein. Aap ka data kabhi nahi mit-ta.
paidUntil.example: 30 Nov tak ada → 28 Nov ko 1 mahina dein → 30 Dec tak.

payInto.title: In mein se kisi mein ada karein
payInto.body: Software wale ke bank aur wallet account. Copy daba kar number copy karein, phir bank app, Easypaisa ya JazzCash se bhejein.
payInto.example: JazzCash number copy → Rs. 2,000 bhejein → transaction ID rakhein.

report.title: Maine ada kar diya
report.body: Adaigi ke baad yahan batayein: raqam, mahine, kaise diya aur transaction ID ya screenshot. Manzoori par plan barh jaata hai.
report.example: Easypaisa par 3 mahine ke Rs. 6,000, ID 01234567890 → Send → "Being checked" → "Received".

amount.title: Raqam (Rs)
amount.body: Aap ne kitna bheja. Khud mahana fees × mahine bharta hai; mukhtalif diya ho to badlein.

months.title: Mahine
months.body: Ye adaigi kitne mahinon ki hai.

method.title: Kis se diya
method.body: Software wale ke kis account mein raqam bheji.
method.example: JazzCash account mein bheji → JazzCash dabayein.

reference.title: Transaction ID
reference.body: Adaigi ke SMS ya app ka ID ya reference number, taake software wala aap ki raqam dhoond sake.

paidOn.title: Adaigi ki tareekh
paidOn.body: Jis din aap ne raqam bheji.

proof.title: Screenshot
proof.body: Adaigi ki tasveer ya screenshot. Is se manzoori jaldi hoti hai.
proof.example: JazzCash ki "Transaction successful" screen ka screenshot.

code.title: Renewal code
code.body: Adaigi ke baad software wala WhatsApp par code bhejta hai. Yahan daal kar plan foran barhayein — internet ke baghair bhi chalta hai.
code.example: Code mila → daalein → Renew → "30 Dec tak ada".

codePaste.title: Code daalein
codePaste.body: Poora code bilkul waisa hi daalein jaisa mila. Ek code sirf ek dafa chalta hai.
codePaste.example: Der tak dabayein → Paste → code se renew.

backup.title: Mere data ka backup
backup.body: Har list (stock, khata, sale, khareed, kharche…) Excel files mein ek zip mein download. Plan khatam ho tab bhi chalta hai.
backup.example: Mahine mein ek dafa: Backup → zip computer ya Google Drive par rakhein.

history.title: Aap ki adaigiyan
history.body: Har batayi gayi fees aur us ki haalat: being checked, received ya not accepted. Received wali ki raseed chhaapein.
history.example: October Rs. 2,000 · Received → raseed number daba kar chhaapein.

due.title: Fee jo abhi deni hai
due.body: Aap ke package ke woh mahine jo fee ada hone se pehle diye gaye. Har line mein muddat, fee, aap ne kitna diya aur kitna baqi hai. Aap jo payment bhejenge woh pehle yeh poora karegi.
due.example: FEE-0003, 2 mahine Rs. 3,000, aap ne Rs. 1,000 diye → Kuch ada hui, Rs. 2,000 abhi dene hain.

move.title: Accounts ke darmiyan raqam bhejein
move.body: Apne ek account se doosre mein raqam — galle se bank, ya bank se galle mein. Ye na sale hai na kharcha: sirf dono balance badalte hain.
move.example: Galle se Rs. 1,00,000 HBL mein jama → galla −1,00,000, HBL +1,00,000, munafa wohi.

transfers.title: Bheji gayi raqam
transfers.body: Aap ke accounts ke darmiyan taaza transfers, karne wale ke saath. Kati hui line wali wapis ki gayi.

moveAmount.title: Raqam
moveAmount.body: Kitni raqam bhejni hai, rupees mein.
moveAmount.example: 100000 → Rs. 1,00,000 galle se nikal kar bank mein.

kind.title: Qisam
kind.body: Ye account kis qisam ka hai: cash (galla ya daraz), bank, Easypaisa ya JazzCash.
kind.example: Doosre counter ka daraz → Cash. Meezan account → Bank.

name.title: Account ka naam
name.body: Chhota naam jo raqam ki jagah chunte waqt pehchan lein.

accountNo.title: Account / wallet number
accountNo.body: Bank account ya wallet number, aap ki apni yaad ke liye.

opening.title: Shuru ka balance
opening.body: Account daalte din us mein pehle se maujood raqam. Is ke baad balance sirf sale, adaigi, kharche aur transfer se badalta hai.
opening.example: HBL mein pehle se Rs. 2,00,000 → 200000 likhein; kal Rs. 38,000 ki online sale → Rs. 2,38,000.

book.title: Cash book
book.body: Is account mein aane jaane wali har raqam, nayi pehle, har ek ke baad ka balance. Kati hui line wali wapis ki gayi.

profit.title: Munafa
profit.body: Chune hue dinon mein: kya becha, us ki khareed qeemat kya thi, kharche aur bacha hua asal munafa. Tax aur owner ki nikali raqam alag dikhti hai.
profit.example: Is mahine: sale Rs. 12,50,000 − khareed Rs. 10,60,000 − kharche Rs. 50,000 = munafa Rs. 1,40,000.

top.title: Sab se zyada bikne wale
top.body: Chune hue dinon mein sab se zyada kya bika: phone model ke hisaab se, baqi cheezein naam se, ginti, raqam aur un par munafe ke saath.

estimate.title: Andaza
estimate.body: Pichle 4 hafton ke inhi dinon se agle 7 din ki sale ka andaza, aur pichle 30 din ki raftar se har model ka stock kitne din chalega. Andaza hai, waada nahi.
estimate.example: Agle 7 din ≈ Rs. 3,10,000. Infinix Hot 40: 2 baqi, roz 1 bikta → 2 din mein khatam → "Buy more".

old.title: Purana stock
old.body: Aaj stock mein maujood phone, dukaan mein kitne din se hain is hisaab se: 0–15, 16–30, 31–60 aur 60 se zyada, khareed qeemat ke saath.
old.example: 60+ din: 4 phone, maaliyat Rs. 1,80,000 → paisa phansa; qeemat kam karne ka sochein.

types.title: Qisam war stock
types.body: Aap ka stock phone, tablet aur ghari mein taqseem: kitne, khareed aur asking par maaliyat, kitne purane, non-PTA, lock check ke baghair aur 60 din se purane.
types.example: Tablet: 6 unit, khareed Rs. 2,10,000, 1 ka lock check nahi hua.

prices.title: Qeemat ki tabdeeliyan
prices.body: Chune hue dinon mein phone ki asking price ki har tabdeeli aur asking se kam har sale, kis ne ki, kis ne ijazat di aur kitni kam.
prices.example: Ali ne Rs. 38,000 wala A15 Rs. 37,000 mein becha → "Sold under asking −1,000".

books.title: Balance sheet ka tab
books.body: Aap ki dukaan ka hisaab do safhon mein: balance sheet (kya paas hai, kya dena hai, aap ka hissa) aur trial balance (har khaata, debit aur credit). Ledger se banta hai, haath se kuch nahi likha jata.
books.example: Accountant 30 June ki balance sheet maange → 30-06 chunein aur Balance sheet kholein.

grossSales.title: Discount se pehle sale
grossSales.body: Chune hue dinon ki saari sale, discount aur wapsi kaatne se pehle. Cancel bill nahi gine jaate; tax shamil nahi.

discounts.title: Discount
discounts.body: In dinon mein customers ko bills par di gayi chhoot.

salesReturns.title: Sale ki wapsi
salesReturns.body: In dinon mein customers ki lautayi cheezon ki maaliyat (wapsi aur exchange ki raqam).

netSales.title: Asal sale
netSales.body: Jo waqai becha: discount aur wapsi ke baad sale, tax aur cancel bills ke baghair.

cogs.title: Bike maal ki khareed
cogs.body: Jo phone aur cheezein bechein woh aap ko kitne mein pari thin. Sirf bika hua gina jaata hai, shelf wala nahi.
cogs.example: 30 phone beche jin ki kul khareed Rs. 10,60,000 thi.

grossProfit.title: Gross munafa
grossProfit.body: Asal sale minus bike maal ki khareed — dukaan ke kharchon se pehle ka munafa.

operatingProfit.title: Kharchon ke baad munafa
operatingProfit.body: Gross munafa minus dukaan ke kharche (har qisam upar likhi hai). Owner ki nikali raqam kharcha nahi.

otherIncome.title: Repair aur doosri aamdani
otherIncome.body: In dinon mein repair ke kaam aur doosri aamdani. Ye munafe mein jama hoti hai.

netProfit.title: Khalis munafa / nuqsan
netProfit.body: In dinon mein dukaan ki asal kamai: kharchon ke baad munafa plus repair aur doosri aamdani. Zero se kam ho to nuqsan.
netProfit.example: Rs. 1,40,000 + Rs. 15,000 repair = Rs. 1,55,000 khalis munafa.

taxCollected.title: Jama shuda tax
taxCollected.body: In dinon mein bills par customers se liya gaya sales tax. Ye hukoomat ka hai, is liye sale ya munafe mein nahi.
taxCollected.example: Rs. 2,00,000 ke tax wale bills par 18% → Rs. 36,000 FBR mein jama karane hain.

ownerTook.title: Owner ne nikala
ownerTook.body: Owner ne ghar ya zaati kaam ke liye dukaan se jo raqam li. Cash kam hota hai, magar ye dukaan ka kharcha nahi, is liye munafa nahi badalta.
ownerTook.example: Owner ne ghar ke liye Rs. 50,000 liye → munafa Rs. 1,55,000 hi; galla Rs. 50,000 kam.

lists.title: Lists download
lists.body: Chune hue dinon ki sale, khareed ya kharchon ki poori list, Excel ya print ke liye, accountant ke liye.
lists.example: Is mahine ke kharche download → accountant ko WhatsApp par bhejein.

next7.title: Agle 7 din (andaza)
next7.body: Aane wale 7 dinon ki mutawaqqa sale: har din pichle 4 hafton ke usi din ki average. Muqable ke liye pichla aur us se pehla hafta bhi.
next7.example: Pichle 4 Saturdays ki average Rs. 60,000 → is Saturday ≈ Rs. 60,000.

runOut.title: Kaun sa phone khatam hoga
runOut.body: Har model ke liye: pichle 30 din mein bike, ab stock mein aur is raftar se kitne din baqi. 7 din ya kam hon to "Buy more"; stock ho magar 30 din mein koi na bika ho to "Not selling".
runOut.example: A15: 15 bike, 3 stock → 6 din → Buy more. Nokia 105: 4 stock, 0 bike → Not selling.

ageBucket.title: Dukaan mein din
ageBucket.body: Kitne phone itne din se stock mein hain, aur un ki khareed qeemat. Phone jitna der para rahe utna paisa phansa rehta hai.

typeCost.title: Khareed par
typeCost.body: Is qisam ke stock ke units ki kul khareed qeemat.

typeRetail.title: Asking par
typeRetail.body: Sab unit apni asking price par bikein to kitni raqam aaye.
typeRetail.example: 12 ghariyan asking Rs. 1,50,000 → Rs. 30,000 mumkina munafa.

typeUsed.title: Purane
typeUsed.body: In mein se kitne unit istemal shuda hain (naye / dabba pack nahi).

typeNonPta.title: Non-PTA / JV
typeNonPta.body: Woh unit jo PTA mein registered nahi (ya JV). Mohlat ke baad in mein SIM kaam nahi karti, is liye kam mein bikte hain.
typeNonPta.example: 3 non-PTA phone → bechne se pehle khareedar ko batayein.

typeLock.title: Lock check nahi / lock laga
typeLock.body: Pehla adad: woh purane unit jin ka iCloud / Google / FRP lock kabhi nahi check hua. Doosra: jin par lock abhi laga hai — saaf hone tak bik nahi sakte.
typeLock.example: 1 / 1 → ek tablet abhi check karein; doosre ka iCloud bechne wale se hatwayein.

typeSlow.title: 60 din se purane
typeSlow.body: Is qisam ke woh unit jo 60 din se zyada se stock mein hain.
typeSlow.example: 2 ghariyan 60 din se zyada → offer par lagayein.

priceRows.title: Qeemat kis ne badli
priceRows.body: Pehli list har bande ka jor: kitni dafa asking badli, kitni sale asking se kam aur kul kitni kam. Neeche har tabdeeli ya sale, ijazat dene wale ke saath.
priceRows.example: Ali: 3 changes · 2 under asking · −2,500 → neeche dekhein kaun se phone.

sticker.title: Repair sticker
sticker.body: Customer ke phone ke liye chhota sticker jis par job number aur tafseel ho, taake mez par ya lab mein kisi aur phone se na mile. Barcode job number hai: scan karein to job khul jati hai.
sticker.example: Ahmed ka Samsung A54 aaya: sticker REP-000012 · Ahmed · A54 · Screen · Tayyar 05-11 print kar ke peeche laga dein.

stickerFields.title: Sticker par kya ho
stickerFields.body: Kisi khane par tap karein to woh sticker par aayega ya hat jayega. Aap ki pasand isi phone par yaad rehti hai. Phone ka screen lock kabhi print nahi hota.
stickerFields.example: Lab bhejne ke liye Job number, Barcode, Phone model, Kharabi aur Lab chunein; counter ke liye Customer aur Mobile number bhi.

send.title: Lab ko bhejein
send.body: Jab aap ka apna technician theek na kar sake to phone market ki kisi repair lab / technician ko dein aur yahan darj karein: kis ke paas hai, kab se, kya karna hai aur rate. Ek waqt mein ek lab.
send.example: iPhone 11 ka board ka kaam: "Zain Mobile Lab, Hall Road" ko bhejein, rate Rs. 4,500, 2 din mein wapsi.

atLab.title: Abhi lab mein
atLab.body: Yeh phone bahar ki lab ke paas hai. Kab se, mutawaqqa din aur lab ka rate dikhta hai. Lab der kare to laal ho jata hai.
atLab.example: 01-11 ko Ali Repair Lab ko bheja, mutawaqqa 03-11; 04-11 ko "Der" dikhayega.

trips.title: Lab ke chakkar
trips.body: Har baar jab yeh phone lab gaya: kaun si lab, bhejne aur wapsi ki tareekh, theek hua ya nahi, aur charge. Kuch bhi delete nahi hota.
trips.example: Ali Lab 01-11 → 03-11 theek nahi Rs. 500; Zain Lab 03-11 → 05-11 theek Rs. 4,000.

problem.title: Lab kya kare
problem.body: Jo kaam aap lab ko de rahe hain, apne alfaaz mein. Yeh job aur lab ke record mein dikhta hai.
problem.example: "Screen badlein, purana frame rakhein" ya "board check karein, power nahi".

quoted.title: Lab ka bataya rate
quoted.body: Kaam shuru karne se pehle lab ne jo rate bataya. Sirf record ke liye; asal charge phone wapas aane par likha jata hai.
quoted.example: Lab ne Rs. 4,500 kaha; wapsi par Rs. 4,000 liya: tab 4,000 likhein.

expected.title: Wapsi mutawaqqa
expected.body: Jis din lab ne phone wapas karne ka wada kiya. Is ke baad job aur lab par "Der" aata hai taake aap phone kar sakein.
expected.example: Jumeraat ka wada; Jumma ko repair mein der dikhayega.

outcome.title: Kya lab ne theek kiya?
outcome.body: Theek: job "tayyar" ho jati hai aur customer ko tayyar ka message jata hai. Theek nahi: job khuli rehti hai; kisi aur lab ko bhej sakte hain.
outcome.example: Ali board theek na kar saka → Theek nahi → Zain Lab ko bhejein.

charge.title: Lab ka charge
charge.body: Lab ne is chakkar ka jo liya, chahe theek na kar saki ho (checking). Customer ke phone par yeh repair ki laagat hai; apne phone par us phone ki qeemat mein jud jata hai.
charge.example: Lab ne screen ke Rs. 4,000 liye: aap ka bill Rs. 9,000 → munafa Rs. 5,000.

paidNow.title: Lab ko abhi diye
paidNow.body: Phone lete waqt lab ko jo naqd diya. Baqi lab ke khate mein jata hai aur baad mein khate se ada karte hain.
paidNow.example: Charge Rs. 4,000, abhi Rs. 1,000 diye → Rs. 3,000 lab ke khate mein.

cancel.title: Bhejna mansookh
cancel.body: Jab ghalti se bheja darj hua ho ya lab ne phone liya hi na ho. Yeh chakkar wajah ke sath history mein mansookh ke taur par rehta hai.
cancel.example: Ali Lab chuni lekin Zain ko diya: "ghalat lab" likh kar mansookh karein aur Zain ko bhejein.

labs.title: Repair labs
labs.body: Market ki labs aur technician jinhein aap phone bhejte hain. Har ek ka record: bheje, theek, theek nahi, din, charges aur dukaan ne kitna dena hai.
labs.example: Zain Mobile Lab: 12 bheje, 10 theek (83%), ausat 2 din, dukaan ne Rs. 6,500 dene hain.

labPage.title: Lab ka record
labPage.body: Ek lab ka sab kuch: dukaan ne kitna dena hai, kitne phone gaye aur theek hue, kitne din lagte hain, aur har phone tareekh aur charge ke sath.
labPage.example: Ali Repair Lab: Rs. 500 dene hain, 3 phone bheje, 1 theek, 2 theek nahi, ausat 3 din.

owe.title: Dukaan ne lab ko dene hain
owe.body: Lab ke woh charges jo abhi ada nahi hue, us ke khate se. Lab ke khate mein "Paise diye" se ada karein.
owe.example: Charges Rs. 4,500, ada Rs. 1,000 → dukaan ne Rs. 3,500 dene hain.

sent.title: Bheje
sent.body: Is lab ko kitne phone gaye (mansookh chakkar nahi gine jaate).

atLabShort.title: Lab mein
atLabShort.body: Jo phone abhi is lab ke paas hain.
atLabShort.example: 2 lab mein: ek iPhone 11 aur ek Redmi Note 12.

late.title: Der
late.body: Woh phone jo wade ke din ke baad bhi lab mein hain. Lab ko phone karein.

fixed.title: Theek ho gaya
fixed.body: Woh phone jo is lab ne theek kar ke wapas kiye.

notFixed.title: Theek nahi hua
notFixed.body: Woh phone jo yeh lab theek kiye baghair wapas laayi.
notFixed.example: 10 mein se 2 theek hue baghair wapas aaye.

fixRate.title: Theek %
fixRate.body: Jo phone wapas aaye un mein se kitne theek hue. Lab chunne se pehle muqabla karein.

avgDays.title: Ausat din
avgDays.body: Yeh lab ausatan kitne din phone rakhti hai.
avgDays.example: 1, 2 aur 3 din mein wapas → ausat 2 din.

charges.title: Charges
charges.body: Wapas aane wale phones par lab ke saare charges.

tab.title: Balance sheet ka tab
tab.body: Aap ki dukaan ka hisaab do safhon mein: balance sheet (kya paas hai, kya dena hai, aap ka hissa) aur trial balance (har khaata, debit aur credit). Ledger se banta hai, haath se kuch nahi likha jata.
tab.example: Accountant 30 June ki balance sheet maange → 30-06 chunein aur Balance sheet kholein.

asOf.title: Is din tak
asOf.body: Report is din ke aakhir tak ki har cheez dikhati hai. Purana din chunein to hisaab waisa dikhega jaisa us din tha.
asOf.example: 31-12-2025 chunein → saal ke aakhri din ki balance sheet.

sheet.title: Balance sheet
sheet.body: Teen khaane: dukaan ke paas kya hai (raqam, logon ka udhaar, stock), dukaan ne kya dena hai (logon ko, tax) aur maalik ka hissa (daali hui raqam, ab tak ka munafa, nikaali hui raqam minus). Paas hai hamesha dena hai + maalik ka hissa ke barabar hota hai.
sheet.example: Paas hai Rs. 9,50,000 = dena hai Rs. 1,50,000 + maalik ka hissa Rs. 8,00,000.

trial.title: Trial balance
trial.body: Har khaata apne balance ke saath, debit mein (jo paas hai ya kharch hua) ya credit mein (jo kamaya ya dena hai). Dono ka kul hamesha barabar hota hai; accountant is se hisaab check karta hai.
trial.example: Galla Rs. 40,000 debit · Sale Rs. 3,00,000 credit · Bike maal ki khareed Rs. 2,40,000 debit …

has.title: Dukaan ke paas kya hai
has.body: Galle, bank aur wallet mein raqam, logon ne jo udhaar dena hai, aur stock apni khareed ki qeemat par.

owes.title: Dukaan ne kya dena hai
owes.body: Jo raqam abhi dealeron aur logon ko deni hai (udhaar aur liya hua len-den), aur bilon par liya hua tax jo abhi jama karana hai.

owner.title: Maalik ka hissa
owner.body: Maalik ke liye dukaan ki maaliyat: shuru mein ya baad mein daali hui raqam aur stock, jama ab tak ka munafa, minus jo aap ne apne liye nikaala.

check.title: Barabar hai
check.body: App check karti hai ke dukaan ke paas jo hai woh dena hai + maalik ka hissa ke barabar ho. Hamesha hona chahiye; kabhi na ho to support ko batayein.

profit.title: Ab tak ka munafa
profit.body: App par dukaan shuru hone se is din tak ka saara munafa: wohi raqam jo Munafa ka tab is poore arse ke liye dikhata hai. Maalik ka nikaala hua yahan kharcha nahi gina jata.
profit.example: Munafa ka tab pehle din se aaj tak Rs. 2,50,000 dikhaye → yahan bhi yehi.

page.title: Branch transfer
page.body: Is dukaan se mobile aur items apni doosri branch ko bhejein. Mobile is dukaan ke stock se nikal jata hai (us ki history yahin rehti hai) aur branch ke stock mein usi IMEI, barcode, khareed aur farokht ki qeemat ke saath aa jata hai. Items apni khareed ki qeemat ke saath jate hain. Kuch bikta nahi, is liye munafa nahi badalta.
page.example: Saddar se Mall Road branch ko ek iPhone 13 aur 10 charger bhejein: Saddar ka stock khareed par Rs. 1,52,000 kam, Mall Road ka utna hi zyada.

to.title: Kis branch ko
to.body: Woh branch jo stock legi. Sirf maalik ki woh branches dikhti hain jin mein aap kaam karte hain.
to.example: Saddar ki dukaan → Mall Road chunein.

phones.title: Mobile
phones.body: Yahan stock mein maujood mobile, tablet aur ghariyan jo branch ko jayengi. Talaash karein, IMEI ya barcode scan karein, ya mobile ke safhe se kholein.
phones.example: Galaxy A15 ka dabba scan karein → list mein aa jata hai.

items.title: Items
items.body: Charger, cover aur doosri gini jaane wali cheezein, kitne piece jayenge. Purane piece pehle jate hain, apni khareed ki qeemat par.
items.example: Type-C cable × 10 → is dukaan mein 10 kam, branch mein 10 zyada.

cost.title: Jaane wale stock ki maaliyat
cost.body: List mein har cheez ki khareed ki qeemat. Ye is dukaan ke stock se nikal kar branch ke stock mein jama hoti hai; na sale, na munafa, na naqad.

link.title: Gahak ke liye status ka link
link.body: Sirf is job ka nijji link. Gahak marhale (mausool, check hua, repair ho rahi hai, tayyar, wapas diya) tareekhon ke saath, tayyar hone ka din, bill aur baqi raqam dekhta hai. Use apna phone number, poora IMEI, screen lock, lab ka naam ya aap ki laagat kabhi nahi dikhti. Badla hua link nahi khulta.
link.example: Usman WhatsApp par poochta hai "mera phone tayyar hai?" → ek baar link bhej dein; phir woh khud dekh leta hai.

what.title: FBR Digital Invoicing
what.body: FBR ka nizaam (PRAL chalata hai) jo har sales tax invoice bante hi wusool kar ke use FBR number deta hai. Jis dukaan ko report karna lazmi hai (sales tax registered, FBR ne bataya ho) woh yahan on kare. Phir har bill khud FBR ko jata hai aur chhape bill par FBR number aur QR code aata hai.
what.example: Bill INV-000120 bana → FBR ne 7000007DI1747119701593 diya → bill par QR ke saath chhapta hai.

enabled.title: Bill FBR ko bhejein
enabled.body: On: har sale ka bill line mein lag kar FBR ko jata hai; internet ya FBR band ho to intezar karta hai aur baad mein khud chala jata hai. Band: kuch nahi jata, bill pehle ki tarah chhapte hain.
enabled.example: Shaam 5 baje internet band, teen bill bane → internet aate hi FBR ko chale jate hain.

env.title: Sandbox ya production
env.body: Sandbox FBR ka test nizaam hai: jaanch ke dauran test token ke saath istemal karein. Production asal nizaam hai: sirf IRIS ke production token ke saath us par jayein.
env.example: Pehla hafta: Sandbox aur FBR se test; pass ho to Production.

token.title: FBR security token
token.body: Lambi chaabi jo FBR Digital Invoicing ke liye IRIS mein deta hai (kai saal chalti hai). Ye server par taale mein rehti hai aur dobara kabhi nahi dikhti, aap ko bhi nahi; badalne ke liye nayi likhein.
token.example: IRIS → Digital Invoicing → token copy karein → yahan lagayein → Save.

saleType.title: Sale ki qism
saleType.body: FBR is line ke maal ko kaise dekhta hai, FBR ke apne alfaaz mein. Mobile: "Mobile Phones" (Naveen Schedule). Accessories: aam tor par "Goods at standard rate (default)". Badalne se pehle tax advisor se poochein.
saleType.example: Mobile → Mobile Phones; charger → Goods at standard rate (default).

hs.title: HS code
hs.body: Maal ka customs / PCT code jo FBR har line par maangta hai. Pehle se likhe code aam hain; durust code tax advisor batayega.

test.title: FBR se test
test.body: Ek farzi bill FBR ki test jaanch ko bhejta hai (FBR par kuch darj nahi hota). Batata hai ke token durust hai aur FBR dukaan ki tafseel maanta hai.
test.example: Test → "FBR ne test bill maan liya": ab bhejna on kar sakte hain.

status.title: Bill aur FBR
status.body: Bheje: FBR ne number de diya. Baqi: abhi FBR tak nahi pohanche (har minute dobara koshish). Radd hue: FBR ne parh kar inkaar kiya — dikhayi gayi wajah theek karein (masalan HS code) aur Dobara bhejein dabayein.
status.example: Radd: "Invalid HS code" → oopar HS code theek karein → Dobara bhejein.

billSent.title: FBR number
billSent.body: Woh number jo FBR ne is bill ko diya. Chhapa bill use QR code ke saath dikhata hai; gahak FBR se use check kar sakta hai.

page.title: Appearance
page.body: App apne liye badlein: roshan ya gehra, dashboard aur laptop side panel ka design, rang, bunyadi rang, likhai ka size, konay aur hindson ka font. Ye sirf isi phone ya computer par badalta hai; baqi staff apni pasand rakhta hai.
page.example: "Tiles" aur "Neela" chunein → dashboard par baray rangeen khane aur buttons neele ho jate hain.

theme.title: Roshan ya gehra
theme.body: Roshan chamakdar screen hai, gehra raat ko aankhon ke liye aasan. "Phone ke mutabiq" phone ki apni setting par chalta hai.
theme.example: "Gehra" chunein → poori app foran gehri ho jati hai.

design.title: Design
design.body: Dashboard aur laptop side panel ki tarteeb. Classic: rangeen qataarein aur cards. Tiles: baray rangeen khane. Saada: baghair khanon ki saaf fehrist. Bold: gehra panel aur din ki sale baray hindson mein. Har design mein pages aur buttons wohi rehte hain.
design.example: "Saada" chunein → aaj ke hindse aik saaf fehrist mein nazar aate hain.

palette.title: Rangon ka set
palette.body: Poori app ke rang: background, cards, gehra bara card aur numayan rang.
palette.example: "Navy" chunein → gehra neela andaaz, sunehri jhalak ke saath.

accent.title: Bunyadi rang
accent.body: Khaas buttons (Save, Bechein), khule tab aur numayan cheezon ka rang. "Pehle wala" chune hue rangon ke set ka apna rang rakhta hai.
accent.example: "Surkh" chunein → Save ka button aur khula tab surkh ho jate hain.

text.title: Likhai ka size
text.body: Likhai aur buttons baray ho jate hain taake counter par parhna aasan ho.
text.example: "Bara" chunein → har screen ki likhai thori bari ho jati hai.

corners.title: Konay
corners.body: Buttons aur cards ke konay kitne gol hon.
corners.example: "Seedhe" chunein → cards aur buttons chakor konon wale.

font.title: Hindson ka font
font.body: English huroof aur hindson ka font. Urdu likhai hamesha Nastaliq mein rehti hai.
font.example: "Manrope" chunein → 1,250 jaisi raqamein Manrope font mein.

reset.title: Pehle jaisa karein
reset.body: Appearance ki har pasand app ki asal halat par wapas.
reset.example: Rang aazmane ke baad dabayein → roshan theme, Classic design, asal rang.

landing.h1: Apni mobile shop apne phone se chalayein
landing.sub: Purane aur naye phone, CNIC verification aur bechne wale ki dastakhat shuda razamandi ke sath, udhaar khata, repair aur repair labs, accessories, FBR ke liye tayyar tax bill, branches, balance sheet aur poora shop audit — Android app, kisi bhi browser par online, aur offline. Urdu, Roman Urdu aur English mein.

landing.point3: Internet ke baghair bhi chalta hai

used.d: Aane wale se CNIC photo aur eGadget check ke saath khareedein, iqrar nama print karein, har phone ki poori kahani IMEI se.

new.d: Brand aur model se stock, box pack aur open box, PTA / Non-PTA / JV SIM time ke saath, bill par tax, aap ke logo wala bill.

repair.d: Job sheet, parts aur labour, WhatsApp par status, bill ke saath hawalgi — aur ginti se accessories.

landing.videoSub: App par hi record ki gayi: bill ke sath sale, shop audit, stock, udhaar khata, din ka hisaab, repair labs aur ek khula hua "?".
landing.videoHint: Chalane ke liye dabayein. Awaz nahi.
landing.modulesSub: Basic cheezein har plan mein. Baqi jab zaroorat ho shamil karein.

sale.d: Phone chunein, paise lein (cash, online, cheque, bahar se ya udhaar), raseed print ya WhatsApp karein.

purchase.d: Dealer, customer ya doosri dukaan se; camera se IMEI; dabba, charger aur accessories darj.

stock.d: Har phone, tablet aur smart watch apni khareed, maangi qeemat, haalat aur stock ke dinon ke saath.

verify.d: CNIC scan se form bhare; bechne wale ki photo, eGadget nateeja, dastkhat shuda iqrar; chori ke phone ruke.

khata.d: Kis ne aap ko dene hain aur aap ne kisay, har bill aur adaigi chalte baqaye ke saath.

payments.d: Cash, bank, Easypaisa, JazzCash — har ek apne khate mein, galle ki ginti ke saath din band.

invoices.d: Thermal raseed ya A4 bill English ya Urdu mein, PDF download aur share.

returns.d: Phone wapas lein, katauti karein, cash ya credit dein; purana phone andar, naya bahar.

hisaab.d: Aaj, is hafte ya kisi bhi tareekhon ki bikri, haath mein, udhaar, kharche aur munafa.

staff.d: Malik, manager, salesman, technician — har ek wohi dekhe jo usay dekhna chahiye; PIN aur fingerprint login.

imei.d: Koi bhi IMEI scan karein: ye phone pehle yahan aaya? Kis ne becha, kis ne khareeda.

languages.d: Ek waqt mein ek zubaan, Nastaliq Urdu, right-to-left; print shuda kaghaz dukaan ki zubaan mein.
