data.q: Kya mera data mehfooz hai? Kya doosri dukaanein dekh sakti hain?
data.a: Nahi. Har dukaan ka data alag hai aur har raat backup hota hai. Sirf aap ka staff, aap ke diye roles ke saath, aap ki dukaan dekh sakta hai.

phone.a: Nahi. Kisi bhi Android phone (app ya browser) aur iPhone / laptop ke browser par chalta hai. Thermal printer optional hai.

offline.a: Bechte rahein. Sale, stock aur adaigi phone mein rukti hai aur internet aate hi chali jaati hai.

staff.q: Kya mera salesman khareed qeemat dekh sakta hai?
staff.a: Sirf agar aap chahein. Malik, manager, salesman aur technician wohi dekhte hain jo aap ijazat dein.

cancel.q: Kya main kisi bhi waqt chhor sakta hoon?
cancel.a: Ji haan. Mahina-war adaigi; aap ka data aap ka hai aur kisi bhi waqt Excel mein download ho sakta hai.

scanner.q: Kaun sa barcode scanner chalta hai?
scanner.a: Koi bhi USB ya Bluetooth scanner jo keyboard ki tarah likhe — zyada tar aise hi hain, teen se aath hazaar rupay ke. Lagayein aur scan karein, koi setting nahi. Scanner na ho to phone ka camera bhi IMEI aur barcode parhta hai.

android.a: Ji haan. Isi page se (App download karein) download kar ke kisi bhi Android phone par install karein. Yahi account laptop ya iPhone ke kisi bhi browser mein bhi khulta hai.

verify.q: Purane phone ki jaanch kaise hoti hai?
verify.a: Purana phone khareedte waqt bechne wale ka shanakhti card scan karein, PTA aur IMEI darj karein; tablet aur watch par iCloud / Google lock ki jaanch bhi. Jaanch mukammal hone tak phone nahi bikta; chhorne ke liye wajah chahiye jo owner dekhta hai.

consent.q: Bechne wale ki razamandi kya hai?
consent.a: Jo banda aap ko purana phone bechta hai woh screen par iqrar name par dastakhat karta hai ke phone us ka hai aur chori ka nahi. Yeh us ke shanakhti card, IMEI aur tareekh ke sath mehfooz hota hai aur kabhi bhi print ho sakta hai.

yearly.a: Ji haan. Ek sath saal ki adaigi karein aur 10 mahinon ki qeemat mein 12 mahine lein — do mahine muft. Mahana adaigi bhi mojood hai.

fbr.q: Kya ye FBR ke sath chalta hai?
fbr.a: Ji haan. Har bill pehle se tax invoice jaisa hai. Sales tax registered dukaanon ke liye app har bill FBR ke Digital Invoicing system ko bhejti hai aur FBR number aur QR chhapti hai. Shuru mein band hai; aap ko NTN, STRN aur IRIS token chahiye, aur sandbox test ke baad hum aap ke sath on karte hain.

branches.q: Meri do dukaanein hain. Kya dono dekh sakta hoon?
branches.a: Ji haan. Ek login se aap ki saari dukaanein khulti hain; har ek ka apna stock, khata aur reports, aur branch transfer se ek se doosri ko stock bhej sakte hain.

landing.footer: Pakistan mein, Pakistani mobile shops ke liye banaya gaya.
landing.webSub: Wohi dukaan laptop ya desktop ke browser mein: keyboard shortcut wala side menu (F2 sale, F3 stock…), chaurri lists aur reports. Ek login, har device.
landing.newSub: Dukaandaron ne jo manga usi se bana — sab se naya sab se upar, sab shamil, Urdu aur English mein.

fbr.t: FBR Digital Invoicing ke liye tayyar
fbr.d: Har bill khud FBR ko ja sakta hai aur bill par FBR number aur us ka QR code chhapta hai. Jab tak NTN aur IRIS token na lagayein, band rehta hai; internet band ho to bill intezar karta hai aur baad mein chala jata hai.

taxbill.d: Raqam lafzon mein (lakh / crore), cashier aur waqt, tax ke baghair total, har rate ka tax aur kul tax — jaise FBR ka tax invoice hota hai. Ninth Schedule wale phone par tax chhoda ja sakta hai.

cashchange.t: Customer ne kitne diye, kitne wapas
cashchange.d: Customer ne jo diya likhein; screen baqi wapas ki raqam dikhati hai aur bill par dono chhapte hain.

books.d: Kisi bhi tareekh par dukaan ke paas kya hai, kis ka dena hai, aur maalik ka hissa kitna — har account sath sath, unhi entries se jin se baqi reports banti hain.

transfers.d: Ek dukaan se doosri ko phone aur items bhejein. Har phone ki history dono dukaanon mein rehti hai; items laagat par jate hain, is liye kisi branch mein jhoota munafa nahi dikhta.

repairlink.d: Customer ko WhatsApp par link milta hai aur woh apne phone ka haal dekh leta hai — mil gaya, lab par, tayyar — dukaan ko call kiye baghair.

accounts.t: Hisaab shuru se aakhir tak check
accounts.d: Typed item se stock kabhi minus nahi hota, wapsi stock ki qeemat par hoti hai, aur nuqsan hamesha minus ke nishan ke sath dikhta hai.

audit.t: Dukaan ka audit, kisi bhi arse ka
audit.d: Kisi bhi tareekhon ka munafa, naqd o bank, udhaar, stock aur amla — shuru, aakhir aur kisi bhi din ka balance, har raqam tap karein to us ke bill, ghaltiyan pakarne wali jaanch, poori report PDF ya Excel mein.

bulk.d: 300 purane mobile, apna khata, accessories, bikri aur kharchay ek sheet mein layein. Naql karne ko sample rows, save hone se pehle jaanch, aur wahi sheet wapas bahar.

history.d: Kitne ka aaya, kitne ka bika, har adaigi aur qeemat ki tabdeeli ek screen par; har banday ke mobile aur adaigiyan us ki screen par — har format mein download aur share.

prices.t: Fraud ke khilaf qeemat ke usool
prices.d: Tay qeemat khareedari par likhi jati hai; bikri par tabdeeli wajah ke saath record hoti hai, aur aap ke usool tay karte hain ke is se kam kaun bech sakta hai — chahein to malik ke PIN se.

ai.d: Urdu ya English mein poochein: "pichhle mahine Ahmed par kitna baqi tha?" — jawab aap ki dukaan ke data se. CNIC ya dabbe ke label ki tasveer form bhar deti hai.

home.d: Pehle tez kaam, phir aaj ki bikri, munafa, naqd, udhaar aur stock charts ke saath — jo dukaandar din mein das baar dekhta hai.

installments.d: Advance, plan aur har qist ki tareekh par yaad dehani ke saath qiston par bechein.

hazri.d: Phone se aana jaana, der ke nishan, har mulazim ki mahine ki hazri sheet.

otp.d: WhatsApp par code se password badlein; kisi ko phone nahi karna parta.

windows.d: Internet ke baghair dukaan sab kuch ek Windows PC par chala sakti hai, setup file aur raat ke backup ke saath.

barcode.t: Har unit ka barcode, koi bhi scanner
barcode.d: Khareedte hi har mobile aur item ka apna barcode banta hai; label aap ke size mein print. Koi bhi USB ya Bluetooth scanner lagayein: scan kar ke bechein, dhoondein, dabbe ka IMEI purchase mein daalein.

items.t: Accessories darjan mein, bikein aik aik
items.d: 5 darjan cable 1,200 rupay darjan khareedein — stock mein 60 piece, 100 rupay fi piece. Brand, quality, kis phone ke liye, wholesale aur kam se kam qeemat; har purchase ka lot mehfooz ke kitna baqi hai.

devices.t: Tablet aur smart watch, aik aik kar ke
devices.d: Wi-Fi ya SIM, RAM, storage, battery health, case size aur poori specs — agli baar aap ki model library khud bhar deti hai. Mobile jaisi hi history, bill aur khata.

lock.d: Used tablet ya watch sirf iCloud / Google / paired lock check hone ke baad khareedi jati hai; lock lagi device bechi nahi ja sakti. Har check kis ne aur kab kiya, history mein darj.

count.d: Shelf par sab kuch scan karein; app batati hai kya ghaib hai aur kya yahan nahi hona chahiye.

itemreports.t: Item reports aur tayyar order list
itemreports.d: Kam stock supplier ke hisaab se kya mangwana hai ke saath, cost aur sale price par stock ki maliyat, tez aur sust item, ruka hua stock, brand ke hisaab se munafa — aur aik saath % se qeematein badlein.

reminders.t: Wazeh plan yaad dehani, data kabhi band nahi
reminders.d: Plan khatam hone se pehle pursukoon patti, dikhayi gayi bank tafseel se app mein adaigi, aur tareekh ke baad bhi adaigi, export aur poora backup download ho sakta hai.

repairlabs.d: Phone Zain Lab ya Ali Lab ko bhejein aur darj karein: kis ke paas hai, kab se, rate kya. Theek ho ya na ho, lab ka charge us ke khate mein. Har lab ka record: kitne phone, kitne theek, kitne din, kitna dena hai.

sticker.d: Customer ke phone ka sticker print karein: job number, barcode, customer, model, IMEI, kharabi, tayyar hone ki tareekh. Print se pehle khane chunein; scan karein to job khul jaye.

lending.d: Baghair bill ke kisi ko di ya us se li gayi raqam: bills se alag, baad ki sale mein adjust, wapsi ki tareekh aur WhatsApp reminder ke sath.

help.t: Har cheez par misaal ke sath "?"
help.d: Har khane, card aur tab par chhota "?" jo use Urdu, Roman Urdu ya English mein dukaan ki misaal ke sath samjhata hai. 1,100 se zyada wazahatein.

trade.t: Sale, khareed aur staff ki report
trade.d: Counter par wasool vs udhaar, poore / kuch / baghair ada bill, har mulazim aur har customer ke hisaab se, har screen par print aur Excel.

repairaudit.d: Aaye aur wapas diye phone, repair ki aamdani, parts, lab charges aur asal munafa, har lab ka theek %, der wali jobs aur lab mein der wale phone.

roles.d: Salesman bech sakta hai, stock daal sakta hai, wapsi aur paison ka len-den kar sakta hai — lekin khareed qeemat, munafa aur dukaan ka audit kabhi nahi dekhta.

gst.d: Jis item ka apna GST % ho, tax wale bill par usi rate se; bill par "Tax (item-war)". Phone par bill ka rate.

appearance.d: Light ya dark, dashboard ke chaar design (Classic, Tiles, Simple, Bold), apna rang, bara likha hua aur gol ya seedhe kone — har computer aur phone apni shakal yaad rakhta hai.

billqr.d: Customer bill scan kar ke use online dekhta hai: cheezein, total, diye hue aur baqi. Naam, phone, cost ya khata kabhi nazar nahi aata.

landing.guideLink: Har module kaise kaam karta hai
landing.guideTitle: Har module kaise kaam karta hai
landing.guideSub: Har module do tarah se: dukaan ki aasan zaban mein misaal ke sath, aur technical parhne wale ke liye ke andar se kaise kaam karta hai. Kholne ke liye kisi module par tap karein.
landing.guideTech: Andar se kaise kaam karta hai

sell.d: Galaxy A55 chunein, qeemat khud aa jati hai.

bill.d: Confirm karein; bill print ya WhatsApp ke liye tayyar.

audit.d: Mahine ki sale, munafa, naqd aur udhaar.

stock.d: Har phone apne IMEI, haalat aur qeemat ke sath.

khata.d: Kis ne dene hain aur kis ko dene hain.

hisaab.d: Kya aaya, kya gaya, galle mein kitna hai.

labs.d: Lab ka record aur repair audit.

help.d: Koi bhi lafz misaal ke sath.

sale.s: Chand tap mein phone ya item bechein: naqd, online, cheque, bahar se, udhaar ya qiston par.
sale.e: Bilal ne Infinix Hot 40 Rs. 34,500 mein liya, Rs. 20,000 Easypaisa par diye: bill print, Rs. 14,500 us ke khate mein, phone stock se nikal gaya.
sale.x1: Ek sale bill, us ki lines aur ek balanced ledger entry likhti hai (sale, tax, maal ki laagat, naqd / bank / khata).
sale.x2: Har phone ka na badalne wala "bik gaya" event banta hai; stock aur laagat hisaab se nikalte hain, haath se nahi likhe jaate.
sale.x3: Maangi qeemat ya laagat se kam par owner / manager ka PIN chahiye (har dukaan ke apne qeemat ke usool).

purchase.s: Dealer se phone aur item khareedein, ya customer se purana phone, abhi ada ya dealer ke udhaar par.
purchase.e: Rehman Traders ne 2 Tecno phone Rs. 28,500 fi diye, aap ne Rs. 40,000 diye: Rs. 17,000 us ke khate mein, dono phone barcode ke sath stock mein.
purchase.x1: Har line ek device (dukaan mein IMEI munfarid) ya item ka batch us ki asal laagat par kholti hai.
purchase.x2: Ledger: laagat par stock vs naqd aur supplier ka khata; dealer ko wapsi ulta entry hai.
purchase.x3: Customer se purana phone bechne se pehle shanakht ki jaanch (CNIC) chahiye.

stock.s: Har phone apne IMEI, PTA, haalat, qeemat aur khareed se farokht tak poori history ke sath.
stock.e: 4512 search karein: woh iPhone 13 khulega jis ka IMEI 4512 par khatam hota hai, kab aur kis se khareeda, qeemat ki tabdeeliyan aur kis ko becha.
stock.x1: Haalat ek state machine se aati hai (stock, bik gaya, dukaan ke paas, repair, wapas…); har tabdeeli ek event hai.
stock.x2: History ki screen sirf inhi events se banti hai, is liye khaton se kabhi mukhtalif nahi hoti.
stock.x3: Tablet aur smart watch isi device record mein hain, qism aur spec sheet ke sath.

verify.s: Purana phone bechne se pehle bechne wale ki jaanch: CNIC, us ka number, IMEI block to nahi.
verify.e: Usman ne purana Redmi becha: aap us ka CNIC scan karte hain, PTA darj karte hain; phone par "jaanch mukammal" aane ke baad hi bikta hai.
verify.x1: Har device ki jaanch ki haalat hai (baqi / mukammal / mashkook); baqi wala phone nahi bikta.
verify.x2: Chhorne ke liye wajah chahiye ("main ise janta hun") aur yeh sirf owner ke security audit mein dikhta hai.
verify.x3: CNIC ki tasveer har dukaan ki apni mehfooz jagah mein rehti hai.

khata.s: Har bande ka ek safha: udhaar par becha ya khareeda, har adaigi, aur baqaya.
khata.e: Bilal ka khata: do phone udhaar Rs. 46,000, ada Rs. 26,000 → aap ne Rs. 20,000 lene hain; ek tap mein WhatsApp reminder.
khata.x1: Baqaya sirf likhe jaane wale ledger se nikalta hai; kuch bhi badla nahi jata — durusti naya ulta entry hai.
khata.x2: Umar sab se purane ghair ada bill se; der sirf wade ki tareekh ke baad.
khata.x3: Kisi bhi arse ka statement PDF / Excel mein.

lending.s: Kisi ko di ya us se li gayi raqam baghair bill ke, bills se alag, wapsi ki tareekh aur reminder ke sath.
lending.e: Tariq ko Rs. 25,000 diye, 5 tareekh tak wapsi; us ne Rs. 10,000 lautaye. Card par Rs. 15,000 baqi; 6 tareekh ko WhatsApp reminder.
lending.x1: Isi khate mein "lending" maqsad wali adaigi, apni ledger qism ke sath taake har report use alag rakhe.
lending.x2: Khula len-den hisaab se nikalta hai; "bills mein adjust" koi raqam nahi hilata, sirf bill ki haalat.
lending.x3: Wapsi ka reminder raat ka kaam bhejta hai, zyada se zyada har 3 din.

payments.t: Raqam ka aana jana aur accounts
payments.s: Galla, bank, Easypaisa, JazzCash aur cheque ka apna apna baqaya; har adaigi sahi jagah jati hai.
payments.e: Customer ne Easypaisa par Rs. 10,000 bheje: Easypaisa ka baqaya barha, galla nahi. Ek tap mein galle se HBL mein Rs. 1,00,000.
payments.x1: Har account ek ledger account hai; transfer apni entry hai aur kabhi aamdani ya kharcha nahi.
payments.x2: Online / cheque / bahar ki tafseel (TID, bank, rate) adaigi ke sath mehfooz.
payments.x3: Din band karte waqt gina hua galla mutawaqqa se milaya jata hai aur farq mehfooz hota hai.

returns.s: Customer phone wapas kare (poori raqam ya katauti ke sath), aap dealer ko wapas karein, ya purana de kar naya lein.
returns.e: Customer ne Rs. 10,000 ka phone wapas kiya; aap ne Rs. 9,000 lautaye aur Rs. 1,000 rakhe: phone stock mein wapas, Rs. 1,000 doosri aamdani.
returns.x1: Wapsi ek naya document hai jo sale ka hissa ulatta hai; asal bill kabhi nahi badalta.
returns.x2: Phone par "wapas" event banta hai aur woh phir bik sakta hai.
returns.x3: Tabadle mein farq ek entry mein.

repairs.s: Phone lein, khud theek karein ya market ki lab ko bhejein, sticker lagayein, bill ke sath wapas karein.
repairs.e: Ahmed ke iPhone 11 ki screen: Rs. 3,000 advance, Zain Lab ko bheja (Rs. 8,500), theek ho kar aaya; Ahmed ko "tayyar" ka message gaya.
repairs.x1: Job ka status flow hai; lab ka har chakkar apni row hai (bheja, theek / nahi, mansookh) poori history ke sath.
repairs.x2: Lab ka charge us ke khate mein; customer ke phone par repair ki laagat, dukaan ke phone par us phone ki qeemat mein.
repairs.x3: Sticker ka barcode job number hai; screen lock kabhi print nahi hota.

items.s: Charger, cable, cover, glass: darjan ya dabbe mein khareedein, piece mein bechein, kam stock ki ittila ke sath.
items.e: 3 darjan cable Rs. 1,200 fi darjan: 36 piece Rs. 100 fi. 6 beche: stock 30 aur munafa durust.
items.x1: Har aamad ek batch kholti hai; nikasi sab se purane se (FIFO) ya ausat laagat se, dukaan ki pasand.
items.x2: Kam az kam qeemat, dealer ki wholesale qeemat, promo qeemat aur apna GST %.
items.x3: Adjustment ke liye wajah; item ka kuch bhi delete nahi hota.

installments.s: Zamin ke sath mahana qiston par bechein; dekhein aaj kis ki qist hai aur kaun der se hai.
installments.e: Rs. 60,000 ka phone, Rs. 15,000 abhi aur 10 tareekh ko Rs. 7,500 ki 6 qistein; ek din pehle reminder.
installments.x1: Plan sirf batata hai ke udhaar kaise wapas hoga; raqam customer ke khate mein hi rehti hai.
installments.x2: Baqi / der plan ke muqable adaigiyon se nikalta hai.
installments.x3: Reminder raat ka kaam bhejta hai.

expenses.s: Kiraya, bill, tankhwah, chai: qismon mein likhein; galla gin kar din band karein.
expenses.e: Aaj bijli Rs. 6,200 aur chai Rs. 800; raat ko galle mein Rs. 45,200 gine, mutawaqqa Rs. 45,000: +200 mehfooz.
expenses.x1: Kharcha chune gaye account par ledger entry hai; durusti mansookh kar ke dobara.
expenses.x2: Owner ki nikali raqam alag rehti hai aur kabhi kharcha nahi.
expenses.x3: Kharche har report mein kharchon ke baad ke munafe mein jaate hain.

audit.s: Kisi bhi arse ka munafa, naqd, udhaar, stock, sale, khareed, staff, repair aur len-den, print aur Excel ke sath.
audit.e: Is mahine: net sale Rs. 7,18,800, majmui munafa, kharche, asal munafa; kis ne kya becha; kaun se phone 90 din purane hain.
audit.x1: Sirf parhna: har adad ledger, documents aur device events se nikalta hai aur bill tak khola ja sakta hai.
audit.x2: Arse, "kisi din tak" aur pichla arsa; milan ki jaanch ke khate barabar hain.
audit.x3: Laagat aur munafa sirf owner aur manager ko; security feed sirf owner ko.

staff.s: Owner, manager, salesman, technician: har ek wahi dekhta hai jo us ke kaam ko chahiye. Hazri aur kaam ka record.
staff.e: Kashif (salesman) bechta aur stock daalta hai lekin khareed qeemat ya dukaan ka munafa kabhi nahi dekhta; Imran (manager) reports dekhta hai.
staff.x1: Role → ijazat ka table har request par server par check hota hai, sirf screen par chhupaya nahi jata.
staff.x2: Har kaam audit log mein kis ne aur kab ke sath.
staff.x3: Qeemat ke usool se hatne ke liye owner / manager ka PIN.

barcodes.s: Har phone aur item ka barcode; qeemat aur repair sticker print karein; kisi bhi scanner se scan.
barcodes.e: Counter par sticker scan karein: phone sale mein aa gaya. Shelf scan karein: stock ginti batati hai kya ghayab hai.
barcodes.x1: Barcode khareed ke andar hi milta hai aur kabhi nahi badalta; phone, item, IMEI aur SKU sab mein munfarid.
barcodes.x2: Code 128 / EAN / QR; koi bhi USB / Bluetooth scanner keyboard ki tarah kaam karta hai.

help.t: Urdu, Roman Urdu, English — aur har jagah "?"
help.s: App ek waqt mein ek zaban dikhati hai; har khane, card aur tab par wazahat aur misaal wala "?".
help.e: "Net sale" samajh nahi aaya? "?" dabayein: "Discount aur wapsi ke baad ki sale — Rs. 1,20,000 becha, Rs. 40,000 ka wapas aaya → Rs. 80,000".
help.x1: Saari likhawat tarjume ki files se; bill aur message dukaan ki zaban mein.
help.x2: 1,100 se zyada wazahatein, har ek unwan, wazahat aur misaal ke sath teeno zabanon mein.
help.x3: Agar kisi "?" mein koi zaban ya misaal kam ho to test build rok deta hai.

devices.s: Kisi bhi phone ke browser par, Android app ke taur par, keyboard shortcuts ke sath laptop par, ya baghair internet ek Windows computer par.
devices.e: Internet gaya: sale phone par intezar karti hai aur connection aate hi chali jati hai. Ghar par laptop se audit dekhein.
devices.x1: Ek PWA (install hone wali web app) aur Android app, ek hi code se.
devices.x2: Baghair internet ki sale munfarid key ke sath qatar mein taake ek hi baar jaye.
devices.x3: Ek computer wali Windows install ka apna database, aur provider ko apni khabar deti hai.

security.s: Aap ki dukaan ka data sirf aap ka; har tabdeeli darj; kuch bhi delete nahi hota.
security.e: Salesman ne bill mansookh kiya: owner security feed mein dekhta hai kis ne, kab aur kyun.
security.x1: Har table dukaan ke hisaab se alag; koi bhi query doosri dukaan ki rows nahi parh sakti.
security.x2: Raqam bilkul durust (decimal, kabhi float nahi); ledger aur device events sirf likhe jaate hain.
security.x3: Fingerprint / PIN login, bhoole password ke liye phone OTP, rozana backup.

fbr.s: Har bill par poora tax invoice, aur registered dukaanon ke liye har bill FBR ko, number aur QR ke sath.
fbr.e: Bilal ne charger aur cover Rs. 2,360 mein 18% tax ke sath beche: bill par Rs. 2,000 tax ke baghair, "Tax 18% on 2,000 = 360", raqam lafzon mein, aur FBR number us ke QR ke sath.
fbr.x1: Bill sale ki usi transaction mein queue hota hai aur us ke bahar bheja jata hai, background mein aur har minute scheduler se.
fbr.x2: Claim do workers ko ek hi bill bhejne se rokta hai; qabool hua bill dobara kabhi post nahi hota; dobara koshish 1 se 60 minute tak.
fbr.x3: Token server par encrypted aur sirf likhne ke liye hai: koi screen ya API use wapas nahi deti.

books.s: Kisi bhi tareekh par dukaan ke paas kya hai (stock, cash, wasool karna udhaar), kis ka dena hai (supplier, len-den) aur maalik ka hissa.
books.e: 30 June ko: stock Rs. 18,40,000, cash aur bank Rs. 2,15,000, customers ka dena Rs. 95,000, suppliers ko dena Rs. 3,10,000 — baqi aap ka sarmaya aur munafa.
books.x1: Sirf aage badhne wale ledger se banta hai; haath se kuch nahi likha jata.
books.x2: Trial balance: har account ka debit aur credit sath sath, hamesha barabar.
books.x3: Durusti nayi tareekh wali entry hoti hai, is liye purani report baghair nishan ke nahi badalti.

transfers.s: Apni ek dukaan se doosri ko phone aur accessories bhejein, aur dekhein kya raste mein hai.
transfers.e: Gulberg branch 3 iPhone aur 20 charger Mall Road branch ko bhejti hai; phone Gulberg ke stock se nikal kar Mall Road mein apni poori history ke sath aate hain.
transfers.x1: Phone ki row ki dukaan kabhi nahi badalti: bhejne wale ke haan "transferred out", lene wale ke haan "transferred in".
transfers.x2: Items sab se purane batch se nikalte hain aur usi laagat par naye batch ki shakal mein aate hain.
transfers.x3: Paisa laagat par branch account se jata hai, aamdani nahi banta; sirf maalik ya manager, ek hi karobar.

landing.uniqueTitle: Pakistani mobile dukaan ki har zaroorat — ek hi app mein
landing.uniqueSub: Doosre software ya to general store ke liye hain, ya sirf online, ya sirf English mein. Yeh purane phones ki market ke liye bana hai: phone app, online, baghair internet, jaanch aur bechne wale ki razamandi, aap ki zaban mein.

android.d: Dukaan ke phone par install karein: bare button, camera IMEI aur shanakhti card scan karta hai, fingerprint login.
android.p2: Camera se barcode aur shanakhti card scan

online.d: Kisi bhi browser mein kholein — phone, laptop ya computer — aur ghar se apni dukaan live dekhein.
online.p1: Keyboard shortcuts ke sath laptop view
online.p2: Staff apne phone par, har ek ka apna role

offline.d: Internet chala gaya? Sale phone par mehfooz rehti hai aur connection aate hi chali jati hai. Ya ek Windows computer par baghair internet chalayein.
offline.p1: Koi sale na gum hoti hai na do baar jati hai
offline.p2: Raat ke backup ke sath ek computer wali Windows install

consent.t: Bechne wale ki dastakhat shuda razamandi
consent.d: Purana phone khareedte waqt bechne wala screen par iqrar name par dastakhat karta hai — phone, us ke shanakhti card aur tareekh ke sath mehfooz.
consent.p1: Dastakhat, shanakhti card ki tasveer aur IMEI ek sath
consent.p2: Zaroorat parne par kabhi bhi iqrar nama print karein

verify.d: Purana phone bechne se pehle: bechne wale ka shanakhti card, PTA, IMEI ki jaanch, aur tablet aur watch par iCloud / Google lock.
verify.p1: Jaanch baqi ho to phone nahi bikta
verify.p2: Chhorne ke liye wajah chahiye jo owner tak pohanchti hai

langs.d: Poori app us zaban mein jo aap ka staff parhta hai — aur har khane par misaal wala "?", teeno mein se kisi bhi zaban mein.
langs.p1: Bill aur WhatsApp dukaan ki zaban mein
langs.p2: Dukaan ki misaalon ke sath 1,100 se zyada wazahatein

landing.metaTitle: Mobile Shop Software Pakistan — Android app, online aur offline
landing.metaDesc: Pakistan ki mobile shops ke liye software: purane aur naye phone CNIC verification aur bechne wale ki razamandi ke sath, udhaar khata, repair aur repair labs, FBR ke liye tayyar tax bill, branches, balance sheet, shop audit. Android app, online aur offline, Urdu aur English. 14 din muft.

fbr.title: FBR ke liye tayyar bill
fbr.sub: Sales tax registered dukaanon ke liye. FBR ke Digital Invoicing (PRAL) ke qawaid ke mutabiq bana hai, is liye jis din aap ki dukaan ko invoice report karne hon, aap sirf on karte hain.
fbr.p1: Har sale ka bill sale ke foran baad FBR ko jata hai — counter par koi extra qadam nahi.
fbr.p2: FBR ka invoice number aur us ka QR code bill par chhapta hai.
fbr.p3: Internet ya FBR band? Bill intezar karta hai aur khud chala jata hai; sale kabhi nahi rukti.
fbr.p4: Har bill ek baar jata hai, do baar kabhi nahi; FBR jo bill radd kare us ki wajah aur "Dobara bhejein" ka button dikhta hai.
fbr.p5: Aap ka FBR token server par taale mein rehta hai aur dobara kabhi nahi dikhta, aap ko bhi nahi.
fbr.p6: Har qism ke maal ki sale type aur HS code — phone, doosri devices, accessories.
fbr.note: Shuru mein band hai. Aap ko NTN, STRN aur IRIS ka Digital Invoicing token chahiye; FBR ke sandbox par test ke baad hum aap ke sath on karte hain. Sales tax mein registered nahi? Aap ke liye kuch nahi badalta.

bulk.title: Bulk Excel
bulk.intro: Excel mein ek saath bohat si rows likhein: sheet download karein, bharein, upload karein. Pehle check dikhta hai; 'Import' dabane tak kuch save nahi hota.
bulk.step1Hint: Is mein teen peeli sample rows, ek Help sheet aur dropdown lists hain. Apna data samples ke neeche ya un ki jagah likhein.

step2Hint.stock: Ek row = ek mobile. Apna purana stock ho to supplier khali chhorein; supplier ka phone likhein to khareed bill banega.
step2Hint.people: Naam, phone aur qisam kafi hai. Baqi raqam ho to opening balance aur kaun dega bhi likhein.
step2Hint.items: Ek row = ek cheez, maujood tadaad, fi adad cost aur sale price ke saath.
step2Hint.sales: Sirf woh mobile jo app ke stock mein hain. Khatay mein kuch baqi rahe to customer ka phone dein.
step2Hint.expenses: Tareekh, qisam aur raqam. Qisam Lists sheet ke mutabiq ho.

bulk.step3Hint: Excel (.xlsx) ya CSV. Zyada se zyada 2,000 rows.
bulk.optCatalogue: Sheet se naye brand aur model banayein
bulk.optSkip: Ghalat rows chhor dein, baqi import karein
bulk.previewHint: Har paigham aur value dekhne ke liye row par tap karein. Abhi kuch save nahi hua.
bulk.alreadyImported: Yehi file {{when}} ko import ho chuki hai. Dobara karne se double entry ho sakti hai.
bulk.fixFirst: Ghalat rows Excel mein theek kar ke dobara upload karein, ya 'ghalat rows chhor dein' tick karein.
